File: supabase/functions/process-turn/steps/step3_persistence.ts
================
  1: // supabase/functions/process-turn/steps/step3_persistence.ts
  2: // Шаг 3: Мутация БД (ACID Транзакция)
  3: // Применяет все мутации из Шага 2 атомарно через RPC apply_turn_mutations.
  4: 
  5: import { createClient } from "https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2";
  6: import { EngineOutputPayload, EngineMutation } from "../engine/types.ts";
  7: import { cleanTextForAI } from "../../_shared/utils.ts";
  8: 
  9: // ============================================
 10: // Типы
 11: // ============================================
 12: export interface PersistenceInputContext {
 13:   session_id: string;
 14:   engine_output: EngineOutputPayload;
 15: }
 16: 
 17: export interface PersistenceOutputPayload {
 18:   status: "committed" | "aborted_conflict" | "error";
 19:   applied_mutations_count: number;
 20:   new_game_time?: {
 21:     year: number;
 22:     month: number;
 23:     day: number;
 24:     hour: number;
 25:     minute: number;
 26:   };
 27:   conflict_details?: string | null;
 28:   enriched_system_facts: string[];
 29: }
 30: 
 31: // ============================================
 32: // Коды ошибок, которые RPC может вернуть
 33: // ============================================
 34: const CONFLICT_CODES = new Set([
 35:   "ITEM_NOT_AVAILABLE",
 36:   "ITEM_NOT_FOUND",
 37:   "ITEM_NOT_AVAILABLE_FOR_TRANSFER",
 38:   "TARGET_NOT_FOUND",
 39:   "SESSION_NOT_FOUND",
 40:   "INVALID_TARGET_TYPE",
 41:   "INVALID_OWNER_TYPE",
 42:   "UNKNOWN_MUTATION_TYPE",
 43:   "RACE_CONDITION_CONFLICT",
 44: ]);
 45: 
 46: function isConflictError(details: string | null | undefined): boolean {
 47:   if (!details) return false;
 48:   for (const code of CONFLICT_CODES) {
 49:     if (details.includes(code)) return true;
 50:   }
 51:   return false;
 52: }
 53: 
 54: // ============================================
 55: // Обогащение фактов на основе применённых мутаций
 56: // ============================================
 57: function enrichSystemFacts(engine_output: EngineOutputPayload, rpcResult: any): string[] {
 58:   const facts: string[] = [...engine_output.raw_system_facts];
 59: 
 60:   for (const mutation of engine_output.mutations) {
 61:     const m = mutation as any;
 62:     switch (m.type) {
 63:       case "UPDATE_HP":
 64:         if (m.delta < 0) {
 65:           facts.push(`${m.target_type === "npc" ? "NPC" : "Игрок"} ${m.id.slice(0, 8)} получил ${-m.delta} урона.`);
 66:         } else if (m.delta > 0) {
 67:           facts.push(`${m.target_type === "npc" ? "NPC" : "Игрок"} ${m.id.slice(0, 8)} восстановил ${m.delta} HP.`);
 68:         }
 69:         break;
 70:       case "UPDATE_DURABILITY":
 71:         if (m.delta < 0) {
 72:           facts.push(`Прочность предмета ${m.item_id.slice(0, 8)} уменьшена на ${-m.delta}.`);
 73:           if (m.set_broken) {
 74:             facts.push(`⚠️ Предмет ${m.item_id.slice(0, 8)} сломан.`);
 75:           }
 76:         }
 77:         break;
 78:       case "DELETE_ITEM":
 79:         facts.push(`Удалено ${m.quantity} ед. предмета ${m.item_id.slice(0, 8)}.`);
 80:         break;
 81:       case "INSERT_ITEM": {
 82:         const itemName = m.item?.item_name || m.item?.name || "предмет";
 83:         const qty = m.item?.quantity || 1;
 84:         facts.push(`Создан предмет: "${itemName}" x${qty} (owner: ${m.owner_type}).`);
 85:         break;
 86:       }
 87:       case "TRANSFER_ITEM":
 88:         facts.push(`Передано ${m.quantity} ед. предмета ${m.item_id.slice(0, 8)} → ${m.to_type}:${m.to_id.slice(0, 8)}.`);
 89:         break;
 90:       case "SPAWN_STRUCTURE":
 91:         facts.push(`Создана структура "${m.structure?.name || "?"}" в локации ${m.location_id.slice(0, 8)}.`);
 92:         break;
 93:       case "ADVANCE_TIME":
 94:         facts.push(`Время сдвинулось на ${m.minutes} минут.`);
 95:         break;
 96:     }
 97:   }
 98: 
 99:   if (rpcResult?.new_time) {
100:     const t = rpcResult.new_time;
101:     facts.push(`Текущее время: ${t.day}.${t.month}.${t.year} ${t.hour}:${String(t.minute).padStart(2, "0")}.`);
102:   }
103: 
104:   facts.push(`✅ Применено мутаций: ${rpcResult?.applied_count ?? engine_output.mutations.length}.`);
105: 
106:   return facts;
107: }
108: 
109: // ============================================
110: // Lazy Supabase client
111: // ============================================
112: let _supabase: any = null;
113: 
114: function getSupabase() {
115:   if (_supabase) return _supabase;
116:   // @ts-ignore
117:   const supabaseUrl = (typeof Deno !== "undefined" ? Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL") : null) ?? process.env?.SUPABASE_URL ?? "https://test.supabase.co";
118:   // @ts-ignore
119:   const supabaseKey = (typeof Deno !== "undefined" ? Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY") : null) ?? process.env?.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY ?? "test-key";
120:   _supabase = createClient(supabaseUrl, supabaseKey);
121:   return _supabase;
122: }
123: 
124: // ============================================
125: // Главная функция Шага 3
126: // ============================================
127: export async function applyTurnMutations(context: PersistenceInputContext, supabaseOverride?: any): Promise<PersistenceOutputPayload> {
128:   const { session_id, engine_output } = context;
129: 
130:   // ============================================
131:   // Если мутаций нет — сразу "committed"
132:   // ============================================
133:   if (!engine_output.mutations || engine_output.mutations.length === 0) {
134:     return {
135:       status: "committed",
136:       applied_mutations_count: 0,
137:       enriched_system_facts: [
138:         ...engine_output.raw_system_facts,
139:         "Нет мутаций для применения.",
140:       ],
141:     };
142:   }
143: 
144:   const supabase = supabaseOverride || getSupabase();
145: 
146:   try {
147:     console.log(`[step3_persistence] Applying ${engine_output.mutations.length} mutations to session ${session_id}...`);
148: 
149:     // ============================================
150:     // Вызов RPC
151:     // ============================================
152:     const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc("apply_turn_mutations", {
153:       p_mutations: engine_output.mutations,
154:       p_session_id: session_id,
155:     });
156: 
157:     if (error) {
158:       console.error(`[step3_persistence] RPC error:`, error);
159: 
160:       if (isConflictError(error.message)) {
161:         return {
162:           status: "aborted_conflict",
163:           applied_mutations_count: 0,
164:           conflict_details: error.message,
165:           enriched_system_facts: [
166:             "Действие отменено: предмет был перемещён или уничтожен до завершения действия (race condition).",
167:             ...engine_output.raw_system_facts,
168:           ],
169:         };
170:       }
171: 
172:       return {
173:         status: "error",
174:         applied_mutations_count: 0,
175:         conflict_details: error.message,
176:         enriched_system_facts: [
177:           `Системная ошибка при применении мутаций: ${error.message}`,
178:           ...engine_output.raw_system_facts,
179:         ],
180:       };
181:     }
182: 
183:     // ============================================
184:     // Проверяем data.success (RPC может вернуть структуру ошибки)
185:     // ============================================
186:     if (data && typeof data === "object") {
187:       if (data.success === false) {
188:         const details = data.details || "Unknown error";
189:         console.warn(`[step3_persistence] RPC returned error: ${details}`);
190: 
191:         if (isConflictError(details)) {
192:           return {
193:             status: "aborted_conflict",
194:             applied_mutations_count: 0,
195:             conflict_details: details,
196:             enriched_system_facts: [
197:               "Действие отменено: race condition или отсутствие ресурсов.",
198:               ...engine_output.raw_system_facts,
199:             ],
200:           };
201:         }
202: 
203:         return {
204:           status: "error",
205:           applied_mutations_count: 0,
206:           conflict_details: details,
207:           enriched_system_facts: [
208:             `Системная ошибка: ${details}`,
209:             ...engine_output.raw_system_facts,
210:           ],
211:         };
212:       }
213: 
214:       // Успех
215:       const enriched = enrichSystemFacts(engine_output, data);
216:       console.log(`[step3_persistence] ✅ Committed ${data.applied_count} mutations`);
217: 
218:       return {
219:         status: "committed",
220:         applied_mutations_count: data.applied_count || 0,
221:         new_game_time: data.new_time,
222:         enriched_system_facts: enriched,
223:       };
224:     }
225: 
226:     // Fallback: пустой ответ
227:     return {
228:       status: "committed",
229:       applied_mutations_count: engine_output.mutations.length,
230:       enriched_system_facts: engine_output.raw_system_facts,
231:     };
232: 
233:   } catch (err) {
234:     console.error(`[step3_persistence] Exception:`, err);
235:     const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
236: 
237:     if (isConflictError(message)) {
238:       return {
239:         status: "aborted_conflict",
240:         applied_mutations_count: 0,
241:         conflict_details: message,
242:         enriched_system_facts: [
243:           "Действие отменено: race condition.",
244:           ...engine_output.raw_system_facts,
245:         ],
246:       };
247:     }
248: 
249:     throw new Error(`Step 3 persistence failed: ${message}`);
250:   }
251: }

 1: // supabase/functions/test-ping/index.ts
 2: import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.177.0/http/server.ts";
 3: 
 4: const CORS = {
 5:   "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
 6:   "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type, Authorization, x-client-info, apikey",
 7:   "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "POST, OPTIONS",
 8: };
 9: 
10: serve(async (req) => {
11:   if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
12:     return new Response("ok", { headers: CORS });
13:   }
14:   return new Response(JSON.stringify({ ok: true }), {
15:     status: 200,
16:     headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
17:   });
18: });

153: CREATE POLICY "Inventory: system manage" ON inventory FOR ALL USING (true);

171: $$;

178: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION roll_d20(stat_value INT, difficulty_mod INT DEFAULT 0)
179: RETURNS TABLE (roll INT, total INT, success BOOLEAN)
180: LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
181: DECLARE d20_roll INT; stat_mod INT; total_val INT;
182: BEGIN
183:   d20_roll := floor(random() * 20 + 1)::INT;
184:   stat_mod := floor((stat_value - 10) / 2.0)::INT;
185:   total_val := d20_roll + stat_mod + difficulty_mod;
186:   RETURN QUERY SELECT d20_roll AS roll, total_val AS total, (total_val >= 10) AS success;
187: END;
188: $$;
189: 
190: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION roll_d20_advantage(stat_value INT)
191: RETURNS TABLE (rolls INT[], best_roll INT, total INT, success BOOLEAN)
192: LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
193: DECLARE r1 INT; r2 INT; best INT; stat_mod INT; total_val INT;
194: BEGIN
195:   r1 := floor(random() * 20 + 1)::INT;
196:   r2 := floor(random() * 20 + 1)::INT;
197:   best := GREATEST(r1, r2);
198:   stat_mod := floor((stat_value - 10) / 2.0)::INT;
199:   total_val := best + stat_mod;
200:   RETURN QUERY SELECT ARRAY[r1, r2] AS rolls, best AS best_roll, total_val AS total, (total_val >= 10) AS success;
201: END;
202: $$;
203: 
204: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION roll_d20_disadvantage(stat_value INT)
205: RETURNS TABLE (rolls INT[], worst_roll INT, total INT, success BOOLEAN)
206: LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
207: DECLARE r1 INT; r2 INT; worst INT; stat_mod INT; total_val INT;
208: BEGIN
209:   r1 := floor(random() * 20 + 1)::INT;
210:   r2 := floor(random() * 20 + 1)::INT;
211:   worst := LEAST(r1, r2);
212:   stat_mod := floor((stat_value - 10) / 2.0)::INT;
213:   total_val := worst + stat_mod;
214:   RETURN QUERY SELECT ARRAY[r1, r2] AS rolls, worst AS worst_roll, total_val AS total, (total_val >= 10) AS success;
215: END;
216: $$;
217: 
218: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_player_hp(p_player_id UUID, p_hp_change INT)
219: RETURNS TABLE (new_hp INT, new_max_hp INT, is_alive BOOLEAN)
220: LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
221: DECLARE current_hp_val INT; max_hp_val INT; new_hp_val INT;
222: BEGIN
223:   SELECT hp, max_hp INTO current_hp_val, max_hp_val FROM players WHERE id = p_player_id FOR UPDATE;
224:   new_hp_val := GREATEST(0, LEAST(max_hp_val, current_hp_val + p_hp_change));
225:   UPDATE players SET hp = new_hp_val WHERE id = p_player_id;
226:   RETURN QUERY SELECT new_hp_val AS new_hp, max_hp_val AS new_max_hp, (new_hp_val > 0) AS is_alive;
227: END;
228: $$;
229: 
230: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION add_item_to_inventory(p_player_id UUID, p_item_name TEXT, p_quantity INT DEFAULT 1, p_type TEXT DEFAULT 'misc', p_attributes JSONB DEFAULT '{}')
231: RETURNS UUID LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
232: DECLARE existing_item_id UUID; new_id UUID;
233: BEGIN
234:   SELECT id INTO existing_item_id FROM inventory WHERE player_id = p_player_id AND item_name = p_item_name AND type = p_type FOR UPDATE;
235:   IF existing_item_id IS NOT NULL THEN
236:     UPDATE inventory SET quantity = quantity + p_quantity WHERE id = existing_item_id;
237:     RETURN existing_item_id;
238:   ELSE
239:     new_id := gen_random_uuid();
240:     INSERT INTO inventory (id, player_id, item_name, quantity, type, attributes) VALUES (new_id, p_player_id, p_item_name, p_quantity, p_type, p_attributes);
241:     RETURN new_id;
242:   END IF;
243: END;
244: $$;
245: 
246: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION remove_item_from_inventory(p_player_id UUID, p_item_name TEXT, p_quantity INT DEFAULT 1)
247: RETURNS BOOLEAN LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
248: DECLARE existing_item RECORD;
249: BEGIN
250:   SELECT id, quantity INTO existing_item FROM inventory WHERE player_id = p_player_id AND item_name = p_item_name FOR UPDATE;
251:   IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN FALSE; END IF;
252:   IF existing_item.quantity <= p_quantity THEN
253:     DELETE FROM inventory WHERE id = existing_item.id;
254:   ELSE
255:     UPDATE inventory SET quantity = quantity - p_quantity WHERE id = existing_item.id;
256:   END IF;
257:   RETURN TRUE;
258: END;
259: $$;
260:

263: -- ============================================
264: 
265: ALTER PUBLICATION supabase_realtime ADD TABLE messages;
266: ALTER PUBLICATION supabase_realtime ADD TABLE players;
267: ALTER PUBLICATION supabase_realtime ADD TABLE turn_queue;

 1: -- ============================================
 2: -- MultiRP AI — Migration 002: User Settings
 3: -- ============================================
 4: 
 5: -- Таблица настроек пользователя (API-ключи и пр.)
 6: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_settings (
 7:   id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 8:   openrouter_key TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
 9:   created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
10:   updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
11: );
12: 
13: -- Drop existing policies to allow re-running
14: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "UserSettings: owner read" ON user_settings;
15: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "UserSettings: owner insert" ON user_settings;
16: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "UserSettings: owner update" ON user_settings;
17: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "UserSettings: service read" ON user_settings;
18: 
19: -- RLS: пользователь видит и редактирует ТОЛЬКО свою строку
20: ALTER TABLE user_settings ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
21: 
22: CREATE POLICY "UserSettings: owner read"
23:   ON user_settings FOR SELECT
24:   USING (auth.uid() = id);
25: 
26: CREATE POLICY "UserSettings: owner insert"
27:   ON user_settings FOR INSERT
28:   WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = id);
29: 
30: CREATE POLICY "UserSettings: owner update"
31:   ON user_settings FOR UPDATE
32:   USING (auth.uid() = id);
33: 
34: -- Service role (Edge Functions) может читать настройки любого пользователя
35: CREATE POLICY "UserSettings: service read"
36:   ON user_settings FOR SELECT
37:   USING (true);
38: 
39: -- Drop existing trigger to allow re-running
40: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trigger_user_settings_updated_at ON user_settings;
41: 
42: -- Триггер auto-updated_at
43: CREATE TRIGGER trigger_user_settings_updated_at
44:   BEFORE UPDATE ON user_settings
45:   FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at();
46: 
47: -- ============================================
48: -- RPC: Upsert настроек пользователя
49: -- ============================================
50: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION upsert_user_settings(
51:   p_user_id UUID,
52:   p_openrouter_key TEXT DEFAULT NULL
53: )
54: RETURNS UUID
55: LANGUAGE plpgsql
56: SECURITY DEFINER
57: AS $$
58: DECLARE
59:   existing_id UUID;
60: BEGIN
61:   SELECT id INTO existing_id FROM user_settings WHERE id = p_user_id;
62: 
63:   IF existing_id IS NOT NULL THEN
64:     UPDATE user_settings
65:     SET openrouter_key = COALESCE(p_openrouter_key, openrouter_key),
66:         updated_at = NOW()
67:     WHERE id = p_user_id;
68:     RETURN existing_id;
69:   ELSE
70:     INSERT INTO user_settings (id, openrouter_key)
71:     VALUES (p_user_id, p_openrouter_key);
72:     RETURN p_user_id;
73:   END IF;
74: END;
75: $$;
76: 
77: -- ============================================
78: -- RPC: Получить ключ пользователя (для Edge Functions)
79: -- ============================================
80: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_user_openrouter_key(p_user_id UUID)
81: RETURNS TEXT
82: LANGUAGE plpgsql
83: SECURITY DEFINER
84: AS $$
85: DECLARE
86:   v_key TEXT;
87: BEGIN
88:   SELECT openrouter_key INTO v_key
89:   FROM user_settings
90:   WHERE id = p_user_id;
91: 
92:   RETURN v_key;
93: END;
94: $$;

File: supabase/migrations/003_character_cards.sql

 1: -- ============================================
 2: -- MultiRP AI — Migration 003: Character Cards
 3: -- Шаблоны персонажей, привязанные к пользователю
 4: -- ============================================
 5: 
 6: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS character_cards (
 7:   id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 8:   owner_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 9:   name TEXT NOT NULL,
10:   race TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Человек',
11:   class TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Воин',
12:   appearance TEXT DEFAULT '',
13:   personality JSONB DEFAULT '{"ideals": [], "bonds": [], "flaws": []}',
14:   bio TEXT DEFAULT '',
15:   power_level INT DEFAULT 10 CHECK (power_level >= 1 AND power_level <= 100),
16:   stats JSONB DEFAULT '{"STR": 10, "DEX": 10, "CON": 10, "INT": 10, "WIS": 10, "CHA": 10}',
17:   hp INT DEFAULT 30,
18:   max_hp INT DEFAULT 30,
19:   money INT DEFAULT 50,
20:   created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
21:   updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
22: );
23: 
24: -- Drop existing policies to allow re-running
25: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "CharCards: owner read" ON character_cards;
26: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "CharCards: owner insert" ON character_cards;
27: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "CharCards: owner update" ON character_cards;
28: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "CharCards: owner delete" ON character_cards;
29: 
30: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_character_cards_owner ON character_cards(owner_id);
31: 
32: ALTER TABLE character_cards ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
33: 
34: CREATE POLICY "CharCards: owner read" ON character_cards
35:   FOR SELECT USING (auth.uid() = owner_id);
36: 
37: CREATE POLICY "CharCards: owner insert" ON character_cards
38:   FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = owner_id);
39: 
40: CREATE POLICY "CharCards: owner update" ON character_cards
41:   FOR UPDATE USING (auth.uid() = owner_id);
42: 
43: CREATE POLICY "CharCards: owner delete" ON character_cards
44:   FOR DELETE USING (auth.uid() = owner_id);
45: 
46: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trigger_character_cards_updated_at ON character_cards;
47: CREATE TRIGGER trigger_character_cards_updated_at
48:   BEFORE UPDATE ON character_cards
49:   FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at();

File: supabase/migrations/007_npc_inventory_rpc.sql
================
 1: -- Обновление RPC функций инвентаря для поддержки NPC
 2: -- Применять после миграции 006
 3: 
 4: -- Обновление функции add_item_to_inventory для поддержки NPC
 5: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION add_item_to_inventory(
 6:   p_player_id UUID DEFAULT NULL,
 7:   p_item_name TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
 8:   p_quantity INT DEFAULT 1,
 9:   p_type TEXT DEFAULT 'misc',
10:   p_attributes JSONB DEFAULT '{}',
11:   p_npc_id UUID DEFAULT NULL
12: )
13: RETURNS UUID LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
14: DECLARE existing_item_id UUID; new_id UUID;
15: BEGIN
16:   -- Ищем существующий предмет по player_id или npc_id
17:   SELECT id INTO existing_item_id
18:   FROM inventory
19:   WHERE (
20:     (p_player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id = p_player_id)
21:     OR (p_npc_id IS NOT NULL AND npc_id = p_npc_id)
22:   )
23:   AND item_name = p_item_name
24:   AND type = p_type
25:   FOR UPDATE;
26: 
27:   IF existing_item_id IS NOT NULL THEN
28:     UPDATE inventory SET quantity = quantity + p_quantity WHERE id = existing_item_id;
29:     RETURN existing_item_id;
30:   ELSE
31:     new_id := gen_random_uuid();
32:     INSERT INTO inventory (id, player_id, npc_id, item_name, quantity, type, attributes)
33:     VALUES (new_id, p_player_id, p_npc_id, p_item_name, p_quantity, p_type, p_attributes);
34:     RETURN new_id;
35:   END IF;
36: END;
37: $$;
38: 
39: -- Обновление функции remove_item_from_inventory для поддержки NPC
40: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION remove_item_from_inventory(
41:   p_player_id UUID DEFAULT NULL,
42:   p_item_name TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
43:   p_quantity INT DEFAULT 1,
44:   p_npc_id UUID DEFAULT NULL
45: )
46: RETURNS BOOLEAN LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
47: DECLARE existing_item RECORD;
48: BEGIN
49:   -- Ищем существующий предмет по player_id или npc_id
50:   SELECT id, quantity INTO existing_item
51:   FROM inventory
52:   WHERE (
53:     (p_player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id = p_player_id)
54:     OR (p_npc_id IS NOT NULL AND npc_id = p_npc_id)
55:   )
56:   AND item_name = p_item_name
57:   FOR UPDATE;
58: 
59:   IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN FALSE; END IF;
60: 
61:   IF existing_item.quantity <= p_quantity THEN
62:     DELETE FROM inventory WHERE id = existing_item.id;
63:   ELSE
64:     UPDATE inventory SET quantity = quantity - p_quantity WHERE id = existing_item.id;
65:   END IF;
66: 
67:   RETURN TRUE;
68: END;
69: $$;

File: supabase/migrations/008_fix_rls_recursion.sql
================
  1: -- ============================================
  2: -- MultiRP AI — Migration 008: Fix RLS Infinite Recursion
  3: -- ============================================
  4: -- Исправляет ошибку "infinite recursion detected in policy for relation players"
  5: -- Создаём SECURITY DEFINER функцию, которая обходит RLS при проверке участия в сессии
  6: 
  7: -- Функция для получения session_id пользователя (обходит RLS через SECURITY DEFINER)
  8: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_user_session_ids(p_user_id UUID)
  9: RETURNS TABLE(session_id UUID)
 10: SECURITY DEFINER
 11: SET search_path = public
 12: AS $$
 13: BEGIN
 14:   RETURN QUERY SELECT DISTINCT p.session_id FROM public.players p WHERE p.user_id = p_user_id;
 15: END;
 16: $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
 17: 
 18: -- Функция для получения player_id пользователя (обходит RLS через SECURITY DEFINER)
 19: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_user_player_ids(p_user_id UUID)
 20: RETURNS TABLE(player_id UUID)
 21: SECURITY DEFINER
 22: SET search_path = public
 23: AS $$
 24: BEGIN
 25:   RETURN QUERY SELECT p.id FROM public.players p WHERE p.user_id = p_user_id;
 26: END;
 27: $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
 28: 
 29: -- ============================================
 30: -- ИСПРАВЛЕНИЕ ПОЛИТИК players
 31: -- ============================================
 32: 
 33: -- Удаляем рекурсивную политику
 34: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Players: read in same session" ON players;
 35: 
 36: -- Создаём нерекурсивную политику через функцию
 37: CREATE POLICY "Players: read in same session" ON players FOR SELECT TO authenticated
 38: USING (
 39:   session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM public.get_user_session_ids(auth.uid()))
 40:   OR user_id = auth.uid()
 41: );
 42: 
 43: -- ============================================
 44: -- ИСПРАВЛЕНИЕ ПОЛИТИК sessions
 45: -- ============================================
 46: 
 47: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Sessions: update for participants" ON sessions;
 48: 
 49: CREATE POLICY "Sessions: update for participants" ON sessions FOR UPDATE TO authenticated
 50: USING (id IN (SELECT session_id FROM public.get_user_session_ids(auth.uid())));
 51: 
 52: -- ============================================
 53: -- ИСПРАВЛЕНИЕ ПОЛИТИК inventory
 54: -- ============================================
 55: 
 56: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Inventory: read for owner" ON inventory;
 57: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Inventory: manage for owner" ON inventory;
 58: 
 59: CREATE POLICY "Inventory: read for owner" ON inventory FOR SELECT TO authenticated
 60: USING (player_id IN (SELECT player_id FROM public.get_user_player_ids(auth.uid())));
 61: 
 62: CREATE POLICY "Inventory: manage for owner" ON inventory FOR ALL TO authenticated
 63: USING (player_id IN (SELECT player_id FROM public.get_user_player_ids(auth.uid())));
 64: 
 65: -- ============================================
 66: -- ИСПРАВЛЕНИЕ ПОЛИТИК messages
 67: -- ============================================
 68: 
 69: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Messages: read for session players" ON messages;
 70: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Messages: players send" ON messages;
 71: 
 72: CREATE POLICY "Messages: read for session players" ON messages FOR SELECT TO authenticated
 73: USING (session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM public.get_user_session_ids(auth.uid())));
 74: 
 75: CREATE POLICY "Messages: players send" ON messages FOR INSERT TO authenticated
 76: WITH CHECK (
 77:   sender_type = 'player'
 78:   AND sender_id = auth.uid()
 79:   AND session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM public.get_user_session_ids(auth.uid()))
 80: );
 81: 
 82: -- ============================================
 83: -- ИСПРАВЛЕНИЕ ПОЛИТИК turn_queue
 84: -- ============================================
 85: 
 86: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Turn: read for session players" ON turn_queue;
 87: 
 88: CREATE POLICY "Turn: read for session players" ON turn_queue FOR SELECT TO authenticated
 89: USING (session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM public.get_user_session_ids(auth.uid())));
 90: 
 91: -- ============================================
 92: -- ДОБАВЛЕНИЕ ВОЗМОЖНОСТИ СОЗДАВАТЬ NPC ВРУЧНУЮ
 93: -- ============================================
 94: 
 95: -- Функция для создания NPC со всеми полями (вызывается из Edge Function или напрямую)
 96: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_npc(
 97:   p_world_id UUID,
 98:   p_name TEXT,
 99:   p_role TEXT DEFAULT 'secondary',
100:   p_race TEXT DEFAULT 'Человек',
101:   p_appearance TEXT DEFAULT '',
102:   p_background TEXT DEFAULT '',
103:   p_status_tags TEXT[] DEFAULT '{}',
104:   p_habits TEXT[] DEFAULT '{}',
105:   p_catchphrases TEXT[] DEFAULT '{}',
106:   p_stats JSONB DEFAULT '{"STR": 10, "DEX": 10, "CON": 10, "INT": 10, "WIS": 10, "CHA": 10}',
107:   p_hp INT DEFAULT 30,
108:   p_max_hp INT DEFAULT 30,
109:   p_location_id UUID DEFAULT NULL,
110:   p_state_id UUID DEFAULT NULL
111: )
112: RETURNS UUID
113: SECURITY DEFINER
114: SET search_path = public
115: AS $$
116: DECLARE
117:   new_npc_id UUID;
118: BEGIN
119:   -- Проверяем, что мир существует
120:   IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM worlds WHERE id = p_world_id) THEN
121:     RAISE EXCEPTION 'World with id % not found', p_world_id;
122:   END IF;
123: 
124:   new_npc_id := gen_random_uuid();
125: 
126:   INSERT INTO npcs (
127:     id, world_id, location_id, state_id, role, name, race,
128:     appearance, background, status_tags, habits, catchphrases,
129:     stats, hp, max_hp
130:   ) VALUES (
131:     new_npc_id, p_world_id, p_location_id, p_state_id, p_role, p_name, p_race,
132:     p_appearance, p_background, p_status_tags, p_habits, p_catchphrases,
133:     p_stats, p_hp, p_max_hp
134:   );
135: 
136:   RETURN new_npc_id;
137: END;
138: $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

File: supabase/migrations/010_user_settings_models.sql
================
 1: -- ============================================
 2: -- MultiRP AI — Migration 010: User Settings Models
 3: -- ============================================
 4: -- Добавляет поля card_model и dm_model в таблицу user_settings
 5: 
 6: -- Добавляем колонки для моделей
 7: ALTER TABLE user_settings
 8:   ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS card_model TEXT DEFAULT 'xiaomi/mimo-v2.5',
 9:   ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS dm_model TEXT DEFAULT 'xiaomi/mimo-v2.5';
10: 
11: -- Обновляем RPC функцию
12: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION upsert_user_settings(
13:   p_user_id UUID,
14:   p_openrouter_key TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
15:   p_card_model TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
16:   p_dm_model TEXT DEFAULT NULL
17: )
18: RETURNS VOID
19: LANGUAGE plpgsql
20: SECURITY DEFINER
21: AS $$
22: BEGIN
23:   INSERT INTO user_settings (id, openrouter_key, card_model, dm_model)
24:   VALUES (
25:     p_user_id,
26:     COALESCE(p_openrouter_key, ''),
27:     COALESCE(p_card_model, 'xiaomi/mimo-v2.5'),
28:     COALESCE(p_dm_model, 'xiaomi/mimo-v2.5')
29:   )
30:   ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
31:     openrouter_key = CASE WHEN p_openrouter_key IS NOT NULL THEN p_openrouter_key ELSE user_settings.openrouter_key END,
32:     card_model = CASE WHEN p_card_model IS NOT NULL THEN p_card_model ELSE user_settings.card_model END,
33:     dm_model = CASE WHEN p_dm_model IS NOT NULL THEN p_dm_model ELSE user_settings.dm_model END,
34:     updated_at = NOW();
35: END;
36: $$;
37: 
38: COMMENT ON COLUMN user_settings.card_model IS 'Модель для генерации карточек (бестиарий)';
39: COMMENT ON COLUMN user_settings.dm_model IS 'Модель для ДМа (рассказчик)';

File: supabase/migrations/015_add_npc_missing_fields.sql
================
 1: -- ============================================
 2: -- MultiRP AI — Migration 015: NPC Missing Fields
 3: -- Добавляет поля, которые используются в коде/экспорте но отсутствуют в БД
 4: -- ============================================
 5: 
 6: -- class: класс персонажа (воин/маг/жрец/etc), используется для определения hit_dice
 7: ALTER TABLE npcs
 8:   ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS class TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '';
 9: 
10: -- tier: потенциал существа (1-5), определяет количество спецатак
11: ALTER TABLE npcs
12:   ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS tier INT DEFAULT 1 CHECK (tier BETWEEN 1 AND 5);
13: 
14: -- is_unique: уникальный экспр (получает имя), для неуникальных — диапазон уровней
15: ALTER TABLE npcs
16:   ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_unique BOOLEAN DEFAULT false;
17: 
18: -- level_min: минимальный уровень при спавне (для неуникальных существ)
19: ALTER TABLE npcs
20:   ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS level_min INT DEFAULT 1 CHECK (level_min >= 1 AND level_min <= 100);
21: 
22: -- level_max: максимальный уровень при спавне (для неуникальных существ)
23: ALTER TABLE npcs
24:   ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS level_max INT DEFAULT 1 CHECK (level_max >= 1 AND level_max <= 100);
25: 
26: -- Ограничение: level_max >= level_min
27: ALTER TABLE npcs
28:   DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS npcs_valid_level_range,
29:   ADD CONSTRAINT npcs_valid_level_range CHECK (level_max >= level_min);
30: 
31: -- Индексы для быстрой фильтрации
32: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_npcs_class ON npcs(class);
33: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_npcs_tier ON npcs(tier);
34: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_npcs_is_unique ON npcs(is_unique);
35: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_npcs_level_min ON npcs(level_min);
36: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_npcs_level_max ON npcs(level_max);
37: 
38: -- Комментарии
39: COMMENT ON COLUMN npcs.class IS 'Класс персонажа (воин/маг/жрец/etc), используется для определения hit_dice';
40: COMMENT ON COLUMN npcs.tier IS 'Потенциал существа (1-5), определяет количество спецатак';
41: COMMENT ON COLUMN npcs.is_unique IS 'Уникальный экземпляр (получает имя), для неуникальных — диапазон уровней';
42: COMMENT ON COLUMN npcs.level_min IS 'Минимальный уровень при спавне (для неуникальных существ)';
43: COMMENT ON COLUMN npcs.level_max IS 'Максимальный уровень при спавне (для неуникальных существ)';

File: supabase/migrations/017_apply_turn_mutations.sql
================
  1: -- ============================================
  2: -- MultiRP AI — Migration 017: Atomic Turn Mutations
  3: -- ============================================
  4: -- Атомарная RPC apply_turn_mutations() для Шага 3
  5: -- Гарантирует ACID-транзакцию для всех мутаций хода (защита от race conditions)
  6: 
  7: -- ============================================
  8: -- Таблица структур локаций (для build_structure)
  9: -- ============================================
 10: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS location_structures (
 11:   id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 12:   location_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES locations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 13:   name TEXT NOT NULL,
 14:   type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'shelter',
 15:   hp INT DEFAULT 50 CHECK (hp >= 0),
 16:   max_hp INT DEFAULT 50 CHECK (max_hp >= 0),
 17:   created_by UUID REFERENCES players(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 18:   tags TEXT[] DEFAULT '{}',
 19:   created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
 20:   updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
 21: );
 22: 
 23: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_location_structures_location ON location_structures(location_id);
 24: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_location_structures_type ON location_structures(type);
 25: 
 26: COMMENT ON TABLE location_structures IS 'Структуры, построенные игроками (укрытия, мосты, ловушки)';
 27: COMMENT ON COLUMN location_structures.type IS 'Тип структуры: shelter, bridge, trap, decoration, etc.';
 28: 
 29: -- ============================================
 30: -- Патч колонок инвентаря: durability, condition, updated_at
 31: -- (необходимо для assess-durability и UPDATE_DURABILITY мутаций)
 32: -- ============================================
 33: ALTER TABLE inventory
 34:   ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS durability INT DEFAULT 100,
 35:   ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS condition TEXT DEFAULT 'good',
 36:   ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW();
 37: 
 38: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_inventory_durability ON inventory(durability);
 39: 
 40: COMMENT ON COLUMN inventory.durability IS 'Прочность предмета (0-100). 0 = сломан';
 41: COMMENT ON COLUMN inventory.condition IS 'Состояние: good, worn, damaged, broken';
 42: COMMENT ON COLUMN inventory.updated_at IS 'Время последнего изменения предмета';
 43: 
 44: -- ============================================
 45: -- RPC: apply_turn_mutations
 46: -- ============================================
 47: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION apply_turn_mutations(
 48:   p_mutations JSONB,
 49:   p_session_id UUID
 50: )
 51: RETURNS JSONB
 52: LANGUAGE plpgsql
 53: SECURITY DEFINER
 54: AS $$
 55: DECLARE
 56:   v_mutation JSONB;
 57:   v_mutation_type TEXT;
 58:   v_applied_count INT := 0;
 59:   v_current_time JSONB;
 60:   v_session_year INT;
 61:   v_session_month INT;
 62:   v_session_day INT;
 63:   v_session_hour INT;
 64:   v_session_minute INT;
 65:   v_total_minutes INT;
 66:   v_new_minute INT;
 67:   v_new_hour INT;
 68:   v_new_day INT;
 69:   v_new_month INT;
 70:   v_new_year INT;
 71: 
 72:   -- UPDATE_HP
 73:   v_target_type TEXT;
 74:   v_target_id UUID;
 75:   v_delta INT;
 76:   v_current_hp INT;
 77:   v_max_hp INT;
 78: 
 79:   -- UPDATE_DURABILITY
 80:   v_item_id UUID;
 81:   v_durability_delta INT;
 82:   v_set_broken BOOLEAN;
 83:   v_current_durability INT;
 84:   v_attrs JSONB;
 85:   v_item_name TEXT;
 86:   v_item_quantity INT;
 87: 
 88:   -- DELETE_ITEM
 89:   v_delete_qty INT;
 90: 
 91:   -- INSERT_ITEM
 92:   v_owner_id UUID;
 93:   v_owner_type TEXT;
 94:   v_item JSONB;
 95: 
 96:   -- TRANSFER_ITEM
 97:   v_from_id UUID;
 98:   v_to_id UUID;
 99:   v_from_type TEXT;
100:   v_to_type TEXT;
101:   v_transfer_qty INT;
102: 
103:   -- SPAWN_STRUCTURE
104:   v_location_id UUID;
105:   v_structure JSONB;
106: BEGIN
107:   -- ============================================
108:   -- Загружаем текущее время сессии (для ADVANCE_TIME)
109:   -- ============================================
110:   SELECT game_year, game_month, game_day, game_hour, game_minute
111:   INTO v_session_year, v_session_month, v_session_day, v_session_hour, v_session_minute
112:   FROM sessions
113:   WHERE id = p_session_id
114:   FOR UPDATE;
115: 
116:   IF NOT FOUND THEN
117:     RAISE EXCEPTION 'SESSION_NOT_FOUND: %', p_session_id
118:       USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
119:   END IF;
120: 
121:   v_new_year := v_session_year;
122:   v_new_month := v_session_month;
123:   v_new_day := v_session_day;
124:   v_new_hour := v_session_hour;
125:   v_new_minute := v_session_minute;
126: 
127:   -- ============================================
128:   -- Цикл по мутациям
129:   -- ============================================
130:   FOR v_mutation IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_mutations)
131:   LOOP
132:     v_mutation_type := v_mutation->>'type';
133: 
134:     CASE v_mutation_type
135:       WHEN 'UPDATE_HP' THEN
136:         v_target_type := v_mutation->>'target_type';
137:         v_target_id := (v_mutation->>'id')::UUID;
138:         v_delta := (v_mutation->>'delta')::INT;
139: 
140:         IF v_target_type = 'player' THEN
141:           SELECT hp, max_hp INTO v_current_hp, v_max_hp
142:           FROM players WHERE id = v_target_id FOR UPDATE;
143: 
144:           IF NOT FOUND THEN
145:             RAISE EXCEPTION 'TARGET_NOT_FOUND: player %', v_target_id
146:               USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
147:           END IF;
148: 
149:           UPDATE players
150:           SET hp = GREATEST(0, LEAST(max_hp, hp + v_delta)),
151:               updated_at = NOW()
152:           WHERE id = v_target_id;
153: 
154:           v_applied_count := v_applied_count + 1;
155: 
156:         ELSIF v_target_type = 'npc' THEN
157:           SELECT hp, max_hp INTO v_current_hp, v_max_hp
158:           FROM npcs WHERE id = v_target_id FOR UPDATE;
159: 
160:           IF NOT FOUND THEN
161:             RAISE EXCEPTION 'TARGET_NOT_FOUND: npc %', v_target_id
162:               USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
163:           END IF;
164: 
165:           UPDATE npcs
166:           SET hp = GREATEST(0, LEAST(max_hp, hp + v_delta)),
167:               updated_at = NOW()
168:           WHERE id = v_target_id;
169: 
170:           v_applied_count := v_applied_count + 1;
171:         ELSE
172:           RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_TARGET_TYPE: %', v_target_type
173:             USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
174:         END IF;
175: 
176:       WHEN 'UPDATE_DURABILITY' THEN
177:         v_item_id := (v_mutation->>'item_id')::UUID;
178:         v_durability_delta := (v_mutation->>'delta')::INT;
179:         v_set_broken := COALESCE((v_mutation->>'set_broken')::BOOLEAN, FALSE);
180: 
181:         SELECT item_name, attributes, durability
182:         INTO v_item_name, v_attrs, v_current_durability
183:         FROM inventory WHERE id = v_item_id FOR UPDATE;
184: 
185:         IF NOT FOUND THEN
186:           RAISE EXCEPTION 'ITEM_NOT_FOUND: %', v_item_id
187:             USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
188:         END IF;
189: 
190:         -- Обновляем durability в attributes JSONB
191:         v_attrs := COALESCE(v_attrs, '{}'::JSONB);
192:         v_attrs := v_attrs || jsonb_build_object(
193:           'durability', GREATEST(0, LEAST(100, COALESCE((v_attrs->>'durability')::INT, 100) + v_durability_delta))
194:         );
195: 
196:         IF v_set_broken OR (v_attrs->>'durability')::INT = 0 THEN
197:           v_attrs := v_attrs || jsonb_build_object('condition', 'broken');
198:         END IF;
199: 
200:         UPDATE inventory
201:         SET attributes = v_attrs,
202:             durability = COALESCE((v_attrs->>'durability')::INT, durability),
203:             updated_at = NOW()
204:         WHERE id = v_item_id;
205: 
206:         v_applied_count := v_applied_count + 1;
207: 
208:       WHEN 'DELETE_ITEM' THEN
209:         v_item_id := (v_mutation->>'item_id')::UUID;
210:         v_delete_qty := COALESCE((v_mutation->>'quantity')::INT, 1);
211: 
212:         SELECT item_name, quantity
213:         INTO v_item_name, v_item_quantity
214:         FROM inventory WHERE id = v_item_id FOR UPDATE;
215: 
216:         IF NOT FOUND THEN
217:           RAISE EXCEPTION 'ITEM_NOT_AVAILABLE: %', v_item_id
218:             USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
219:         END IF;
220: 
221:         IF v_item_quantity < v_delete_qty THEN
222:           RAISE EXCEPTION 'ITEM_NOT_AVAILABLE: % (have %, need %)',
223:             v_item_id, v_item_quantity, v_delete_qty
224:             USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
225:         END IF;
226: 
227:         IF v_item_quantity = v_delete_qty THEN
228:           DELETE FROM inventory WHERE id = v_item_id;
229:         ELSE
230:           UPDATE inventory
231:           SET quantity = quantity - v_delete_qty,
232:               updated_at = NOW()
233:           WHERE id = v_item_id;
234:         END IF;
235: 
236:         v_applied_count := v_applied_count + 1;
237: 
238:       WHEN 'INSERT_ITEM' THEN
239:         v_owner_id := (v_mutation->>'owner_id')::UUID;
240:         v_owner_type := v_mutation->>'owner_type';
241:         v_item := v_mutation->'item';
242: 
243:         IF v_owner_type = 'player' THEN
244:           -- Используем существующий add_item_to_inventory
245:           PERFORM add_item_to_inventory(
246:             p_player_id := v_owner_id,
247:             p_item_name := v_item->>'item_name',
248:             p_quantity := COALESCE((v_item->>'quantity')::INT, 1),
249:             p_type := COALESCE(v_item->>'type', 'misc'),
250:             p_attributes := COALESCE(v_item->'attributes', '{}'::JSONB)
251:           );
252:         ELSIF v_owner_type = 'npc' THEN
253:           PERFORM add_item_to_inventory(
254:             p_npc_id := v_owner_id,
255:             p_item_name := v_item->>'item_name',
256:             p_quantity := COALESCE((v_item->>'quantity')::INT, 1),
257:             p_type := COALESCE(v_item->>'type', 'misc'),
258:             p_attributes := COALESCE(v_item->'attributes', '{}'::JSONB)
259:           );
260:         ELSE
261:           RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_OWNER_TYPE: %', v_owner_type
262:             USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
263:         END IF;
264: 
265:         v_applied_count := v_applied_count + 1;
266: 
267:       WHEN 'TRANSFER_ITEM' THEN
268:         v_item_id := (v_mutation->>'item_id')::UUID;
269:         v_from_id := (v_mutation->>'from_id')::UUID;
270:         v_to_id := (v_mutation->>'to_id')::UUID;
271:         v_from_type := v_mutation->>'from_type';
272:         v_to_type := v_mutation->>'to_type';
273:         v_transfer_qty := COALESCE((v_mutation->>'quantity')::INT, 1);
274: 
275:         -- Списываем у from (с блокировкой)
276:         SELECT item_name, quantity
277:         INTO v_item_name, v_item_quantity
278:         FROM inventory
279:         WHERE id = v_item_id
280:           AND (
281:             (v_from_type = 'player' AND player_id = v_from_id)
282:             OR (v_from_type = 'npc' AND npc_id = v_from_id)
283:           )
284:         FOR UPDATE;
285: 
286:         IF NOT FOUND THEN
287:           RAISE EXCEPTION 'ITEM_NOT_AVAILABLE_FOR_TRANSFER: %', v_item_id
288:             USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
289:         END IF;
290: 
291:         IF v_item_quantity < v_transfer_qty THEN
292:           RAISE EXCEPTION 'ITEM_NOT_AVAILABLE_FOR_TRANSFER: % (have %, need %)',
293:             v_item_id, v_item_quantity, v_transfer_qty
294:             USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
295:         END IF;
296: 
297:         -- Списываем
298:         IF v_item_quantity = v_transfer_qty THEN
299:           DELETE FROM inventory WHERE id = v_item_id;
300:         ELSE
301:           UPDATE inventory SET quantity = quantity - v_transfer_qty WHERE id = v_item_id;
302:         END IF;
303: 
304:         -- Начисляем получателю
305:         IF v_to_type = 'player' THEN
306:           PERFORM add_item_to_inventory(
307:             p_player_id := v_to_id,
308:             p_item_name := v_item_name,
309:             p_quantity := v_transfer_qty,
310:             p_type := 'misc',
311:             p_attributes := jsonb_build_object('transferred', true)
312:           );
313:         ELSIF v_to_type = 'npc' THEN
314:           PERFORM add_item_to_inventory(
315:             p_npc_id := v_to_id,
316:             p_item_name := v_item_name,
317:             p_quantity := v_transfer_qty,
318:             p_type := 'misc',
319:             p_attributes := jsonb_build_object('transferred', true)
320:           );
321:         END IF;
322: 
323:         v_applied_count := v_applied_count + 1;
324: 
325:       WHEN 'SPAWN_STRUCTURE' THEN
326:         v_location_id := (v_mutation->>'location_id')::UUID;
327:         v_structure := v_mutation->'structure';
328: 
329:         INSERT INTO location_structures (location_id, name, type, hp, max_hp, tags)
330:         VALUES (
331:           v_location_id,
332:           COALESCE(v_structure->>'name', 'Структура'),
333:           COALESCE(v_structure->>'type', 'shelter'),
334:           COALESCE((v_structure->>'hp')::INT, 50),
335:           COALESCE((v_structure->>'max_hp')::INT, 50),
336:           COALESCE(
337:             ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(v_structure->'tags')),
338:             ARRAY[]::TEXT[]
339:           )
340:         );
341: 
342:         v_applied_count := v_applied_count + 1;
343: 
344:       WHEN 'ADVANCE_TIME' THEN
345:         v_total_minutes := (v_mutation->>'minutes')::INT;
346:         v_total_minutes := v_total_minutes + (v_new_hour * 60) + v_new_minute;
347: 
348:         -- Минуты и часы (0..59, 0..23)
349:         v_new_minute := v_total_minutes % 60;
350:         v_new_hour := (v_total_minutes / 60) % 24;
351: 
352:         -- Дни, месяцы и годы (1-based: дни 1..30, месяцы 1..12)
353:         -- Переводим в 0-based, делим/модулируем, возвращаем в 1-based
354:         v_new_day := (v_session_day - 1) + (v_total_minutes / 1440);
355:         v_new_month := (v_session_month - 1) + (v_new_day / 30);
356:         v_new_day := (v_new_day % 30) + 1;
357: 
358:         v_new_year := v_session_year + (v_new_month / 12);
359:         v_new_month := (v_new_month % 12) + 1;
360: 
361:         v_applied_count := v_applied_count + 1;
362: 
363:       ELSE
364:         RAISE EXCEPTION 'UNKNOWN_MUTATION_TYPE: %', v_mutation_type
365:           USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
366:     END CASE;
367:   END LOOP;
368: 
369:   -- ============================================
370:   -- Финальное обновление времени
371:   -- ============================================
372:   UPDATE sessions
373:   SET game_year = v_new_year,
374:       game_month = v_new_month,
375:       game_day = v_new_day,
376:       game_hour = v_new_hour,
377:       game_minute = v_new_minute,
378:       updated_at = NOW()
379:   WHERE id = p_session_id;
380: 
381:   v_current_time := jsonb_build_object(
382:     'year', v_new_year,
383:     'month', v_new_month,
384:     'day', v_new_day,
385:     'hour', v_new_hour,
386:     'minute', v_new_minute
387:   );
388: 
389:   RETURN jsonb_build_object(
390:     'success', TRUE,
391:     'applied_count', v_applied_count,
392:     'new_time', v_current_time
393:   );
394: 
395: EXCEPTION
396:   WHEN OTHERS THEN
397:     -- Возвращаем ошибку (откат неявный)
398:     RETURN jsonb_build_object(
399:       'success', FALSE,
400:       'error_code', 'RACE_CONDITION_CONFLICT',
401:       'details', SQLERRM,
402:       'sql_state', SQLSTATE
403:     );
404: END;
405: $$;
406: 
407: COMMENT ON FUNCTION apply_turn_mutations IS
408:   'Атомарное применение мутаций хода. Возвращает {success, applied_count, new_time} или {success:false, error_code, details} при ошибке.';

 1: -- ============================================
 2: -- MultiRP AI — Migration 018: NPC Relationships & Tiered Memories
 3: -- Шкала отношений NPC (-100..+100), 3 уровня воспоминаний и оценка яркости
 4: -- ============================================
 5: 
 6: -- 1. Создание таблицы персональных отношений NPC с игроками
 7: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS npc_relationships (
 8:   id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 9:   npc_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES npcs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
10:   player_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES players(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
11:   score INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (score BETWEEN -100 AND 100),
12:   tier TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'neutral' CHECK (tier IN (
13:     'sworn_enemy', -- -100..-70: Заклятый враг
14:     'hostile',     -- -69..-35:  Враждебность
15:     'unfriendly',  -- -34..-10:  Неприязнь / Настороженность
16:     'neutral',     -- -9..+15:   Нейтралитет / Равнодушие
17:     'friendly',    -- +16..+50:  Симпатия / Знакомый
18:     'trusted',     -- +51..+80:  Доверие / Уважение
19:     'devoted'      -- +81..+100: Преданность / Любовь
20:   )),
21:   status_tags TEXT[] DEFAULT '{}',
22:   interactions_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
23:   last_interaction_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
24:   created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
25:   updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
26:   UNIQUE(npc_id, player_id)
27: );
28: 
29: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_npc_relationships_npc ON npc_relationships(npc_id);
30: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_npc_relationships_player ON npc_relationships(player_id);
31: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_npc_relationships_score ON npc_relationships(score);
32: 
33: -- 2. Обновление таблицы npc_memories: добавление яркости и расширение типов
34: ALTER TABLE npc_memories
35:   ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS vividness INT DEFAULT 5 CHECK (vividness BETWEEN 1 AND 10),
36:   ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS emotional_tone TEXT DEFAULT 'neutral',
37:   ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS significance_reason TEXT DEFAULT '';
38: 
39: -- Расширяем check constraint для memory_type: impression, regular, vivid, belief (и medium для обратной совместимости)
40: ALTER TABLE npc_memories
41:   DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS npc_memories_memory_type_check;
42: 
43: ALTER TABLE npc_memories
44:   ADD CONSTRAINT npc_memories_memory_type_check
45:   CHECK (memory_type IN ('impression', 'regular', 'vivid', 'belief', 'medium'));
46: 
47: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_npc_memories_vividness ON npc_memories(vividness);
48: 
49: -- 3. RLS политики
50: ALTER TABLE npc_relationships ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
51: 
52: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Relationships: read for authenticated" ON npc_relationships;
53: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Relationships: system manage" ON npc_relationships;
54: 
55: CREATE POLICY "Relationships: read for authenticated" ON npc_relationships FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
56: CREATE POLICY "Relationships: system manage" ON npc_relationships FOR ALL USING (true);
57: 
58: -- 4. Realtime публикация
59: DO $$
60: BEGIN
61:   IF NOT EXISTS (
62:     SELECT 1 FROM pg_publication_tables 
63:     WHERE pubname = 'supabase_realtime' AND tablename = 'npc_relationships'
64:   ) THEN
65:     ALTER PUBLICATION supabase_realtime ADD TABLE npc_relationships;
66:   END IF;
67: END $$;

File: supabase/migrations/020_skills_leveling_and_npc_combat.sql
================
  1: -- Migration 020: Player Skills, Leveling (No 20 Cap, Stat Points, MP), NPC Autonomous Activities & Combat Turn Queue
  2: 
  3: -- =====================================================
  4: -- 1. PLAYER SKILLS TABLE (Только для игроков, 1..100)
  5: -- =====================================================
  6: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS player_skills (
  7:   id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  8:   player_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES players(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  9:   skill_key TEXT NOT NULL, -- e.g. "swordsmanship", "gathering", "archery", "leatherworking", "stealth"
 10:   name TEXT NOT NULL, -- "Владение мечом", "Собирательство"
 11:   level INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (level >= 1 AND level <= 100),
 12:   xp INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 13:   xp_to_next_level INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 100,
 14:   description TEXT DEFAULT '',
 15:   effects JSONB DEFAULT '{}', -- e.g. {"damage_bonus_pct": 10, "find_chance_bonus_pct": 15, "time_reduction_pct": 20}
 16:   created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
 17:   updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
 18:   UNIQUE(player_id, skill_key)
 19: );
 20: 
 21: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_player_skills_player ON player_skills(player_id);
 22: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_player_skills_key ON player_skills(skill_key);
 23: 
 24: ALTER TABLE player_skills ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
 25: CREATE POLICY "Player skills: read for session players" ON player_skills
 26:   FOR SELECT TO authenticated
 27:   USING (player_id IN (SELECT id FROM players WHERE session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM players WHERE user_id = auth.uid())));
 28: CREATE POLICY "Player skills: system manage" ON player_skills
 29:   FOR ALL USING (true);
 30: 
 31: ALTER PUBLICATION supabase_realtime ADD TABLE player_skills;
 32: 
 33: -- =====================================================
 34: -- 2. EXPAND PLAYERS: XP, Stat Points (ОХ), MP
 35: -- =====================================================
 36: ALTER TABLE players

 43: COMMENT ON COLUMN players.mp IS 'Текущие очки маны';
 44: COMMENT ON COLUMN players.max_mp IS 'Максимальные очки маны';

 73: 
 74: -- =====================================================
 75: -- 5. RPC: ALLOCATE STAT POINTS (Без ограничения в 20!)
 76: -- =====================================================
 77: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION allocate_stat_points(
 78:   p_player_id UUID,
 79:   p_stat_name TEXT,
 80:   p_points INT DEFAULT 1
 81: ) RETURNS JSONB AS $$
 82: DECLARE
 83:   v_player RECORD;
 84:   v_stats JSONB;
 85:   v_cur_val INT;
 86:   v_new_val INT;
 87:   v_new_max_hp INT;
 88:   v_new_max_mp INT;
 89:   v_con_mod INT;
 90: BEGIN
 91:   IF p_points <= 0 THEN
 92:     RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Количество очков должно быть больше нуля');
 93:   END IF;
 94: 
 95:   p_stat_name := UPPER(TRIM(p_stat_name));
 96:   IF p_stat_name NOT IN ('STR', 'DEX', 'CON', 'INT', 'WIS', 'CHA') THEN
 97:     RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Недопустимая характеристика: ' || p_stat_name);
 98:   END IF;
 99: 
100:   SELECT * INTO v_player FROM players WHERE id = p_player_id FOR UPDATE;
101:   IF NOT FOUND THEN
102:     RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Игрок не найден');
103:   END IF;
104: 
105:   IF COALESCE(v_player.stat_points, 0) < p_points THEN
106:     RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Недостаточно очков характеристик');
107:   END IF;
108: 
109:   v_stats := COALESCE(v_player.stats, '{"STR": 10, "DEX": 10, "CON": 10, "INT": 10, "WIS": 10, "CHA": 10}'::jsonb);
110:   v_cur_val := COALESCE((v_stats->>p_stat_name)::INT, 10);
111:   v_new_val := v_cur_val + p_points; -- БЕЗ ограничения в 20!
112: 
113:   v_stats := jsonb_set(v_stats, ARRAY[p_stat_name], to_jsonb(v_new_val));
114: 
115:   -- Пересчет Max HP при изменении CON
116:   v_new_max_hp := v_player.max_hp;
117:   IF p_stat_name = 'CON' THEN
118:     v_con_mod := FLOOR((v_new_val - 10) / 2.0)::INT;
119:     v_new_max_hp := GREATEST(10, v_new_val * 2 + (COALESCE(v_player.level, 1) * GREATEST(1, v_con_mod + 5)));
120:   END IF;
121: 
122:   -- Пересчет Max MP при изменении INT
123:   v_new_max_mp := COALESCE(v_player.max_mp, 50);
124:   IF p_stat_name = 'INT' THEN
125:     v_new_max_mp := GREATEST(20, v_new_val * 2 + (COALESCE(v_player.level, 1) * 5));
126:   END IF;
127: 
128:   UPDATE players
129:   SET
130:     stats = v_stats,
131:     stat_points = v_player.stat_points - p_points,
132:     max_hp = v_new_max_hp,
133:     hp = LEAST(v_player.hp + (v_new_max_hp - v_player.max_hp), v_new_max_hp),
134:     max_mp = v_new_max_mp,
135:     mp = LEAST(COALESCE(v_player.mp, 50) + (v_new_max_mp - COALESCE(v_player.max_mp, 50)), v_new_max_mp),
136:     updated_at = NOW()
137:   WHERE id = p_player_id;
138: 
139:   RETURN jsonb_build_object(
140:     'success', true,
141:     'stat_name', p_stat_name,
142:     'old_value', v_cur_val,
143:     'new_value', v_new_val,
144:     'remaining_stat_points', v_player.stat_points - p_points,
145:     'max_hp', v_new_max_hp,
146:     'max_mp', v_new_max_mp
147:   );
148: END;
149: $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;
150: 
151: -- =====================================================
152: -- 6. RPC: ADD PLAYER SKILL XP (1..100 с авто-левелапом)
153: -- =====================================================
154: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION add_player_skill_xp(
155:   p_player_id UUID,
156:   p_skill_key TEXT,
157:   p_skill_name TEXT,
158:   p_xp_amount INT
159: ) RETURNS JSONB AS $$
160: DECLARE
161:   v_skill RECORD;
162:   v_cur_lvl INT;
163:   v_cur_xp INT;
164:   v_next_xp INT;
165:   v_new_lvl INT;
166:   v_new_xp INT;
167:   v_leveled_up BOOLEAN := false;
168:   v_effects JSONB;
169: BEGIN
170:   p_skill_key := LOWER(TRIM(p_skill_key));
171:   IF p_xp_amount <= 0 THEN
172:     RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Количество опыта должно быть больше нуля');
173:   END IF;
174: 
175:   SELECT * INTO v_skill FROM player_skills
176:   WHERE player_id = p_player_id AND skill_key = p_skill_key
177:   FOR UPDATE;
178: 
179:   IF NOT FOUND THEN
180:     -- Создаём начальный навык на уровне 1
181:     v_cur_lvl := 1;
182:     v_cur_xp := 0;
183:     v_next_xp := 100;
184:   ELSE
185:     v_cur_lvl := v_skill.level;
186:     v_cur_xp := v_skill.xp;
187:     v_next_xp := v_skill.xp_to_next_level;
188:   END IF;
189: 
190:   -- На максимальном 100 уровне опыт не копится
191:   IF v_cur_lvl >= 100 THEN
192:     RETURN jsonb_build_object(
193:       'success', true,
194:       'skill_key', p_skill_key,
195:       'level', 100,
196:       'xp', v_next_xp,
197:       'leveled_up', false,
198:       'is_max', true
199:     );
200:   END IF;
201: 
202:   v_new_lvl := v_cur_lvl;
203:   v_new_xp := v_cur_xp + p_xp_amount;
204: 
205:   WHILE v_new_xp >= v_next_xp AND v_new_lvl < 100 LOOP
206:     v_new_xp := v_new_xp - v_next_xp;
207:     v_new_lvl := v_new_lvl + 1;
208:     v_next_xp := v_new_lvl * 100;
209:     v_leveled_up := true;
210:   END LOOP;
211: 
212:   -- Расчёт базовых числовых эффектов от уровня (1..100)
213:   v_effects := jsonb_build_object(
214:     'bonus_pct', v_new_lvl,
215:     'accuracy_bonus', FLOOR(v_new_lvl / 10)::INT,
216:     'time_reduction_pct', LEAST(50, FLOOR(v_new_lvl * 0.5)::INT)
217:   );
218: 
219:   INSERT INTO player_skills (player_id, skill_key, name, level, xp, xp_to_next_level, effects, updated_at)
220:   VALUES (p_player_id, p_skill_key, p_skill_name, v_new_lvl, v_new_xp, v_next_xp, v_effects, NOW())
221:   ON CONFLICT (player_id, skill_key) DO UPDATE
222:   SET
223:     level = v_new_lvl,
224:     xp = v_new_xp,
225:     xp_to_next_level = v_next_xp,
226:     effects = v_effects,
227:     updated_at = NOW();
228: 
229:   RETURN jsonb_build_object(
230:     'success', true,
231:     'skill_key', p_skill_key,
232:     'name', p_skill_name,
233:     'old_level', v_cur_lvl,
234:     'level', v_new_lvl,
235:     'xp', v_new_xp,
236:     'xp_to_next_level', v_next_xp,
237:     'leveled_up', v_leveled_up,
238:     'effects', v_effects
239:   );
240: END;
241: $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;

13: -- Auto-sync is_alive when hp changes
14: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sync_npc_is_alive()
15: RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
16: BEGIN
17:   IF NEW.hp IS NOT NULL AND NEW.hp <= 0 THEN
18:     NEW.is_alive := false;
19:   ELSIF NEW.hp IS NOT NULL AND NEW.hp > 0 THEN
20:     NEW.is_alive := true;
21:   END IF;
22:   RETURN NEW;
23: END;
24: $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
25:

28:   BEFORE UPDATE OF hp ON npcs

  1: -- Migration 023: Fix inventory RPCs overload ambiguity and add npcs.is_hostile

  5: -- 2. Drop ambiguous legacy functions

  7: DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS remove_item_from_inventory(UUID, TEXT, INT);
  8: 
  9: -- 3. Re-create single authoritative add_item_to_inventory
 10: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION add_item_to_inventory(
 11:   p_player_id UUID DEFAULT NULL,
 12:   p_item_name TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
 13:   p_quantity INT DEFAULT 1,
 14:   p_type TEXT DEFAULT 'misc',
 15:   p_attributes JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
 16:   p_npc_id UUID DEFAULT NULL
 17: )
 18: RETURNS UUID LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
 19: DECLARE
 20:   existing_item_id UUID;
 21:   new_id UUID;
 22: BEGIN
 23:   SELECT id INTO existing_item_id
 24:   FROM inventory
 25:   WHERE (
 26:     (p_player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id = p_player_id)
 27:     OR (p_npc_id IS NOT NULL AND npc_id = p_npc_id)
 28:   )
 29:   AND item_name = p_item_name
 30:   AND type = p_type
 31:   FOR UPDATE;
 32: 
 33:   IF existing_item_id IS NOT NULL THEN
 34:     UPDATE inventory
 35:     SET quantity = quantity + p_quantity,
 36:         attributes = COALESCE(p_attributes, attributes)
 37:     WHERE id = existing_item_id;
 38:     RETURN existing_item_id;
 39:   ELSE
 40:     new_id := gen_random_uuid();
 41:     INSERT INTO inventory (id, player_id, npc_id, item_name, quantity, type, attributes)
 42:     VALUES (new_id, p_player_id, p_npc_id, p_item_name, p_quantity, p_type, COALESCE(p_attributes, '{}'::jsonb));
 43:     RETURN new_id;
 44:   END IF;
 45: END;
 46: $$;
 47: 
 48: GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION add_item_to_inventory(UUID, TEXT, INT, TEXT, JSONB, UUID) TO authenticated, anon, service_role;

 50: -- 4. Re-create single authoritative remove_item_from_inventory
 51: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION remove_item_from_inventory(
 52:   p_player_id UUID DEFAULT NULL,
 53:   p_item_name TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
 54:   p_quantity INT DEFAULT 1,
 55:   p_npc_id UUID DEFAULT NULL
 56: )
 57: RETURNS BOOLEAN LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
 58: DECLARE
 59:   existing_item RECORD;
 60: BEGIN
 61:   SELECT id, quantity INTO existing_item
 62:   FROM inventory
 63:   WHERE (
 64:     (p_player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id = p_player_id)
 65:     OR (p_npc_id IS NOT NULL AND npc_id = p_npc_id)
 66:   )
 67:   AND item_name = p_item_name
 68:   FOR UPDATE;
 69: 
 70:   IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN FALSE; END IF;
 71:   IF existing_item.quantity <= p_quantity THEN
 72:     DELETE FROM inventory WHERE id = existing_item.id;
 73:   ELSE
 74:     UPDATE inventory SET quantity = quantity - p_quantity WHERE id = existing_item.id;
 75:   END IF;
 76:   RETURN TRUE;
 77: END;
 78: $$;
 79: 
 80: GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION remove_item_from_inventory(UUID, TEXT, INT, UUID) TO authenticated, anon, service_role;

 82: -- 5. Update apply_turn_mutations with unambiguous RPC calls
 83: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION apply_turn_mutations(
 84:   p_mutations JSONB,
 85:   p_session_id UUID
 86: )
 87: RETURNS JSONB
 88: LANGUAGE plpgsql
 89: SECURITY DEFINER
 90: AS $$
 91: DECLARE
 92:   v_mutation JSONB;
 93:   v_mutation_type TEXT;
 94:   v_applied_count INT := 0;
 95:   v_current_time JSONB;
 96:   v_session_year INT;
 97:   v_session_month INT;
 98:   v_session_day INT;
 99:   v_session_hour INT;
100:   v_session_minute INT;
101:   v_total_minutes INT;
102:   v_new_minute INT;
103:   v_new_hour INT;
104:   v_new_day INT;
105:   v_new_month INT;
106:   v_new_year INT;
107: 
108:   -- UPDATE_HP
109:   v_target_type TEXT;
110:   v_target_id UUID;
111:   v_delta INT;
112:   v_current_hp INT;
113:   v_max_hp INT;
114: 
115:   -- UPDATE_DURABILITY
116:   v_item_id UUID;
117:   v_durability_delta INT;
118:   v_set_broken BOOLEAN;
119:   v_current_durability INT;
120:   v_attrs JSONB;
121:   v_item_name TEXT;
122:   v_item_quantity INT;
123: 
124:   -- DELETE_ITEM
125:   v_delete_qty INT;
126: 
127:   -- INSERT_ITEM
128:   v_owner_id UUID;
129:   v_owner_type TEXT;
130:   v_item JSONB;
131: 
132:   -- TRANSFER_ITEM
133:   v_from_id UUID;
134:   v_to_id UUID;
135:   v_from_type TEXT;
136:   v_to_type TEXT;
137:   v_transfer_qty INT;
138: 
139:   -- SPAWN_STRUCTURE
140:   v_location_id UUID;
141:   v_structure JSONB;
142: BEGIN
143:   -- Загружаем текущее время сессии
144:   SELECT game_year, game_month, game_day, game_hour, game_minute
145:   INTO v_session_year, v_session_month, v_session_day, v_session_hour, v_session_minute
146:   FROM sessions
147:   WHERE id = p_session_id
148:   FOR UPDATE;
149: 
150:   IF NOT FOUND THEN
151:     RAISE EXCEPTION 'SESSION_NOT_FOUND: %', p_session_id
152:       USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
153:   END IF;
154: 
155:   FOR v_mutation IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_mutations)
156:   LOOP
157:     v_mutation_type := v_mutation->>'type';
158: 
159:     CASE v_mutation_type
160:       WHEN 'UPDATE_HP' THEN
161:         v_target_type := v_mutation->>'target_type';
162:         v_target_id := (v_mutation->>'target_id')::UUID;
163:         v_delta := (v_mutation->>'delta')::INT;
164: 
165:         IF v_target_type = 'player' THEN
166:           SELECT hp, max_hp INTO v_current_hp, v_max_hp
167:           FROM players WHERE id = v_target_id FOR UPDATE;
168: 
169:           IF NOT FOUND THEN
170:             RAISE EXCEPTION 'TARGET_NOT_FOUND: player %', v_target_id USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
171:           END IF;
172: 
173:           UPDATE players
174:           SET hp = GREATEST(0, LEAST(v_max_hp, v_current_hp + v_delta)), updated_at = NOW()
175:           WHERE id = v_target_id;
176: 
177:         ELSIF v_target_type = 'npc' THEN
178:           SELECT hp, max_hp INTO v_current_hp, v_max_hp
179:           FROM npcs WHERE id = v_target_id FOR UPDATE;
180: 
181:           IF NOT FOUND THEN
182:             RAISE EXCEPTION 'TARGET_NOT_FOUND: npc %', v_target_id USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
183:           END IF;
184: 
185:           UPDATE npcs
186:           SET hp = GREATEST(0, LEAST(v_max_hp, v_current_hp + v_delta)),
187:               is_alive = (GREATEST(0, LEAST(v_max_hp, v_current_hp + v_delta)) > 0),
188:               updated_at = NOW()
189:           WHERE id = v_target_id;
190:         ELSE
191:           RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_TARGET_TYPE: %', v_target_type USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
192:         END IF;
193: 
194:         v_applied_count := v_applied_count + 1;
195: 
196:       WHEN 'UPDATE_DURABILITY' THEN
197:         v_item_id := (v_mutation->>'item_id')::UUID;
198:         v_durability_delta := (v_mutation->>'delta')::INT;
199:         v_set_broken := COALESCE((v_mutation->>'set_broken')::BOOLEAN, false);
200: 
201:         SELECT attributes INTO v_attrs
202:         FROM inventory WHERE id = v_item_id FOR UPDATE;
203: 
204:         IF NOT FOUND THEN
205:           RAISE EXCEPTION 'ITEM_NOT_FOUND: %', v_item_id USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
206:         END IF;
207: 
208:         v_current_durability := COALESCE((v_attrs->>'durability')::INT, 100);
209:         v_current_durability := GREATEST(0, v_current_durability + v_durability_delta);
210:         v_attrs := jsonb_set(v_attrs, '{durability}', to_jsonb(v_current_durability));
211: 
212:         IF v_set_broken OR v_current_durability = 0 THEN
213:           v_attrs := jsonb_set(v_attrs, '{is_broken}', 'true'::JSONB);
214:         END IF;
215: 
216:         UPDATE inventory SET attributes = v_attrs WHERE id = v_item_id;
217:         v_applied_count := v_applied_count + 1;
218: 
219:       WHEN 'DELETE_ITEM' THEN
220:         v_item_id := (v_mutation->>'item_id')::UUID;
221:         v_delete_qty := COALESCE((v_mutation->>'quantity')::INT, 1);
222: 
223:         SELECT quantity INTO v_item_quantity
224:         FROM inventory WHERE id = v_item_id FOR UPDATE;
225: 
226:         IF NOT FOUND THEN
227:           RAISE EXCEPTION 'ITEM_NOT_FOUND: %', v_item_id USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
228:         END IF;
229: 
230:         IF v_item_quantity < v_delete_qty THEN
231:           RAISE EXCEPTION 'ITEM_NOT_AVAILABLE: % (have %, need %)', v_item_id, v_item_quantity, v_delete_qty USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
232:         END IF;
233: 
234:         IF v_item_quantity = v_delete_qty THEN
235:           DELETE FROM inventory WHERE id = v_item_id;
236:         ELSE
237:           UPDATE inventory SET quantity = quantity - v_delete_qty WHERE id = v_item_id;
238:         END IF;
239: 
240:         v_applied_count := v_applied_count + 1;
241: 
242:       WHEN 'INSERT_ITEM' THEN
243:         v_owner_id := (v_mutation->>'owner_id')::UUID;
244:         v_owner_type := v_mutation->>'owner_type';
245:         v_item := v_mutation->'item';
246: 
247:         IF v_owner_type = 'player' THEN
248:           PERFORM add_item_to_inventory(
249:             p_player_id := v_owner_id,
250:             p_item_name := (v_item->>'item_name')::TEXT,
251:             p_quantity := COALESCE((v_item->>'quantity')::INT, 1),
252:             p_type := COALESCE((v_item->>'type')::TEXT, 'misc'),
253:             p_attributes := COALESCE(v_item->'attributes', '{}'::JSONB),
254:             p_npc_id := NULL::UUID
255:           );
256:         ELSIF v_owner_type = 'npc' THEN
257:           PERFORM add_item_to_inventory(
258:             p_player_id := NULL::UUID,
259:             p_item_name := (v_item->>'item_name')::TEXT,
260:             p_quantity := COALESCE((v_item->>'quantity')::INT, 1),
261:             p_type := COALESCE((v_item->>'type')::TEXT, 'misc'),
262:             p_attributes := COALESCE(v_item->'attributes', '{}'::JSONB),
263:             p_npc_id := v_owner_id
264:           );
265:         ELSE
266:           RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_OWNER_TYPE: %', v_owner_type USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
267:         END IF;
268: 
269:         v_applied_count := v_applied_count + 1;
270: 
271:       WHEN 'TRANSFER_ITEM' THEN
272:         v_item_id := (v_mutation->>'item_id')::UUID;
273:         v_from_id := (v_mutation->>'from_id')::UUID;
274:         v_to_id := (v_mutation->>'to_id')::UUID;
275:         v_from_type := v_mutation->>'from_type';
276:         v_to_type := v_mutation->>'to_type';
277:         v_transfer_qty := COALESCE((v_mutation->>'quantity')::INT, 1);
278: 
279:         SELECT item_name, quantity
280:         INTO v_item_name, v_item_quantity
281:         FROM inventory
282:         WHERE id = v_item_id
283:           AND (
284:             (v_from_type = 'player' AND player_id = v_from_id)
285:             OR (v_from_type = 'npc' AND npc_id = v_from_id)
286:           )
287:         FOR UPDATE;
288: 
289:         IF NOT FOUND THEN
290:           RAISE EXCEPTION 'ITEM_NOT_AVAILABLE_FOR_TRANSFER: %', v_item_id USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
291:         END IF;
292: 
293:         IF v_item_quantity < v_transfer_qty THEN
294:           RAISE EXCEPTION 'ITEM_NOT_AVAILABLE_FOR_TRANSFER: % (have %, need %)', v_item_id, v_item_quantity, v_transfer_qty USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
295:         END IF;
296: 
297:         IF v_item_quantity = v_transfer_qty THEN
298:           DELETE FROM inventory WHERE id = v_item_id;
299:         ELSE
300:           UPDATE inventory SET quantity = quantity - v_transfer_qty WHERE id = v_item_id;
301:         END IF;
302: 
303:         IF v_to_type = 'player' THEN
304:           PERFORM add_item_to_inventory(
305:             p_player_id := v_to_id,
306:             p_item_name := v_item_name,
307:             p_quantity := v_transfer_qty,
308:             p_type := 'misc',
309:             p_attributes := jsonb_build_object('transferred', true),
310:             p_npc_id := NULL::UUID
311:           );
312:         ELSIF v_to_type = 'npc' THEN
313:           PERFORM add_item_to_inventory(
314:             p_player_id := NULL::UUID,
315:             p_item_name := v_item_name,
316:             p_quantity := v_transfer_qty,
317:             p_type := 'misc',
318:             p_attributes := jsonb_build_object('transferred', true),
319:             p_npc_id := v_to_id
320:           );
321:         END IF;
322: 
323:         v_applied_count := v_applied_count + 1;
324: 
325:       WHEN 'SPAWN_STRUCTURE' THEN
326:         v_location_id := (v_mutation->>'location_id')::UUID;
327:         v_structure := v_mutation->'structure';
328: 
329:         INSERT INTO location_structures (location_id, name, type, hp, max_hp, tags)
330:         VALUES (
331:           v_location_id,
332:           COALESCE(v_structure->>'name', 'Структура'),
333:           COALESCE(v_structure->>'type', 'shelter'),
334:           COALESCE((v_structure->>'hp')::INT, 50),
335:           COALESCE((v_structure->>'max_hp')::INT, 50),
336:           COALESCE(ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(v_structure->'tags')), ARRAY[]::TEXT[])
337:         );
338: 
339:         v_applied_count := v_applied_count + 1;
340: 
341:       WHEN 'ADVANCE_TIME' THEN
342:         v_total_minutes := (v_mutation->>'minutes')::INT;
343: 
344:         v_new_minute := v_session_minute + (v_total_minutes % 60);
345:         v_new_hour := v_session_hour + (v_total_minutes / 60);
346: 
347:         IF v_new_minute >= 60 THEN
348:           v_new_hour := v_new_hour + (v_new_minute / 60);
349:           v_new_minute := v_new_minute % 60;
350:         END IF;
351: 
352:         v_new_day := v_session_day;
353:         v_new_month := v_session_month;
354:         v_new_year := v_session_year;
355: 
356:         IF v_new_hour >= 24 THEN
357:           v_new_day := v_new_day + (v_new_hour / 24);
358:           v_new_hour := v_new_hour % 24;
359: 
360:           WHILE v_new_day > 30 LOOP
361:             v_new_day := v_new_day - 30;
362:             v_new_month := v_new_month + 1;
363:             IF v_new_month > 12 THEN
364:               v_new_month := 1;
365:               v_new_year := v_new_year + 1;
366:             END IF;
367:           END LOOP;
368:         END IF;
369: 
370:         v_session_minute := v_new_minute;
371:         v_session_hour := v_new_hour;
372:         v_session_day := v_new_day;
373:         v_session_month := v_new_month;
374:         v_session_year := v_new_year;
375: 
376:         UPDATE sessions
377:         SET game_year = v_new_year,
378:             game_month = v_new_month,
379:             game_day = v_new_day,
380:             game_hour = v_new_hour,
381:             game_minute = v_new_minute,
382:             updated_at = NOW()
383:         WHERE id = p_session_id;
384: 
385:         v_applied_count := v_applied_count + 1;
386: 
387:       ELSE
388:         RAISE EXCEPTION 'UNKNOWN_MUTATION_TYPE: %', v_mutation_type USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
389:     END CASE;
390:   END LOOP;
391: 
392:   v_current_time := jsonb_build_object(
393:     'year', v_session_year,
394:     'month', v_session_month,
395:     'day', v_session_day,
396:     'hour', v_session_hour,
397:     'minute', v_session_minute
398:   );
399: 
400:   RETURN jsonb_build_object(
401:     'success', true,
402:     'applied_count', v_applied_count,
403:     'new_time', v_current_time
404:   );
405: 
406: EXCEPTION
407:   WHEN OTHERS THEN
408:     RETURN jsonb_build_object(
409:       'success', false,
410:       'error_code', 'RACE_CONDITION_CONFLICT',
411:       'details', SQLERRM,
412:       'sql_state', SQLSTATE
413:     );
414: END;
415: $$;
416: 
417: GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION apply_turn_mutations(JSONB, UUID) TO authenticated, anon, service_role;

================
File: supabase/migrations/025_safe_session_deletion.sql
================
 1: -- 025_safe_session_deletion.sql
 2: -- Безопасное удаление сессий и каскадная очистка всех связанных данных без ущерба для карточек персонажей и миров
 3: 
 4: -- 1. Добавляем RLS политику на удаление сессий для участников или владельца мира
 5: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Sessions: delete for participants or world owner" ON public.sessions;
 6: 
 7: CREATE POLICY "Sessions: delete for participants or world owner" ON public.sessions
 8:   FOR DELETE TO authenticated
 9:   USING (
10:     id IN (SELECT session_id FROM public.get_user_session_ids(auth.uid()))
11:     OR world_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.worlds WHERE owner_id = auth.uid())
12:   );
13: 
14: -- 2. Создаем RPC функцию для атомарного и безопасного удаления сессии
15: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.delete_session(p_session_id UUID)
16: RETURNS JSONB
17: LANGUAGE plpgsql
18: SECURITY DEFINER
19: SET search_path = public, pg_temp
20: AS $$
21: DECLARE
22:   v_world_id UUID;
23:   v_caller_id UUID;
24:   v_is_participant BOOLEAN := FALSE;
25:   v_is_world_owner BOOLEAN := FALSE;
26:   v_players_count INT := 0;
27:   v_messages_count INT := 0;
28: BEGIN
29:   v_caller_id := auth.uid();
30: 
31:   -- Проверяем существование сессии
32:   SELECT world_id INTO v_world_id
33:   FROM public.sessions
34:   WHERE id = p_session_id;
35: 
36:   IF v_world_id IS NULL THEN
37:     RETURN jsonb_build_object(
38:       'success', false,
39:       'error', 'SESSION_NOT_FOUND',
40:       'message', 'Сессия не найдена'
41:     );
42:   END IF;
43: 
44:   -- Проверка прав: вызывающий должен быть либо участником сессии, либо владельцем мира
45:   -- (если вызов идёт из service_role, v_caller_id может быть NULL)
46:   IF v_caller_id IS NOT NULL THEN
47:     SELECT EXISTS (
48:       SELECT 1 FROM public.players
49:       WHERE session_id = p_session_id AND user_id = v_caller_id
50:     ) INTO v_is_participant;
51: 
52:     SELECT EXISTS (
53:       SELECT 1 FROM public.worlds
54:       WHERE id = v_world_id AND owner_id = v_caller_id
55:     ) INTO v_is_world_owner;
56: 
57:     IF NOT v_is_participant AND NOT v_is_world_owner THEN
58:       RETURN jsonb_build_object(
59:         'success', false,
60:         'error', 'PERMISSION_DENIED',
61:         'message', 'У вас нет прав на удаление этой сессии'
62:       );
63:     END IF;
64:   END IF;
65: 
66:   -- Считаем удаляемые связанные сущности для аудита
67:   SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_players_count FROM public.players WHERE session_id = p_session_id;
68:   SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_messages_count FROM public.messages WHERE session_id = p_session_id;
69: 
70:   -- Очищаем инвентарь NPC, привязанный к этой сессии через attributes
71:   DELETE FROM public.inventory
72:   WHERE attributes->>'harvested_at' = p_session_id::TEXT;
73: 
74:   -- Удаляем саму сессию (БД автоматически каскадирует удаление:
75:   -- players -> inventory, player_skills, player_injuries, npc_relationships, npc_memories,
76:   -- messages, turn_queue)
77:   DELETE FROM public.sessions WHERE id = p_session_id;
78: 
79:   RETURN jsonb_build_object(
80:     'success', true,
81:     'deleted_session_id', p_session_id,
82:     'cleaned_players', v_players_count,
83:     'cleaned_messages', v_messages_count
84:   );
85: END;
86: $$;
87: 
88: GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.delete_session(UUID) TO authenticated;
89: GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.delete_session(UUID) TO service_role;

 31: 
 32: function makeEngineOutput(mutations: any[] = [], facts: string[] = []): EngineOutputPayload {
 33:   return {
 34:     success: true,
 35:     action_results: [],
 36:     mutations: mutations as any,
 37:     encounter_triggered: { triggered: false },
 38:     raw_system_facts: facts,
 39:   };
 40: }

 42: describe("Step 3: Persistence (ACID Транзакция)", () => {

 47:   // ============================================
 48:   // Базовые случаи
 49:   // ============================================

 53:       engine_output: makeEngineOutput([], ["Some fact"]),
 54:     };
 55: 
 56:     const result = await applyTurnMutations(ctx);
 57:

 61:     expect(mockSupabase.rpc).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

 26:       if (key === "SUPABASE_URL") return "https://test.supabase.co";
 27:       if (key === "SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY") return "test-service-key";

 29:       return null;
