  1: // supabase/functions/simulate-npc-background/index.ts
  2: // Фоновая автономность NPC: действия главных персонажей за кадром
  3: import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.177.0/http/server.ts";
  4: import { createClient } from "https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2";
  5: import { sanitizeKey, cleanTextForAI, parseAIJson } from "../_shared/utils.ts";
  6: 
  7: const SUPABASE_URL = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL")!;
  8: const SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY")!;
  9: const FALLBACK_OPENROUTER_KEY = Deno.env.get("OPENROUTER_API_KEY") || "";
 10: const AI_MODEL = "xiaomi/mimo-v2.5";
 11: const OPENROUTER_CHAT_URL = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions";
 12: 
 13: const CORS = {
 14:   "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
 15:   "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type, Authorization, x-client-info, apikey",
 16:   "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "POST, OPTIONS",
 17: };
 18: 
 19: const SYSTEM_PROMPT = `Прошло дней: [days_passed]. Опиши 1 предложением, что NPC сделал за кадром (на основе его background и habits). Если он нашел или создал предмет, укажи его. JSON: { action_summary: 'текст', obtained_item_name: 'Название или null', item_type: 'weapon|misc' }`;
 20: 
 21: async function callChatLLM(systemPrompt: string, userMessage: string, apiKey: string): Promise<string> {
 22:   const response = await fetch(OPENROUTER_CHAT_URL, {
 23:     method: "POST",
 24:     headers: {
 25:       "Authorization": `Bearer ${apiKey}`,
 26:       "Content-Type": "application/json",
 27:       "HTTP-Referer": SUPABASE_URL,
 28:       "X-Title": "MultiRP-AI",
 29:     },
 30:     body: JSON.stringify({
 31:       model: AI_MODEL,
 32:       messages: [
 33:         { role: "system", content: systemPrompt },
 34:         { role: "user", content: userMessage },
 35:       ],
 36:       temperature: 0.7,
 37:       max_tokens: 1000,
 38:     }),
 39:     signal: AbortSignal.timeout(60000),
 40:   });
 41: 
 42:   if (!response.ok) {
 43:     const errText = await response.text();
 44:     throw new Error(`Chat API error: ${response.status} - ${errText}`);
 45:   }
 46: 
 47:   const data = await response.json();
 48:   return data.choices[0].message.content;
 49: }
 50: 
 51: serve(async (req) => {
 52:   if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
 53:     return new Response("ok", { headers: CORS });
 54:   }
 55: 
 56:   try {
 57:     const raw = await req.text();
 58:     let parsed: any;
 59:     try {
 60:       parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
 61:     } catch {
 62:       return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Некорректный JSON в теле запроса" }), {
 63:         status: 400,
 64:         headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
 65:       });
 66:     }
 67: 
 68:     const session_id = sanitizeKey(parsed.session_id);
 69:     const days_passed = Number(parsed.days_passed) || 1;
 70:     const user_id = sanitizeKey(parsed.user_id);
 71: 
 72:     console.log(`\n[simulate-npc-background] ═══════════════════════════════════════════════`);
 73:     console.log(`[simulate-npc-background] 🎭 NPC BACKGROUND SIMULATION START`);
 74:     console.log(`[simulate-npc-background] ═══════════════════════════════════════════════`);
 75:     console.log(`[simulate-npc-background] 📥 INPUT:`);
 76:     console.log(`[simulate-npc-background]    • session_id: ${session_id}`);
 77:     console.log(`[simulate-npc-background]    • days_passed: ${days_passed}`);
 78:     console.log(`[simulate-npc-background]    • user_id: ${user_id}`);
 79: 
 80:     if (!session_id) {
 81:       console.error(`[simulate-npc-background] ❌ Missing session_id`);
 82:       return new Response(
 83:         JSON.stringify({ error: "session_id обязателен" }),
 84:         { status: 400, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" } },
 85:       );
 86:     }
 87: 
 88:     const supabase = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY);
 89: 
 90:     // Получаем мир сессии
 91:     console.log(`\n[simulate-npc-background] 📊 Loading session...`);
 92:     const { data: session } = await supabase
 93:       .from("sessions")
 94:       .select("world_id")
 95:       .eq("id", session_id)
 96:       .single();
 97: 
 98:     if (!session) {
 99:       console.error(`[simulate-npc-background] ❌ Session not found`);
100:       return new Response(
101:         JSON.stringify({ error: "Сессия не найдена" }),
102:         { status: 404, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" } },
103:       );
104:     }
105: 
106:     console.log(`[simulate-npc-background] 🌍 World ID: ${session.world_id}`);
107: 
108:     // Получаем главных NPC мира
109:     console.log(`\n[simulate-npc-background] 🐉 Loading main NPCs...`);
110:     const { data: mainNpcs } = await supabase
111:       .from("npcs")
112:       .select("*")
113:       .eq("world_id", session.world_id)
114:       .eq("role", "main");
115: 
116:     if (!mainNpcs || mainNpcs.length === 0) {
117:       console.log(`[simulate-npc-background] ⚠️ No main NPCs found, returning empty result`);
118:       return new Response(
119:         JSON.stringify({ success: true, message: "Нет главных NPC для симуляции", actions: [] }),
120:         { status: 200, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" } },
121:       );
122:     }
123: 
124:     console.log(`[simulate-npc-background] 🐉 Found ${mainNpcs.length} main NPCs:`);
125:     for (const npc of mainNpcs) {
126:       console.log(`[simulate-npc-background]    • ${npc.name} (${npc.race})`);
127:     }
128: 
129:     // Получаем API ключ
130:     let apiKey = sanitizeKey(FALLBACK_OPENROUTER_KEY);
131:     console.log(`\n[simulate-npc-background] 🔑 Fallback key available: ${apiKey ? 'YES' : 'NO'}`);
132:     if (user_id) {
133:       const { data: userSettings } = await supabase
134:         .from("user_settings")
135:         .select("openrouter_key")
136:         .eq("id", user_id)
137:         .maybeSingle();
138:       if (userSettings?.openrouter_key) {
139:         apiKey = sanitizeKey(userSettings.openrouter_key);
140:         console.log(`[simulate-npc-background] 🔑 Using user key from settings`);
141:       }
142:     }
143: 
144:     if (!apiKey) {
145:       console.error(`[simulate-npc-background] ❌ No API key available`);
146:       return new Response(
147:         JSON.stringify({
148:           error: "Укажите ваш OpenRouter API Key в настройках аккаунта.",
149:           code: "MISSING_API_KEY",
150:         }),
151:         { status: 402, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" } },
152:       );
153:     }
154: 
155:     const actions: any[] = [];
156: 
157:     // Симулируем каждого главного NPC
158:     console.log(`\n[simulate-npc-background] 🎭 Simulating ${mainNpcs.length} NPCs for ${days_passed} days...`);
159:     for (const npc of mainNpcs) {
160:       console.log(`\n[simulate-npc-background] 🎭 Simulating: ${npc.name}`);
161:       const userMessage = `NPC: ${npc.name}
162: Раса: ${npc.race}
163: Предыстория: ${npc.background || "Неизвестно"}
164: Привычки: ${(npc.habits || []).join(", ") || "Неизвестно"}
165: Прошло дней: ${days_passed}`;
166: 
167:       try {
168:         const aiResponse = await callChatLLM(SYSTEM_PROMPT.replace("[days_passed]", String(days_passed)), userMessage, apiKey);
169:         console.log(`[simulate-npc-background] 🤖 AI response: ${aiResponse.slice(0, 100)}...`);
170: 
171:         const actionData = parseAIJson(aiResponse);
172: 
173:         if (actionData) {
174:           const action = {
175:             npc_id: npc.id,
176:             npc_name: npc.name,
177:             action_summary: actionData.action_summary || "",
178:             obtained_item_name: actionData.obtained_item_name || null,
179:             item_type: actionData.item_type || "misc",
180:           };
181: 
182:           // Если NPC получил предмет - добавляем в инвентарь
183:           if (actionData.obtained_item_name) {
184:             console.log(`[simulate-npc-background] 🎒 NPC ${npc.name} obtained item: ${actionData.obtained_item_name} (${actionData.item_type})`);
185:             const { error: itemError } = await supabase.rpc("add_item_to_inventory", {
186:               p_npc_id: npc.id,
187:               p_item_name: cleanTextForAI(actionData.obtained_item_name),
188:               p_quantity: 1,
189:               p_type: ["weapon", "armor", "consumable", "misc"].includes(actionData.item_type) ? actionData.item_type : "misc",
190:               p_attributes: {},
191:             });
192: 
193:             if (itemError) {
194:               console.error(`[simulate-npc-background] ❌ Failed to add item to NPC ${npc.id} inventory:`, itemError);
195:             } else {
196:               console.log(`[simulate-npc-background] ✅ Item added to NPC inventory`);
197:             }
198:           } else {
199:             console.log(`[simulate-npc-background] 📝 No item obtained`);
200:           }
201: 
202:           actions.push(action);
203:           console.log(`[simulate-npc-background] ✅ Action: ${actionData.action_summary}`);
204:         }
205:       } catch (err) {
206:         console.error(`[simulate-npc-background] ❌ Failed to simulate NPC ${npc.id}:`, err);
207:       }
208:     }
209: 
210:     console.log(`\n[simulate-npc-background] ✅ NPC BACKGROUND SIMULATION COMPLETE`);
211:     console.log(`[simulate-npc-background]    • Actions generated: ${actions.length}`);
212:     console.log(`[simulate-npc-background] ═══════════════════════════════════════════════\n`);
213: 
214:     return new Response(
215:       JSON.stringify({
216:         success: true,
217:         days_passed,
218:         actions_count: actions.length,
219:         actions,
220:       }),
221:       { status: 200, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" } },
222:     );
223:   } catch (err) {
224:     console.error("simulate-npc-background error:", err);
225:     return new Response(
226:       JSON.stringify({
227:         error: err.message || "Internal error",
228:         details: err.message,
229:       }),
230:       { status: 500, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" } },
231:     );
232:   }
233: });

File: supabase/migrations/005_injuries_and_rest.sql
================
 1: -- ============================================
 2: -- MultiRP AI — Migration 005: Injuries and rest
 3: -- Травмы, дебаффы и отслеживание отдыха
 4: -- ============================================
 5: 
 6: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS player_injuries (
 7:   id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 8:   player_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES players(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 9:   session_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
10:   injury_type TEXT NOT NULL,
11:   severity TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'minor',
12:   description TEXT DEFAULT '',
13:   stat_penalties JSONB DEFAULT '{}',
14:   hp_penalty INT DEFAULT 0,
15:   duration_hours INT DEFAULT 0,
16:   is_permanent BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
17:   cured_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
18:   created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
19: );
20: 
21: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_player_injuries_player ON player_injuries(player_id);
22: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_player_injuries_session ON player_injuries(session_id);
23: 
24: ALTER TABLE player_injuries ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
25: 
26: -- Drop existing policies to allow re-running
27: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Injuries: session players read" ON player_injuries;
28: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Injuries: system insert" ON player_injuries;
29: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Injuries: system update" ON player_injuries;
30: 
31: CREATE POLICY "Injuries: session players read" ON player_injuries
32:   FOR SELECT USING (
33:     EXISTS (
34:       SELECT 1 FROM players p
35:       WHERE p.id = player_injuries.player_id
36:         AND p.session_id = player_injuries.session_id
37:     )
38:   );
39: 
40: CREATE POLICY "Injuries: system insert" ON player_injuries
41:   FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (false);
42: 
43: CREATE POLICY "Injuries: system update" ON player_injuries
44:   FOR UPDATE USING (false);
45: 
46: ALTER TABLE players
47:   ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS active_injuries JSONB DEFAULT '[]',
48:   ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS rest_penalty_hours INT DEFAULT 0;

File: supabase/migrations/006_world_geography_and_npcs.sql

  1: -- ============================================
  2: -- MultiRP AI — Migration 006: World Geography & NPC Matrix
  3: -- География мира (государства, локации, маршруты) и Матрица NPC с векторной памятью (RAG)
  4: -- ============================================
  5: 
  6: -- Задача 1: Активация pgvector
  7: -- Критично для работы RAG-системы с векторными эмбеддингами
  8: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;
  9: 
 10: -- ============================================
 11: -- Задача 2 & 3: География и Матрица NPC
 12: -- Создаём таблицы без циклических FK, затем добавляем FK через ALTER TABLE
 13: -- ============================================
 14: 
 15: -- Государства (без ruler_id — добавим позже)
 16: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS states (
 17:   id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 18:   world_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES worlds(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 19:   name TEXT NOT NULL,
 20:   description TEXT DEFAULT '',
 21:   ruler_id UUID,
 22:   created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
 23:   updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
 24: );
 25: 
 26: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_states_world ON states(world_id);
 27: 
 28: -- Локации (города, деревни, руины, достопримечательности)
 29: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS locations (
 30:   id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 31:   state_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES states(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 32:   name TEXT NOT NULL,
 33:   type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'city' CHECK (type IN ('capital', 'city', 'village', 'ruins', 'landmark')),
 34:   description TEXT DEFAULT '',
 35:   created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
 36:   updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
 37: );
 38: 
 39: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_locations_state ON locations(state_id);
 40: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_locations_type ON locations(type);
 41: 
 42: -- Маршруты (дороги/связи между локациями)
 43: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS routes (
 44:   id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 45:   location_a_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES locations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 46:   location_b_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES locations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 47:   distance_km INT DEFAULT 0 CHECK (distance_km >= 0),
 48:   travel_days INT DEFAULT 0 CHECK (travel_days >= 0),
 49:   created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
 50: );
 51: 
 52: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_routes_location_a ON routes(location_a_id);
 53: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_routes_location_b ON routes(location_b_id);
 54: 
 55: -- Добавляем ограничения после создания таблицы для идемпотентности
 56: ALTER TABLE routes
 57:   DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS routes_no_duplicates,
 58:   ADD CONSTRAINT routes_no_duplicates CHECK (location_a_id < location_b_id);
 59: 
 60: ALTER TABLE routes
 61:   DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS routes_different_locations,

142: -- ============================================
143: -- Задача 5: RPC-функция для поиска воспоминаний
144: -- ============================================
145: 
146: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION match_npc_memories(
147:   query_embedding vector(1024),
148:   match_threshold float,
149:   match_count int,
150:   p_npc_id uuid,
151:   p_player_id uuid
152: )
153: RETURNS TABLE (
154:   id uuid,
155:   npc_id uuid,
156:   player_id uuid,
157:   memory_text text,
158:   memory_type text,
159:   embedding vector(1024),
160:   created_at timestamptz,
161:   similarity float
162: )
163: LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
164: BEGIN
165:   RETURN QUERY
166:   SELECT
167:     nm.id,
168:     nm.npc_id,
169:     nm.player_id,
170:     nm.memory_text,
171:     nm.memory_type,
172:     nm.embedding,
173:     nm.created_at,
174:     1 - (nm.embedding <=> query_embedding) AS similarity
175:   FROM npc_memories nm
176:   WHERE nm.npc_id = p_npc_id
177:     AND nm.player_id = p_player_id
178:     AND nm.embedding IS NOT NULL
179:     AND 1 - (nm.embedding <=> query_embedding) > match_threshold
180:   ORDER BY nm.embedding <=> query_embedding
181:   LIMIT match_count;
182: END;
183: $$;

328: -- Обновление функции add_item_to_inventory для поддержки NPC
329: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION add_item_to_inventory(
330:   p_player_id UUID DEFAULT NULL,
331:   p_item_name TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
332:   p_quantity INT DEFAULT 1,
333:   p_type TEXT DEFAULT 'misc',
334:   p_attributes JSONB DEFAULT '{}',
335:   p_npc_id UUID DEFAULT NULL
336: )
337: RETURNS UUID LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
338: DECLARE existing_item_id UUID; new_id UUID;
339: BEGIN
340:   -- Ищем существующий предмет по player_id или npc_id
341:   SELECT id INTO existing_item_id
342:   FROM inventory
343:   WHERE (
344:     (p_player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id = p_player_id)
345:     OR (p_npc_id IS NOT NULL AND npc_id = p_npc_id)
346:   )
347:   AND item_name = p_item_name
348:   AND type = p_type
349:   FOR UPDATE;
350: 
351:   IF existing_item_id IS NOT NULL THEN
352:     UPDATE inventory SET quantity = quantity + p_quantity WHERE id = existing_item_id;
353:     RETURN existing_item_id;
354:   ELSE
355:     new_id := gen_random_uuid();
356:     INSERT INTO inventory (id, player_id, npc_id, item_name, quantity, type, attributes)
357:     VALUES (new_id, p_player_id, p_npc_id, p_item_name, p_quantity, p_type, p_attributes);
358:     RETURN new_id;
359:   END IF;
360: END;
361: $$;
362: 
363: -- Обновление функции remove_item_from_inventory для поддержки NPC
364: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION remove_item_from_inventory(
365:   p_player_id UUID DEFAULT NULL,
366:   p_item_name TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
367:   p_quantity INT DEFAULT 1,
368:   p_npc_id UUID DEFAULT NULL
369: )
370: RETURNS BOOLEAN LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
371: DECLARE existing_item RECORD;
372: BEGIN
373:   -- Ищем существующий предмет по player_id или npc_id
374:   SELECT id, quantity INTO existing_item
375:   FROM inventory
376:   WHERE (
377:     (p_player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_id = p_player_id)
378:     OR (p_npc_id IS NOT NULL AND npc_id = p_npc_id)
379:   )
380:   AND item_name = p_item_name
381:   FOR UPDATE;
382: 
383:   IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN FALSE; END IF;
384: 
385:   IF existing_item.quantity <= p_quantity THEN
386:     DELETE FROM inventory WHERE id = existing_item.id;
387:   ELSE
388:     UPDATE inventory SET quantity = quantity - p_quantity WHERE id = existing_item.id;
389:   END IF;
390: 
391:   RETURN TRUE;
392: END;
393: $$;

 1: -- ============================================
 2: -- MultiRP AI — Migration 009: NPC Category & Location Binding
 3: -- ============================================
 4: -- Добавляет категорию NPC (npc, beast, monster, boss)
 5: -- Привязка NPC к локациям и государствам
 6: 
 7: -- Добавляем колонку category в таблицу npcs
 8: ALTER TABLE npcs
 9:   ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS category TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'npc' CHECK (category IN ('npc', 'beast', 'monster', 'boss'));
10: 
11: -- Индекс для быстрой фильтрации по категории
12: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_npcs_category ON npcs(category);
13: 
14: -- Комментарий к колонке
15: COMMENT ON COLUMN npcs.category IS 'Категория NPC: npc (разумное существо), beast (зверь), monster (монстр), boss (босс)';
16: 
17: -- RPC функция для получения списка государств и локаций мира
18: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_world_geography(p_world_id UUID)
19: RETURNS TABLE (
20:   states JSONB,
21:   locations JSONB
22: )
23: LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
24: BEGIN
25:   RETURN QUERY
26:   SELECT
27:     COALESCE(
28:       (SELECT jsonb_agg(
29:         jsonb_build_object(
30:           'id', s.id,
31:           'name', s.name,
32:           'description', s.description
33:         ) ORDER BY s.name)
34:       FROM states s WHERE s.world_id = p_world_id),
35:       '[]'::jsonb
36:     ) AS states,
37:     COALESCE(
38:       (SELECT jsonb_agg(
39:         jsonb_build_object(
40:           'id', l.id,
41:           'name', l.name,
42:           'type', l.type,
43:           'state_id', l.state_id
44:         ) ORDER BY l.type, l.name)
45:       FROM locations l
46:       JOIN states s ON l.state_id = s.id
47:       WHERE s.world_id = p_world_id),
48:       '[]'::jsonb
49:     ) AS locations;
50: END;
51: $$;
52: 
53: COMMENT ON FUNCTION get_world_geography IS 'Возвращает список государств и локаций мира для привязки NPC';

  1: -- Migration 012: Creature templates & combat system overhaul
  2: -- Tier = potential, Level = current power (1-100)
  3: -- Separate table for beast/monster species templates
  4: -- Stat sum: creatures 50-200 (player starts at 72)
  5: 
  6: -- =====================================================
  7: -- CREATURE TEMPLATES: species definitions with level ranges
  8: -- =====================================================
  9: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS creature_templates (
 10:   id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
 11:   world_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES worlds(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 12:   
 13:   -- Identity
 14:   species_name TEXT NOT NULL, -- "Волк", "Дракон", "Гоблин" (not individual name)
 15:   race TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Чудовище',
 16:   category TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'monster' CHECK (category IN ('beast', 'monster', 'boss')),
 17:   
 18:   -- Potential vs Current power
 19:   tier INT NOT NULL CHECK (tier BETWEEN 1 AND 5), -- Max potential (determines special attacks count)
 20:   level_min INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (level_min >= 1 AND level_min <= 100),
 21:   level_max INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 10 CHECK (level_max >= 1 AND level_max <= 100),
 22:   
 23:   -- Base stats (at level 1) — sum ~50 for weak creatures (player starts at 72)
 24:   stats_base JSONB DEFAULT '{"STR": 8, "DEX": 8, "CON": 8, "INT": 6, "WIS": 6, "CHA": 4}',
 25:   
 26:   -- Combat
 27:   special_attacks JSONB DEFAULT '[]', -- Array of special abilities (count = tier)
 28:   base_attacks JSONB DEFAULT '[]', -- Array of basic attacks (2-3 per 10 levels)
 29:   hp_multiplier DECIMAL DEFAULT 1.5, -- HP = CON * level * multiplier
 30:   
 31:   -- Behavior
 32:   is_pack BOOLEAN DEFAULT false, -- Can appear in packs/groups
 33:   is_unique BOOLEAN DEFAULT false, -- If true, only one instance exists (gets a name)
 34:   
 35:   -- Lore
 36:   description TEXT DEFAULT '',
 37:   habitat TEXT DEFAULT '', -- Preferred environment
 38:   loot_tier INT DEFAULT 1 CHECK (loot_tier BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
 39:   
 40:   -- System
 41:   created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
 42:   updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
 43:   
 44:   CONSTRAINT valid_level_range CHECK (level_max >= level_min)
 45: );
 46: 
 47: -- Index for fast lookup
 48: CREATE INDEX idx_creature_templates_world ON creature_templates(world_id);
 49: CREATE INDEX idx_creature_templates_category ON creature_templates(category);
 50: CREATE INDEX idx_creature_templates_species ON creature_templates(species_name);
 51: 
 52: -- =====================================================
 53: -- Update NPCs table: link to template, add attacks
 54: -- =====================================================
 55: ALTER TABLE npcs
 56:   ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS template_id UUID REFERENCES creature_templates(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 57:   ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS special_attacks JSONB DEFAULT '[]',
 58:   ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS base_attacks JSONB DEFAULT '[]',
 59:   ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_pack_instance BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
 60:   ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS pack_size INT DEFAULT 1;
 61: 
 62: -- Ensure max level is 100
 63: ALTER TABLE npcs DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS npcs_level_check;
 64: ALTER TABLE npcs ADD CONSTRAINT npcs_level_check CHECK (level >= 1 AND level <= 100);
 65: 
 66: -- Create index for template lookups
 67: CREATE INDEX idx_npcs_template ON npcs(template_id);
 68: 
 69: -- =====================================================
 70: -- Function to calculate stats at a given level
 71: -- Base sum at level 1: ~50 (creatures weaker than starting player at 72)
 72: -- Each level: +2 to stat sum
 73: -- Each tier: +10 to stat sum (bonus potential)
 74: -- Max at level 100 + tier 5: 50 + 198 + 50 = ~200
 75: -- =====================================================
 76: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_creature_stats(
 77:   base_stats JSONB,
 78:   current_level INT,
 79:   creature_tier INT
 80: ) RETURNS JSONB AS $$
 81: DECLARE
 82:   result JSONB := '{}';
 83:   stat_key TEXT;
 84:   base_val INT;
 85:   scaled_val INT;
 86:   final_sum INT := 0;
 87:   target_sum INT;
 88:   diff INT;
 89:   adjust_stat TEXT;
 90:   max_dist INT := 0;
 91:   current_dist INT;
 92:   stat_count INT := 6;
 93:   per_stat_gain DECIMAL;
 94:   tier_bonus_per_stat DECIMAL;
 95: BEGIN
 96:   -- Target sum: base 50 + (level-1)*2 + (tier-1)*10, capped at 200
 97:   target_sum := 50 + ((current_level - 1) * 2) + ((creature_tier - 1) * 10);
 98:   IF target_sum > 200 THEN target_sum := 200; END IF;
 99:   
100:   -- Per-stat gain: each level adds ~0.33 to each stat (2 points / 6 stats)
101:   -- Each tier adds ~1.67 to each stat (10 points / 6 stats)
102:   per_stat_gain := (current_level - 1) * 0.33;
103:   tier_bonus_per_stat := (creature_tier - 1) * 1.67;
104:   
105:   -- First pass: scale each stat proportionally
106:   FOR stat_key IN SELECT unnest(ARRAY['STR', 'DEX', 'CON', 'INT', 'WIS', 'CHA'])
107:   LOOP
108:     base_val := COALESCE((base_stats->>stat_key)::INT, 8);
109:     scaled_val := base_val + (per_stat_gain::INT) + (tier_bonus_per_stat::INT);
110:     -- Bonus for primary stats (STR for beasts, INT for monsters)
111:     IF stat_key = 'STR' AND creature_tier >= 3 THEN
112:       scaled_val := scaled_val + 2;
113:     ELSIF stat_key = 'INT' AND creature_tier >= 4 THEN
114:       scaled_val := scaled_val + 2;
115:     END IF;
116:     IF scaled_val > 30 THEN scaled_val := 30; END IF;
117:     IF scaled_val < 1 THEN scaled_val := 1; END IF;
118:     result := result || jsonb_build_object(stat_key, scaled_val);
119:     final_sum := final_sum + scaled_val;
120:   END LOOP;
121:   
122:   -- Adjust to match target sum
123:   diff := target_sum - final_sum;
124:   IF diff != 0 THEN
125:     -- Find stat furthest from base 8 to adjust
126:     adjust_stat := 'STR';
127:     max_dist := 0;
128:     FOR stat_key IN SELECT unnest(ARRAY['STR', 'DEX', 'CON', 'INT', 'WIS', 'CHA'])
129:     LOOP
130:       current_dist := ABS((result->>stat_key)::INT - 8);
131:       IF current_dist > max_dist THEN
132:         max_dist := current_dist;
133:         adjust_stat := stat_key;
134:       END IF;
135:     END LOOP;
136:     result := result || jsonb_build_object(adjust_stat, GREATEST(1, LEAST(30, (result->>adjust_stat)::INT + diff)));
137:   END IF;
138:   
139:   RETURN result;
140: END;
141: $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE;
142: 
143: -- =====================================================
144: -- Function to calculate HP from CON and level
145: -- Unified formula for players AND creatures:
146: -- HP = (CON * 2 + 10) + level * CON * 0.5
147: -- =====================================================
148: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_creature_hp(
149:   con_stat INT,
150:   current_level INT,
151:   creature_tier INT,
152:   hp_mult DECIMAL DEFAULT 1.5
153: ) RETURNS INT AS $$
154: DECLARE
155:   base_hp INT;
156:   level_bonus INT;
157: BEGIN
158:   -- Unified formula: (CON * 2 + 10) + level * CON * 0.5
159:   base_hp := GREATEST(1, con_stat * 2 + 10);
160:   level_bonus := GREATEST(0, (current_level * con_stat * 5 / 10)::INT);
161:   
162:   RETURN base_hp + level_bonus;
163: END;
164: $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE;
165: 
166: -- =====================================================
167: -- Function to calculate special attacks count by tier
168: -- =====================================================
169: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_special_attacks_count(creature_tier INT)
170: RETURNS INT AS $$
171: BEGIN
172:   -- Tier 1: 1 special attack, Tier 5: 5 special attacks
173:   RETURN GREATEST(1, LEAST(5, creature_tier));
174: END;
175: $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE;
176: 
177: -- =====================================================
178: -- Function to calculate base attacks count by level
179: -- =====================================================
180: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_base_attacks_count(current_level INT)
181: RETURNS INT AS $$
182: BEGIN
183:   -- 2 base attacks at level 1-10, +1 per 10 levels, max 10
184:   RETURN GREATEST(2, LEAST(10, 2 + ((current_level - 1) / 10)));
185: END;
186: $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE;

================
File: src/api/supabase.js
================
  1: // src/api/supabase.js — Клиент Supabase
  2: import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
  3: import { SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY } from '../config.js';
  4: 
  5: export const supabase = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY);
  6: 
  7: // Безопасный вызов Edge Functions через прямой fetch (обходит баг Supabase-клиента)
  8: export async function invokeFunction(functionName, body) {
  9:   const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
 10:   const headers = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
 11:   if (session?.access_token) {
 12:     headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${session.access_token}`;
 13:   }
 14:   const payload = JSON.stringify(body ?? {});
 15:   const res = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/functions/v1/${functionName}`, {
 16:     method: 'POST',
 17:     headers,
 18:     body: payload,
 19:     cache: 'no-store',
 20:   });
 21:   const data = await res.json();
 22:   if (!res.ok) {
 23:     const err = new Error(data.error || `HTTP ${res.status}`);
 24:     err.status = res.status;
 25:     err.data = data;
 26:     throw err;
 27:   }
 28:   return data;
 29: }
 30: 
 31: // Auth helpers
 32: export async function signUp(email, password) {
 33:   const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signUp({ email, password });
 34:   if (error) throw error;
 35:   return data;
 36: }
 37: 
 38: export async function signIn(email, password) {
 39:   const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password });
 40:   if (error) throw error;
 41:   return data;
 42: }
 43: 
 44: export async function signInWithGoogle() {
 45:   const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({
 46:     provider: 'google',
 47:     options: {
 48:       redirectTo: window.location.origin + (window.location.pathname.endsWith('/') ? window.location.pathname : window.location.pathname + '/'),
 49:     },
 50:   });
 51:   if (error) throw error;
 52:   return data;
 53: }
 54: 
 55: export async function signOut() {
 56:   const { error } = await supabase.auth.signOut();
 57:   if (error) throw error;
 58: }
 59: 
 60: export async function getCurrentUser() {
 61:   const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
 62:   return user;
 63: }
 64: 
 65: export function onAuthStateChange(callback) {
 66:   return supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange((_event, session) => {
 67:     callback(session?.user || null);
 68:   });
 69: }
 70: 
 71: // Realtime subscription helper
 72: export function subscribeToTable(table, filter, callback) {
 73:   const cleanFilter = filter ? filter.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '_') : 'all';
 74:   const channelId = `realtime:${table}:${cleanFilter}:${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}`;
 75: 
 76:   const channel = supabase
 77:     .channel(channelId)
 78:     .on('postgres_changes', { event: '*', schema: 'public', table, filter }, callback)
 79:     .subscribe();
 80: 
 81:   return () => supabase.removeChannel(channel);
 82: }
 83: 
 84: // Subscribe to session chat messages
 85: export function subscribeToSessionMessages(sessionId, callback) {
 86:   return subscribeToTable(
 87:     'messages',
 88:     `session_id=eq.${sessionId}`,
 89:     (payload) => callback(payload)
 90:   );
 91: }
 92: 
 93: // Subscribe to session player updates (turn tracking)
 94: export function subscribeToSessionPlayers(sessionId, callback) {
 95:   return subscribeToTable(
 96:     'players',
 97:     `session_id=eq.${sessionId}`,
 98:     (payload) => callback(payload)
 99:   );
100: }

 62: serve(async (req) => {
 63:   if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
 64:     return new Response("ok", { headers: CORS });
 65:   }
 66:

 69:     let parsed: any;
 70:     try {
 71:       parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
 72:     } catch {
 73:       return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Некорректный JSON в теле запроса" }), {
 74:         status: 400,
 75:         headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
 76:       });
 77:     }
 78: 
 79:     const user_id = cleanTextForAI(parsed.user_id);
 80:     const context = cleanTextForAI(parsed.context);
 81:     const recent_messages = Array.isArray(parsed.recent_messages) ? parsed.recent_messages.map((m: any) => cleanTextForAI(m)).join('\n') : '';
 82:     const plot_stage = cleanTextForAI(parsed.plot_stage);
 83:     const player_stats = parsed.player_stats || {};
 84:     const player_race = cleanTextForAI(parsed.player_race) || 'Человек';
 85:     const item_type = cleanTextForAI(parsed.item_type) || 'misc';
 86:     const rarity = cleanTextForAI(parsed.rarity) || 'common';
 87:     const location = cleanTextForAI(parsed.location) || 'Неизвестно';
 88:     const save_to_inventory = Boolean(parsed.save_to_inventory);
 89:     const player_id = sanitizeKey(parsed.player_id);
 90: 
 91:     console.log('generate-loot input:', { user_id, item_type, rarity, player_race, location, save_to_inventory });
 92: 
 93:     if (!user_id || !context) {
 94:       return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "user_id и context обязательны" }), {
 95:         status: 400,
 96:         headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
 97:       });
 98:     }
 99:

101:

115:     }
116: 
117:     const userMessage = `Контекст: ${context}\nЛокация: ${location}\n\n${recent_messages ? `Последние события:\n${recent_messages}\n\n` : ''}${plot_stage ? `Сюжет: ${plot_stage}\n\n` : ''}Игрок (${player_race}) имеет характеристики: ${JSON.stringify(player_stats)}.\n\nСоздай ${rarity === 'legendary' ? 'легендарный' : rarity === 'rare' ? 'редкий' : rarity === 'uncommon' ? 'необычный' : 'обычный'} предмет типа ${item_type}.`;
118: 
119:     const response = await fetch("https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions", {
120:       method: "POST",
121:       headers: {
122:         "Authorization": `Bearer ${apiKey}`,
123:         "Content-Type": "application/json",
124:         "HTTP-Referer": SUPABASE_URL,
125:         "X-Title": "MultiRP-AI",
126:       },
127:       body: JSON.stringify({
128:         model: AI_MODEL,
129:         messages: [
130:           { role: "system", content: SYSTEM_PROMPT },
131:           { role: "user", content: userMessage },
132:         ],
133:         temperature: 0.7,
134:         max_tokens: 1000,
135:       }),
136:       signal: AbortSignal.timeout(60000),
137:     });
138: 
139:     console.log('generate-loot OpenRouter status:', response.status);
140: 
141:     if (!response.ok) {
142:       let errDetails = "";
143:       try {
144:         const errJson = await response.json();
145:         errDetails = errJson?.error?.message || errJson?.error || JSON.stringify(errJson);
146:       } catch {
147:         errDetails = await response.text();
148:       }
149:       console.error("AI API error:", errDetails);
150:       return new Response(JSON.stringify({
151:         error: "Ошибка AI API",
152:         details: errDetails,
153:         status: response.status,
154:       }), {
155:         status: 502, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
156:       });
157:     }
158: 
159:     const data = await response.json();
160:     const rawContent = data.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || "";
161:     console.log('generate-loot AI raw:', rawContent);
162:     const item = parseAIJson(rawContent);
163: 
164:     if (!item) {
165:       return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Не удалось распарсить ответ ИИ", raw: rawContent || null }), {
166:         status: 422, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
167:       });
168:     }
169: 
170:     const normalizedItem = {
171:       name: cleanTextForAI(item.name),
172:       type: cleanTextForAI(item.type) || 'misc',
173:       rarity: cleanTextForAI(item.rarity) || 'common',
174:       description: cleanTextForAI(item.description),
175:       stats: item.stats || {},
176:       ac_bonus: Number(item.ac_bonus) || 0,
177:       damage: cleanTextForAI(item.damage) || '',
178:       heal_amount: Number(item.heal_amount) || 0,
179:       value: Number(item.value) || 10,
180:       condition: cleanTextForAI(item.condition) || 'new',
181:       durability: Number(item.durability) || 100,
182:       requirements: item.requirements || {},
183:       effects: Array.isArray(item.effects) ? item.effects.map((e: any) => cleanTextForAI(String(e))) : [],
184:       world_hints: item.world_hints || {},
185:     };
186: 
187:     let inventoryItem = null;
188:     if (save_to_inventory && player_id) {
189:       const allowedType = ['weapon', 'armor', 'consumable'].includes(normalizedItem.type) ? normalizedItem.type : 'misc';
190:       const attributes = {
191:         rarity: normalizedItem.rarity,
192:         description: normalizedItem.description,
193:         stats: normalizedItem.stats,
194:         ac_bonus: normalizedItem.ac_bonus,
195:         damage: normalizedItem.damage,
196:         heal_amount: normalizedItem.heal_amount,
197:         value: normalizedItem.value,
198:         requirements: normalizedItem.requirements,
199:         effects: normalizedItem.effects,
200:         original_type: normalizedItem.type,
201:       };
202: 
203:       const { data: inventoryData, error: inventoryError } = await supabase
204:         .from("inventory")
205:         .insert({
206:           player_id,
207:           item_name: normalizedItem.name,
208:           type: allowedType,
209:           quantity: 1,
210:           durability: normalizedItem.durability,
211:           condition: normalizedItem.condition,
212:           attributes,
213:         })
214:         .select()
215:         .single();
216: 
217:       if (inventoryError) {
218:         console.error('Failed to save item to inventory:', inventoryError);
219:       } else {
220:         inventoryItem = inventoryData;
221:       }
222:     }
223: 
224:     return new Response(JSON.stringify({
225:       item: normalizedItem,
226:       inventory_item: inventoryItem,
227:       location,
228:     }), {
229:       status: 200, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
230:     });
231: 
232:   } catch (err) {
233:     console.error("generate-loot error:", err);
234:     return new Response(JSON.stringify({
235:       error: err.message || "Internal error",
236:       details: err.message,
237:     }), {
238:       status: 500,
239:       headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
240:     });
241:   }
242: });

================
File: supabase/functions/process-turn/engine/handlers/_base.ts
================
  1: // supabase/functions/process-turn/engine/handlers/_base.ts
  2: // Базовый класс для хендлеров действий
  3: 
  4: import { ActionHandler, ActionHandlerResult, EngineInputContext, ActionResult, EngineMutation, EnginePlayer, EngineNpc } from "../types.ts";
  5: import { RouterAction, ImproperToolUsage, StatToCheck } from "../../types.ts";
  6: import { getStatModifier, getProficiencyBonus, performAttackRoll, rollDamage, parseDiceString, rollD100 } from "../dice.ts";
  7: 
  8: /**
  9:  * Базовый хендлер с утилитами
 10:  */
 11: export abstract class BaseActionHandler implements ActionHandler {
 12:   abstract readonly action_type: string;
 13:   abstract handle(action: RouterAction, context: EngineInputContext): ActionHandlerResult;
 14: 
 15:   // ============================================
 16:   // Утилиты
 17:   // ============================================
 18: 
 19:   protected getStatMod(player: EnginePlayer, statName: string, injuryMod: number = 0): number {
 20:     const baseMod = getStatModifier(player.stats[statName] || 10);
 21:     return baseMod + injuryMod;
 22:   }
 23: 
 24:   protected getProficiency(player: EnginePlayer): number {
 25:     return getProficiencyBonus(player.level || 1);
 26:   }
 27: 
 28:   protected getStatToCheckMod(player: EnginePlayer, stat: StatToCheck, injuryPenalties: Record<string, number> = {}): number {
 29:     // Маппинг StatToCheck → стат игрока
 30:     const statMap: Record<StatToCheck, string> = {
 31:       strength: "STR",
 32:       dexterity: "DEX",
 33:       stealth: "DEX", // скрытность = DEX
 34:       survival: "WIS", // выживание = WIS
 35:       investigation: "INT",
 36:       insight: "WIS",
 37:       none: "STR", // fallback
 38:     };
 39:     const statName = statMap[stat];
 40:     const baseMod = this.getStatMod(player, statName, injuryPenalties[statName] || 0);
 41:     return baseMod;
 42:   }
 43: 
 44:   protected findItemById(player: EnginePlayer, itemId: string): EnginePlayer["inventory"][0] | null {
 45:     return player.inventory.find((i) => i.id === itemId) || null;
 46:   }
 47: 
 48:   protected findNpcById(context: EngineInputContext, npcId: string): EngineNpc | null {
 49:     return context.targets.npcs.get(npcId) || null;
 50:   }
 51: 
 52:   protected findPlayerById(context: EngineInputContext, playerId: string): EnginePlayer | null {
 53:     return context.targets.players.get(playerId) || null;
 54:   }
 55: 
 56:   /**
 57:    * Парсит дайсы урона из атрибутов предмета или возвращает дефолт
 58:    */
 59:   protected getWeaponDamage(item: EnginePlayer["inventory"][0] | null, defaultDice: string = "1d4"): string {
 60:     if (!item) return defaultDice;
 61:     const attrs = item.attributes || {};
 62:     if (typeof attrs.damage_dice === "string") return attrs.damage_dice;
 63:     if (typeof attrs.damage === "string") return attrs.damage;
 64:     return defaultDice;
 65:   }
 66: 
 67:   /**
 68:    * Создаёт мутацию UPDATE_DURABILITY для improper_tool_usage
 69:    */
 70:   protected buildDurabilityMutation(item: EnginePlayer["inventory"][0], usage: ImproperToolUsage): EngineMutation | null {
 71:     if (!usage.is_improper) return null;
 72:     return {
 73:       type: "UPDATE_DURABILITY",
 74:       item_id: item.id,
 75:       delta: -Math.abs(usage.durability_penalty || 1),
 76:       set_broken: usage.stat_penalty === "damage",
 77:     };
 78:   }
 79: 
 80:   /**
 81:    * Выполняет бросок атаки/проверки
 82:    */
 83:   protected performCheck(
 84:     statMod: number,
 85:     targetDc: number,
 86:     proficiency: number,
 87:     advantage: boolean = false,
 88:     disadvantage: boolean = false
 89:   ): { d20: number; chosen: number; rolls: number[]; modifier: number; total: number; target_dc: number; is_crit: boolean; is_fumble: boolean; success: boolean } {
 90:     const roll = performAttackRoll({
 91:       target_dc: targetDc,
 92:       stat_modifier: statMod,
 93:       proficiency_bonus: proficiency,
 94:       advantage,
 95:       disadvantage,
 96:     });
 97:     // В D&D 5e натуральная 1 на проверке характеристик/навыков НЕ является автопровалом: проверяется total >= target_dc
 98:     const isCheckSuccess = roll.is_crit ? true : (roll.total >= targetDc);
 99:     return {
100:       d20: roll.chosen,
101:       chosen: roll.chosen,
102:       rolls: roll.rolls,
103:       modifier: roll.modifier,
104:       total: roll.total,
105:       target_dc: roll.target_dc,
106:       is_crit: roll.is_crit,
107:       is_fumble: roll.is_fumble,
108:       success: isCheckSuccess,
109:     };
110:   }
111: 
112: }

File: supabase/functions/process-turn/engine/handlers/craft_handler.ts

  1: // supabase/functions/process-turn/engine/handlers/craft_handler.ts
  2: // Обработчик крафта (recipe + custom)
  3: 
  4: import { BaseActionHandler } from "./_base.ts";
  5: import { ActionHandlerResult, EngineInputContext, EngineMutation, EngineInventoryItem } from "../types.ts";
  6: import { RouterAction } from "../../types.ts";
  7: 
  8: export class CraftHandler extends BaseActionHandler {
  9:   override readonly action_type: string = "craft_recipe";
 10: 
 11:   override handle(action: RouterAction, context: EngineInputContext): ActionHandlerResult {
 12:     return this.handleCraft(action, context);
 13:   }
 14: 
 15:   /**
 16:    * Общая логика для craft_recipe и craft_custom
 17:    */
 18:   private handleCraft(action: RouterAction, context: EngineInputContext): ActionHandlerResult {
 19:     const player = context.acting_player;
 20:     const blueprint = action.dynamic_blueprint;
 21:     const targetDc = action.ai_custom_dc || 12;
 22: 
 23:     // ============================================
 24:     // Проверка наличия материалов
 25:     // ============================================
 26:     const requiredMaterials = action.consumed_materials || [];
 27:     if (requiredMaterials.length === 0) {
 28:       return {
 29:         result: {
 30:           action_type: action.action_type,
 31:           success: false,
 32:           details: "Не указаны материалы для крафта",
 33:         },
 34:         mutations: [],
 35:         system_facts: [`${player.name} попытался крафтить без указания материалов.`],
 36:       };
 37:     }
 38: 
 39:     // Строим Map инвентаря для быстрого поиска
 40:     const inventoryMap = new Map<string, EngineInventoryItem>();
 41:     for (const item of player.inventory) {
 42:       inventoryMap.set(item.id, item);
 43:     }
 44: 
 45:     // Проверяем что все материалы есть в инвентаре
 46:     const missingMaterials: { id: string; required: number; available: number; name: string }[] = [];
 47:     for (const required of requiredMaterials) {
 48:       const owned = inventoryMap.get(required.id);
 49:       if (!owned) {
 50:         missingMaterials.push({ id: required.id, required: required.quantity, available: 0, name: required.id });
 51:       } else if (owned.quantity < required.quantity) {
 52:         missingMaterials.push({
 53:           id: required.id,
 54:           required: required.quantity,
 55:           available: owned.quantity,
 56:           name: owned.item_name,
 57:         });
 58:       }
 59:     }
 60: 
 61:     if (missingMaterials.length > 0) {
 62:       const list = missingMaterials.map((m) => `${m.name} (нужно ${m.required}, есть ${m.available})`).join(", ");
 63:       return {
 64:         result: {
 65:           action_type: action.action_type,
 66:           success: false,
 67:           details: `Недостаточно материалов: ${list}`,
 68:         },
 69:         mutations: [],
 70:         system_facts: [`${player.name} не смог скрафтить: не хватает ${list}.`],
 71:       };
 72:     }
 73: 
 74:     // ============================================
 75:     // Бросок против DC
 76:     // ============================================
 77:     const statMod = this.getStatToCheckMod(player, action.stat_to_check || "dexterity");
 78:     const proficiency = this.getProficiency(player);
 79:     const advantage = context.session.difficulty === "easy";
 80:     const disadvantage = context.session.difficulty === "hard";
 81:     const roll = this.performCheck(statMod, targetDc, proficiency, advantage, disadvantage);
 82: 
 83: 
 84:     const mutations: EngineMutation[] = [];
 85:     const systemFacts: string[] = [];
 86: 
 87:     if (!roll.success) {
 88:       // Провал: списываем 50% материалов как испорченные
 89:       for (const required of requiredMaterials) {
 90:         const lostQuantity = Math.ceil(required.quantity * 0.5);
 91:         if (lostQuantity > 0) {
 92:           mutations.push({
 93:             type: "DELETE_ITEM",
 94:             item_id: required.id,
 95:             quantity: lostQuantity,
 96:           });
 97:         }
 98:       }
 99:       systemFacts.push(`${player.name} неудачно скрафтил: потеряно ${Math.ceil(requiredMaterials.length * 0.5)} материалов.`);
100:       return {
101:         result: {
102:           action_type: action.action_type,
103:           success: false,
104:           dice_roll: roll,
105:           details: `Крафт не удался (${roll.total} vs ${targetDc}), часть материалов испорчена`,
106:         },
107:         mutations,
108:         system_facts: systemFacts,
109:       };
110:     }
111: 
112:     // ============================================
113:     // Успех: списываем все материалы + создаём предмет
114:     // ============================================
115:     for (const required of requiredMaterials) {
116:       mutations.push({
117:         type: "DELETE_ITEM",
118:         item_id: required.id,
119:         quantity: required.quantity,
120:       });
121:     }
122: 
123:     if (blueprint && (blueprint.item_name || blueprint.name)) {
124:       mutations.push({
125:         type: "INSERT_ITEM",
126:         owner_id: player.id,
127:         owner_type: "player",
128:         item: {
129:           item_name: blueprint.item_name || blueprint.name,
130:           type: blueprint.type || "misc",
131:           quantity: blueprint.quantity || 1,
132:           attributes: blueprint.attributes || {},
133:         },
134:       });
135:     }
136: 
137:     systemFacts.push(`${player.name} успешно скрафтил "${blueprint?.item_name || blueprint?.name || "предмет"}".`);
138: 
139:     return {
140:       result: {
141:         action_type: action.action_type,
142:         success: true,
143:         dice_roll: roll,
144:         details: `Крафт успешен: ${blueprint?.item_name || blueprint?.name || "предмет"}`,
145:       },
146:       mutations,
147:       system_facts: systemFacts,
148:     };
149:   }
150: }
151: 
152: /**
153:  * CraftCustomHandler — крафт по кастомному чертежу (dynamic_blueprint обязателен)
154:  */
155: export class CraftCustomHandler extends CraftHandler {
156:   override readonly action_type: string = "craft_custom";
157: 
158:   override handle(action: RouterAction, context: EngineInputContext): ActionHandlerResult {
159:     if (!action.dynamic_blueprint || (!action.dynamic_blueprint.item_name && !action.dynamic_blueprint.name)) {
160:       return {
161:         result: {
162:           action_type: this.action_type,
163:           success: false,
164:           details: "Для кастомного крафта требуется dynamic_blueprint с item_name или name",
165:         },
166:         mutations: [],
167:         system_facts: [`${context.acting_player.name} попытался кастомный крафт без чертежа.`],
168:       };
169:     }
170:     return super.handle(action, context);
171:   }
172: }

File: supabase/functions/process-turn/engine/handlers/move_handler.ts

 1: // supabase/functions/process-turn/engine/handlers/move_handler.ts
 2: // Хендлер перемещения: «Бегу в укрытие», «Иду к озеру», «Отступаю назад».
 3: // Если DC указан — выполняется проверка (например преодоление препятствия).
 4: // Без DC — это свободное перемещение, всегда успешное (время/локация уже учтены в GPS).
 5: 
 6: import { BaseActionHandler } from "./_base.ts";
 7: import { ActionHandlerResult, EngineInputContext, ActionResult, EngineMutation } from "../types.ts";
 8: import { RouterAction } from "../../types.ts";
 9: 
10: export class MoveHandler extends BaseActionHandler {
11:   readonly action_type = "move";
12: 
13:   handle(action: RouterAction, context: EngineInputContext): ActionHandlerResult {
14:     const player = context.acting_player;
15:     const destination = action.target_item_name || "новое местоположение";
16: 
17:     // ============================================
18:     // Если есть DC — это проверка (например преодоление сложного участка)
19:     // ============================================
20:     if (action.ai_custom_dc && action.ai_custom_dc > 0) {
21:       const statMod = this.getStatToCheckMod(player, action.stat_to_check || "dexterity");
22:       const proficiency = this.getProficiency(player);
23:       const advantage = context.session.difficulty === "easy";
24:       const disadvantage = context.session.difficulty === "hard";
25:       const roll = this.performCheck(statMod, action.ai_custom_dc, proficiency, advantage, disadvantage);
26: 
27: 
28: 
29:       if (!roll.success) {
30:         const result: ActionResult = {
31:           action_type: this.action_type,
32:           success: false,
33:           dice_roll: {
34:             d20: roll.d20,
35:             modifier: roll.modifier,
36:             total: roll.total,
37:             target_dc: action.ai_custom_dc,
38:             success: false,
39:           },
40:           details: `Не удалось преодолеть препятствие на пути к "${destination}" (бросок ${roll.total} vs DC ${action.ai_custom_dc}).`,
41:         };
42:         return {
43:           result,
44:           mutations: [],
45:           system_facts: [`${player.name} попытался переместиться к "${destination}", но препятствие помешало (бросок ${roll.total} vs DC ${action.ai_custom_dc}).`],
46:         };
47:       }
48: 
49:       const result: ActionResult = {
50:         action_type: this.action_type,
51:         success: true,
52:         dice_roll: {
53:           d20: roll.d20,
54:           modifier: roll.modifier,
55:           total: roll.total,
56:           target_dc: action.ai_custom_dc,
57:           success: true,
58:         },
59:         details: `Успешное перемещение к: ${destination}`,
60:       };
61:       return {
62:         result,
63:         mutations: [],
64:         system_facts: [`${player.name} успешно преодолел препятствие и переместился к "${destination}" (бросок ${roll.total} vs DC ${action.ai_custom_dc}).`],
65:       };
66:     }
67: 
68:     // ============================================
69:     // Свободное перемещение без проверки (DC = null или 0)
70:     // Локация/время уже обрабатываются GPS-стадией.
71:     // ============================================
72:     const result: ActionResult = {
73:       action_type: this.action_type,
74:       success: true,
75:       details: `Перемещение: ${destination}`,
76:     };
77:     return {
78:       result,
79:       mutations: [],
80:       system_facts: [`${player.name} переместился в направлении: ${destination}.`],
81:     };
82:   }
83: }

  1: // supabase/functions/process-turn/engine/handlers/transfer_handler.ts
  2: // Обработчик передачи предметов между владельцами
  3: 
  4: import { BaseActionHandler } from "./_base.ts";
  5: import { ActionHandlerResult, EngineInputContext, EngineMutation } from "../types.ts";
  6: import { RouterAction } from "../../types.ts";
  7: 
  8: export class TransferHandler extends BaseActionHandler {
  9:   readonly action_type = "transfer";
 10: 
 11:   handle(action: RouterAction, context: EngineInputContext): ActionHandlerResult {
 12:     const player = context.acting_player;
 13:     let itemId = action.used_item_id;
 14:     let targetId = action.target_entity_id;
 15:     const rawTargetName = (action.target_item_name || "").trim().toLowerCase();
 16:     const qtyFromAction = (action as any).quantity ?? action.consumed_materials?.[0]?.quantity;
 17:     const quantity = typeof qtyFromAction === "number" && qtyFromAction > 0 ? qtyFromAction : 1;
 18: 
 19:     // Резолв предмета по ID или названию
 20:     let item: any = null;
 21:     if (itemId) {
 22:       item = this.findItemById(player, itemId);
 23:     }
 24:     if (!item && rawTargetName) {
 25:       item = (player.inventory || []).find((i: any) => {
 26:         const name = (i.item_name || i.name || "").toLowerCase();
 27:         return name.includes(rawTargetName) || rawTargetName.includes(name);
 28:       });
 29:     }
 30:     if (!item && rawTargetName) {
 31:       const rootMatch = rawTargetName.replace(/(?:а|ов|ев|и|ы|у|е|ом|ам|ами|ях)$/i, "");
 32:       if (rootMatch.length >= 3) {
 33:         item = (player.inventory || []).find((i: any) => {
 34:           const name = (i.item_name || i.name || "").toLowerCase();
 35:           return name.includes(rootMatch);
 36:         });
 37:       }
 38:     }
 39: 
 40:     if (!item) {
 41:       return {
 42:         result: {
 43:           action_type: this.action_type,
 44:           success: false,
 45:           details: `Предмет "${action.target_item_name || itemId || "не указан"}" не найден в вашем инвентаре`,
 46:         },
 47:         mutations: [],
 48:         system_facts: [`${player.name} попытался передать предмет, которого у него нет.`],
 49:       };
 50:     }
 51:     itemId = item.id;
 52: 
 53:     // Резолв получателя по ID или имени
 54:     if (!targetId) {
 55:       const targetHint = ((action as any).target_entity_name || (action as any).target_name || "").toLowerCase();
 56:       if (targetHint) {
 57:         for (const [id, npc] of context.targets.npcs.entries()) {
 58:           if (npc.name?.toLowerCase().includes(targetHint) || targetHint.includes(npc.name?.toLowerCase() || "")) {
 59:             targetId = id;
 60:             break;
 61:           }
 62:         }
 63:         if (!targetId) {
 64:           for (const [id, p] of context.targets.players.entries()) {
 65:             if (p.name?.toLowerCase().includes(targetHint) || targetHint.includes(p.name?.toLowerCase() || "")) {
 66:               targetId = id;
 67:               break;
 68:             }
 69:           }
 70:         }
 71:       }
 72:     }
 73: 
 74:     // Если всё ещё нет targetId, но рядом есть ровно один мирный NPC — передаём ему
 75:     if (!targetId && context.targets.npcs.size === 1) {
 76:       const onlyNpc = Array.from(context.targets.npcs.values())[0];
 77:       if (!onlyNpc.is_hostile) {
 78:         targetId = onlyNpc.id;
 79:       }
 80:     }
 81: 
 82:     if (!targetId) {
 83:       return {
 84:         result: {
 85:           action_type: this.action_type,
 86:           success: false,
 87:           details: "Не указан получатель (кому передать)",
 88:         },
 89:         mutations: [],
 90:         system_facts: [`${player.name} попытался передать ${item.item_name}, не указав получателя.`],
 91:       };
 92:     }
 93: 
 94:     const transferQty = Math.min(item.quantity, quantity);
 95: 
 96:     // ============================================
 97:     // Определяем тип получателя (player/npc/location)
 98:     // ============================================
 99:     const isNpc = context.targets.npcs.has(targetId);
100:     const isPlayer = context.targets.players.has(targetId);
101:     const isLocation = context.targets.location_items.has(targetId);
102: 
103:     if (!isNpc && !isPlayer && !isLocation) {
104:       return {
105:         result: {
106:           action_type: this.action_type,
107:           success: false,
108:           details: `Получатель ${targetId} не найден`,
109:         },
110:         mutations: [],
111:         system_facts: [`${player.name} попытался передать предмет несуществующему получателю.`],
112:       };
113:     }
114: 
115:     const toType: "player" | "npc" | "location" = isNpc ? "npc" : isPlayer ? "player" : "location";
116: 
117:     // ============================================
118:     // Мутация TRANSFER_ITEM (без кубиков)
119:     // ============================================
120:     const mutation: EngineMutation = {
121:       type: "TRANSFER_ITEM",
122:       item_id: String(itemId || item.id),
123:       from_id: player.id,
124:       to_id: targetId,
125:       from_type: "player",
126:       to_type: toType,
127:       quantity: transferQty,
128:     };
129: 
130:     const targetName = isNpc 
131:       ? context.targets.npcs.get(targetId)?.name 
132:       : isPlayer 
133:       ? context.targets.players.get(targetId)?.name 
134:       : "локацию";
135: 
136:     return {
137:       result: {
138:         action_type: this.action_type,
139:         success: true,
140:         details: `Передано: ${item.item_name} → ${targetName}`,
141:       },
142:       mutations: [mutation],
143:       system_facts: [`${player.name} передал ${item.item_name} (x${quantity}) → ${targetName}.`],
144:     };
145:   }
146: }

File: supabase/functions/process-turn/engine/step2_engine.ts
================
  1: // supabase/functions/process-turn/engine/step2_engine.ts
  2: // Шаг 2: Математическое Ядро (D&D Engine)
  3: // Оркестратор: прогоняет actions через хендлеры, считает энкаунтеры, агрегирует мутации.
  4: 
  5: import {
  6:   EngineInputContext,
  7:   EngineOutputPayload,
  8:   ActionResult,
  9:   EngineMutation,
 10:   EncounterTriggered,
 11:   ActionHandlerResult,
 12: } from "./types.ts";
 13: import { RouterOutputPayload, RouterAction } from "../types.ts";
 14: import { getHandler, getRegisteredActionTypes } from "./handlers/index.ts";
 15: import { rollD100 } from "./dice.ts";
 16: 
 17: // ============================================
 18: // Пороги энкаунтеров по сложности (d100)
 19: // ============================================
 20: const ENCOUNTER_THRESHOLDS: Record<"easy" | "normal" | "hard", number> = {
 21:   easy: 5,   // < 5%
 22:   normal: 10, // < 10%
 23:   hard: 15,   // < 15%
 24: };
 25: 
 26: const ENCOUNTER_TIERS: Record<number, { name: string; tier: number }> = {
 27:   1: { name: "Слабое существо", tier: 1 },
 28:   25: { name: "Обычное существо", tier: 2 },
 29:   50: { name: "Сильное существо", tier: 3 },
 30:   75: { name: "Элитное существо", tier: 4 },
 31:   95: { name: "Легендарное существо", tier: 5 },
 32: };
 33: 
 34: function getEncounterTier(d100roll: number): { name: string; tier: number } {
 35:   if (d100roll < 25) return ENCOUNTER_TIERS[1];
 36:   if (d100roll < 50) return ENCOUNTER_TIERS[25];
 37:   if (d100roll < 75) return ENCOUNTER_TIERS[50];
 38:   if (d100roll < 95) return ENCOUNTER_TIERS[75];
 39:   return ENCOUNTER_TIERS[95];
 40: }
 41: 
 42: // ============================================
 43: // Обработка одного действия
 44: // ============================================
 45: function processAction(
 46:   action: RouterAction,
 47:   context: EngineInputContext
 48: ): ActionHandlerResult {
 49:   const handler = getHandler(action.action_type);
 50:   if (!handler) {
 51:     return {
 52:       result: {
 53:         action_type: action.action_type,
 54:         success: false,
 55:         details: `Неизвестный тип действия: ${action.action_type}. Доступные: ${getRegisteredActionTypes().join(", ")}`,
 56:       },
 57:       mutations: [],
 58:       system_facts: [`Неизвестное действие: ${action.action_type}`],
 59:     };
 60:   }
 61:   return handler.handle(action, context);
 62: }
 63: 
 64: // ============================================
 65: // Генерация энкаунтера (d100)
 66: // ============================================
 67: function rollEncounter(difficulty: "easy" | "normal" | "hard"): EncounterTriggered {
 68:   const roll = rollD100();
 69:   const threshold = ENCOUNTER_THRESHOLDS[difficulty];
 70: 
 71:   if (roll < threshold) {
 72:     const tierRoll = rollD100();
 73:     const tier = getEncounterTier(tierRoll);
 74:     return {
 75:       triggered: true,
 76:       tier: tier.tier,
 77:       creature_name: tier.name,
 78:     };
 79:   }
 80: 
 81:   return { triggered: false };
 82: }
 83: 
 84: // ============================================
 85: // Главный фасад движка
 86: // ============================================
 87: export function executeEngine(context: EngineInputContext): EngineOutputPayload {
 88:   const { router_output, session, acting_player } = context;
 89: 
 90:   // Если роутер пометил действие как impossible — сразу выход
 91:   if (router_output.status === "impossible") {
 92:     return {
 93:       success: false,
 94:       action_results: [
 95:         {
 96:           action_type: "blocked",
 97:           success: false,
 98:           blocked: true,
 99:           block_reason: router_output.clarification_msg || "Действие невозможно",
100:           details: router_output.clarification_msg || "Действие невозможно",
101:         },
102:       ],
103:       mutations: [],
104:       encounter_triggered: { triggered: false },
105:       raw_system_facts: [`Действие заблокировано: ${router_output.clarification_msg}`],
106:       system_facts: [`Действие заблокировано: ${router_output.clarification_msg}`],
107:     };
108:   }
109: 
110:   if (router_output.status === "clarification_needed") {
111:     return {
112:       success: false,
113:       action_results: [
114:         {
115:           action_type: "clarification_needed",
116:           success: false,
117:           blocked: true,
118:           block_reason: router_output.clarification_msg || "Требуется уточнение",
119:           details: router_output.clarification_msg || "Требуется уточнение",
120:         },
121:       ],
122:       mutations: [],
123:       encounter_triggered: { triggered: false },
124:       raw_system_facts: [`Требуется уточнение: ${router_output.clarification_msg}`],
125:       system_facts: [`Требуется уточнение: ${router_output.clarification_msg}`],
126:     };
127:   }
128: 
129:   // ============================================
130:   // Прогон всех действий через хендлеры
131:   // ============================================
132:   const action_results: ActionResult[] = [];
133:   const mutations: EngineMutation[] = [];
134:   const raw_system_facts: string[] = [];
135: 
136:   for (const action of router_output.actions) {
137:     const handlerResult = processAction(action, context);
138:     action_results.push(handlerResult.result);
139:     mutations.push(...handlerResult.mutations);
140:     raw_system_facts.push(...handlerResult.system_facts);
141:   }
142: 
143:   // ============================================
144:   // ADVANCE_TIME
145:   // ============================================
146:   if (router_output.time_estimate_minutes > 0) {
147:     mutations.push({
148:       type: "ADVANCE_TIME",
149:       minutes: router_output.time_estimate_minutes,
150:     });
151:     raw_system_facts.push(`Прошло ${router_output.time_estimate_minutes} минут игрового времени.`);
152:   }
153: 
154:   // ============================================
155:   // Случайный энкаунтер
156:   // ============================================
157:   let encounter_triggered: EncounterTriggered = { triggered: false };
158:   if (router_output.encounter_intent.type === "random") {
159:     encounter_triggered = rollEncounter(session.difficulty);
160:     if (encounter_triggered.triggered) {
161:       raw_system_facts.push(
162:         `🎲 Случайный энкаунтер! Появилось: ${encounter_triggered.creature_name} (тир ${encounter_triggered.tier}).`
163:       );
164:     }
165:   } else if (router_output.encounter_intent.type === "targeted" && router_output.encounter_intent.target_name) {
166:     raw_system_facts.push(`Целевой энкаунтер: ${router_output.encounter_intent.target_name}.`);
167:   }
168: 
169:   return {
170:     success: true,
171:     action_results,
172:     mutations,
173:     encounter_triggered,
174:     raw_system_facts,
175:     system_facts: raw_system_facts,
176:   };
177: }

  1: // supabase/functions/process-turn/engine/types.ts
  2: // Типы для Шага 2: Математическое Ядро (D&D Engine)
  3: 
  4: import { RouterOutputPayload, RouterAction } from "../types.ts";
  5: 
  6: // ============================================
  7: // Снимок игрока для движка
  8: // ============================================
  9: export interface EnginePlayer {
 10:   id: string;
 11:   name: string;
 12:   stats: Record<string, number>; // STR, DEX, CON, INT, WIS, CHA
 13:   hp: number;
 14:   max_hp: number;
 15:   armor_class: number;
 16:   initiative: number;
 17:   level: number;
 18:   inventory: EngineInventoryItem[];
 19:   injuries: EngineInjury[];
 20:   skills?: Record<string, { level: number; effects: Record<string, number> }>;
 21: }
 22: 
 23: export interface EngineInventoryItem {
 24:   id: string;
 25:   item_name: string;
 26:   type: string; // weapon, armor, consumable, tool, material, misc
 27:   quantity: number;
 28:   durability?: number | null;
 29:   condition?: string | null;
 30:   attributes?: Record<string, any> | null; // может содержать damage_dice
 31: }
 32: 
 33: export interface EngineInjury {
 34:   stat_penalties?: Record<string, number>;
 35:   duration_hours?: number;
 36: }
 37: 
 38: // ============================================
 39: // Снимок NPC для движка
 40: // ============================================
 41: export interface EngineNpc {
 42:   id: string;
 43:   name: string;
 44:   race: string;
 45:   hp: number;
 46:   max_hp: number;
 47:   armor_class: number;
 48:   level: number;
 49:   stats: Record<string, number>;
 50:   is_hostile: boolean;
 51:   is_alive: boolean;
 52: }
 53: 
 54: export interface EngineLocationItem {
 55:   id: string;
 56:   item_name: string;
 57:   type: string;
 58:   quantity: number;
 59: }
 60: 
 61: // ============================================
 62: // Цели
 63: // ============================================
 64: export interface EngineTargets {
 65:   players: Map<string, EnginePlayer>;
 66:   npcs: Map<string, EngineNpc>;
 67:   location_items: Map<string, EngineLocationItem>;
 68: }
 69: 
 70: // ============================================
 71: // Снимок сессии
 72: // ============================================
 73: export interface EngineSession {
 74:   id: string;
 75:   difficulty: "easy" | "normal" | "hard";
 76:   is_pvp_enabled: boolean;
 77:   game_year: number;
 78:   game_month: number;
 79:   game_day: number;
 80:   game_hour: number;
 81:   game_minute: number;
 82:   current_location_id: string | null;
 83: }
 84: 
 85: // ============================================
 86: // Входной контекст движка
 87: // ============================================
 88: export interface EngineInputContext {
 89:   router_output: RouterOutputPayload;
 90:   session: EngineSession;
 91:   acting_player: EnginePlayer;
 92:   targets: EngineTargets;
 93: }
 94: 
 95: // ============================================
 96: // Атомарные мутации (для Шага 3 — DB Transaction)
 97: // ============================================
 98: export type EngineMutation =
 99:   | { type: "UPDATE_HP"; target_type: "player" | "npc"; id: string; delta: number }
100:   | { type: "UPDATE_DURABILITY"; item_id: string; delta: number; set_broken?: boolean }
101:   | { type: "DELETE_ITEM"; item_id: string; quantity: number }
102:   | { type: "INSERT_ITEM"; owner_id: string; owner_type: "player" | "npc" | "location"; item: any }
103:   | { type: "TRANSFER_ITEM"; item_id: string; from_id: string; to_id: string; from_type: "player" | "npc" | "location"; to_type: "player" | "npc" | "location"; quantity: number }
104:   | { type: "SPAWN_STRUCTURE"; location_id: string; structure: any }
105:   | { type: "ADVANCE_TIME"; minutes: number };
106: 
107: // ============================================
108: // Результат одного действия
109: // ============================================
110: export interface ActionResult {
111:   action_type: string;
112:   success: boolean;
113:   blocked?: boolean;
114:   block_reason?: string;
115:   dice_roll?: {
116:     d20: number;
117:     modifier: number;
118:     total: number;
119:     target_dc: number;
120:     is_crit?: boolean;
121:     is_fumble?: boolean;
122:     success?: boolean;
123:   };
124:   damage_dealt?: number;
125:   details: string;
126: }
127: 
128: // ============================================
129: // Энкаунтер
130: // ============================================
131: export interface EncounterTriggered {
132:   triggered: boolean;
133:   tier?: number;
134:   creature_name?: string;
135: }
136: 
137: // ============================================
138: // Выход движка
139: // ============================================
140: export interface EngineOutputPayload {
141:   success: boolean;
142:   action_results: ActionResult[];
143:   mutations: EngineMutation[];
144:   encounter_triggered: EncounterTriggered;
145:   raw_system_facts: string[];
146:   system_facts?: string[];
147: }
148: 
149: // ============================================
150: // Интерфейс обработчика действия (Command Pattern)
151: // ============================================
152: export interface ActionHandler {
153:   /**
154:    * Тип действия, который обрабатывает хендлер
155:    */
156:   readonly action_type: string;
157: 
158:   /**
159:    * Обрабатывает действие и возвращает результат + мутации
160:    */
161:   handle(action: RouterAction, context: EngineInputContext): ActionHandlerResult;
162: }
163: 
164: export interface ActionHandlerResult {
165:   result: ActionResult;
166:   mutations: EngineMutation[];
167:   system_facts: string[];
168: }

  4: describe("parseAIJson", () => {

  7:   });
  8: 
  9:   it("parses JSON array", () => {

 11:   });
 12:

 16:   });
 17: 
 18:   it("extracts JSON from generic markdown block", () => {

 21:   });
 22: 
 23:   it("extracts first JSON object from mixed text", () => {

 64:   });
 65:

 72:     const input = "Check this image.png and a very long base64 string A".repeat(50);

 74:     expect(cleaned).not.toContain("image.png");

 76:     expect(cleaned.length).toBeLessThan(input.length);
 77:   });
 78:

 85:   });

143: describe("Wild Zone NPC Isolation: Town NPCs stay in town", () => {
144:   it("filters out town merchants and citizens when in a wild zone", () => {
145:     const isCompanionNpc = (n: any) => {
146:       const role = (n.role || "").toLowerCase();
147:       const tags = Array.isArray(n.status_tags) ? n.status_tags.map((t: string) => String(t).toLowerCase()) : [];
148:       return role === "companion" || role === "спутник" || tags.some((t: string) => ["companion", "спутник", "в_отряде", "питомец", "приручен"].includes(t));
149:     };
150: 
151:     const allNpcs = [
152:       { id: "gordon", name: "Гордон", role: "secondary", status_tags: ["торговец"], is_hostile: false },
153:       { id: "blacksmith", name: "Кузнец Торвальд", role: "secondary", status_tags: ["кузнец"], is_hostile: false },
154:       { id: "companion-1", name: "Лидия", role: "companion", status_tags: ["спутник", "в_отряде"], is_hostile: false },
155:       { id: "wolf", name: "Лесной волк", role: "mob", status_tags: ["дикий", "зверь"], is_hostile: true },
156:     ];
157: 
158:     const currentWildZone = "Лес у Ривервуда";
159: 
160:     const filtered = currentWildZone
161:       ? allNpcs.filter((n) =>
162:           isCompanionNpc(n) ||
163:           n.is_hostile === true ||
164:           (Array.isArray(n.status_tags) && n.status_tags.some((t: string) => ["дикий", "монстр", "дикая_зона", "зверь", "хищник"].includes(String(t).toLowerCase())))
165:         )
166:       : allNpcs;
167: 
168:     expect(filtered).toHaveLength(2);
169:     expect(filtered.map((n) => n.name)).toEqual(["Лидия", "Лесной волк"]);
170:     expect(filtered.some((n) => n.name === "Гордон")).toBe(false);
171:     expect(filtered.some((n) => n.name === "Кузнец Торвальд")).toBe(false);
172:   });
173: });

 51: function makeContext(overrides: Partial<EngineInputContext> = {}): EngineInputContext {
 52:   const player = overrides.acting_player || makePlayer();
 53:   const npc = makeNpc();
 54:   const playerMap = new Map([[player.id, player]]);
 55:   const npcMap = new Map([[npc.id, npc]]);
 56: 
 57:   return {
 58:     router_output: overrides.router_output || {
 59:       status: "success",
 60:       clarification_msg: null,
 61:       actions: [],
 62:       encounter_intent: { type: "none", target_name: null },
 63:       time_estimate_minutes: 0,
 64:       atmosphere: { sounds: [], visuals: [] },
 65:     },
 66:     session: overrides.session || {
 67:       id: "session-1",
 68:       difficulty: "normal",
 69:       is_pvp_enabled: false,
 70:       game_year: 1, game_month: 1, game_day: 1,
 71:       game_hour: 8, game_minute: 0,
 72:       current_location_id: "loc-1",
 73:     },
 74:     acting_player: player,
 75:     targets: overrides.targets || {
 76:       players: playerMap,
 77:       npcs: npcMap,
 78:       location_items: new Map(),
 79:     },
 80:   };
 81: }
 82: 
 83: function makeRouterOutput(actions: any[], opts: Partial<RouterOutputPayload> = {}): RouterOutputPayload {

 85:     status: "success",
 86:     clarification_msg: null,
 87:     actions,
 88:     encounter_intent: { type: "none", target_name: null },
 89:     time_estimate_minutes: 0,
 90:     atmosphere: { sounds: [], visuals: [] },
 91:     ...opts,
 92:   };

132:     // Тестируем логику crit/fumble без мока Math.random (ненадёжен в Vitest)
133:     // Создаём 1000 бросков и считаем статистику
134:     let crits = 0, fumbles = 0, successes = 0;
135:     for (let i = 0; i < 1000; i++) {
136:       const r = performAttackRoll({ target_dc: 50, stat_modifier: 0 });
137:       if (r.is_crit) crits++;
138:       if (r.is_fumble) fumbles++;
139:       if (r.success) successes++;
140:     }
141: 
142:     // crit и fumble должны быть ~5% каждый (1/20)
143:     expect(crits).toBeGreaterThan(20);
144:     expect(crits).toBeLessThan(80);
145:     expect(fumbles).toBeGreaterThan(20);
146:     expect(fumbles).toBeLessThan(80);
147:     // При DC=50 и mod=0 — успехи только от crit (~5%)
148:     expect(successes).toBeGreaterThan(20);
149:     expect(successes).toBeLessThan(80);
150:   });
151:

153:     // Используем [5, 18] через прямое присваивание
154:     const adv = { rolls: [5, 18] as [number, number], best: 18 };
155:     const dis = { rolls: [5, 18] as [number, number], worst: 5 };
156: 
157:     expect(adv.best).toBeGreaterThan(adv.rolls[0]);
158:     expect(dis.worst).toBeLessThan(dis.rolls[1]);
159: 
160:     // Реальный вызов: 2 броска d20 в диапазоне 1-20
161:     for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
162:       const a = rollD20Advantage();
163:       const d = rollD20Disadvantage();
164:       expect(a.rolls).toHaveLength(2);
165:       expect(d.rolls).toHaveLength(2);
166:       expect(a.best).toBe(Math.max(a.rolls[0], a.rolls[1]));
167:       expect(d.worst).toBe(Math.min(d.rolls[0], d.rolls[1]));
168:       expect(a.rolls[0]).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
169:       expect(a.rolls[0]).toBeLessThanOrEqual(20);
170:     }
171:   });
