147:     const npcs = parsed.npcs;
148: 
149:     if (!world_id || !Array.isArray(npcs) || npcs.length === 0) {
150:       return new Response(
151:         JSON.stringify({ error: "world_id и npcs обязательны" }),
152:         { status: 400, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" } },
153:       );
154:     }
155: 
156:     console.log(`[save-npcs:${requestId}] 💾 Saving ${npcs.length} NPCs to world ${world_id}`);
157: 
158:     const supabase = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY);
159:     const npcsToInsert = npcs.map(npc => cleanNPC(npc, world_id));
160:

168:       return new Response(
169:         JSON.stringify({ error: "Ошибка сохранения", details: insertError.message }),
170:         { status: 500, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" } },
171:       );
172:     }
173: 
174:     console.log(`[save-npcs:${requestId}] ✅ Saved ${insertedNpcs.length} NPCs`);
175: 
176:     return new Response(
177:       JSON.stringify({ success: true, count: insertedNpcs.length, npcs: insertedNpcs }),
178:       { status: 200, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" } },
179:     );
180:   } catch (err) {
181:     console.error(`[save-npcs:${requestId}] ❌ Error:`, err);
182:     return new Response(
183:       JSON.stringify({ error: err.message || "Internal error" }),
184:       { status: 500, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" } },
185:     );
186:   }
187: });

   1: // src/api/openrouter.js — Прямые запросы к OpenRouter (без лимитов Supabase)
   2: import { OPENROUTER_API_KEY, AI_MODEL, CARD_GENERATION_MODELS, calculateDerivedStats, getRaceAcBonus } from '../config.js';
   3: import { DAMAGE_TYPES, getDamageType, canBeDot, canHalfOnSave, getSaveAbility } from '../config/damageTypes.js';
   4: import { generateDamageDice, rollDice, getAverageDamage } from '../utils/dice.js';
   5: import { getHitDice, calculateHpDnd, getDieAverage } from '../config/hitDice.js';
   6: import { supabase, invokeFunction } from './supabase.js';
   7: import { saveGenerationProgress, loadGenerationProgress, clearGenerationProgress } from '../utils/generationStore.js';
   8: import { saveProgress, loadProgress, deleteProgress } from '../utils/indexedDB.js';
   9: import { resolveNpcRace } from '../utils/npcRaceResolver.js';
  10: 
  11: const OPENROUTER_CHAT_URL = 'https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions';
  12: 
  13: // ===================== NPC STATS CALCULATION =====================
  14: 
  15: /**
  16:  * Calculate all derived combat stats for an NPC/creature
  17:  * 
  18:  * SYSTEM:
  19:  * - Tier (1-5) = POTENTIAL — max capability, determines special attacks count
  20:  * - Level (1-100) = CURRENT POWER — how much of potential is realized
  21:  * - Stat sum: 50 (level 1, tier 1) to 200 (level 100, tier 5)
  22:  * - Player starts at 72 stat sum, so creatures can be weaker or stronger
  23:  * 
  24:  * @param {object} stats - Raw stats {STR, DEX, CON, INT, WIS, CHA}
  25:  * @param {string} race - Race name
  26:  * @param {number} tier - Potential tier (1-5)
  27:  * @param {number} level - Current level (1-100)
  28:  * @returns {object} { level, armor_class, initiative, saving_throws, stat_sum }
  29:  */
  30: export function calculateNPCCombatStats(stats = {}, race = 'Человек', tier = 1, level = 1) {
  31:   const safeStats = {
  32:     STR: Number.isFinite(Number(stats.STR)) ? Math.round(Number(stats.STR)) : 10,
  33:     DEX: Number.isFinite(Number(stats.DEX)) ? Math.round(Number(stats.DEX)) : 10,
  34:     CON: Number.isFinite(Number(stats.CON)) ? Math.round(Number(stats.CON)) : 10,
  35:     INT: Number.isFinite(Number(stats.INT)) ? Math.round(Number(stats.INT)) : 10,
  36:     WIS: Number.isFinite(Number(stats.WIS)) ? Math.round(Number(stats.WIS)) : 10,
  37:     CHA: Number.isFinite(Number(stats.CHA)) ? Math.round(Number(stats.CHA)) : 10,
  38:   };
  39: 
  40:   const dexMod = Math.floor((safeStats.DEX - 10) / 2);
  41:   const raceBonus = getRaceAcBonus(race);
  42:   
  43:   // AC: 10 + DEX mod + race bonus (same as player)
  44:   const armorClass = 10 + dexMod + raceBonus;
  45:   
  46:   // Initiative: DEX modifier
  47:   const initiative = dexMod;
  48:   
  49:   // Saving throws: stat modifier + proficiency bonus (based on level)
  50:   const proficiencyBonus = Math.ceil(level / 4) + 1;
  51:   const savingThrows = {};
  52:   for (const stat of ['STR', 'DEX', 'CON', 'INT', 'WIS', 'CHA']) {
  53:     const mod = Math.floor((safeStats[stat] - 10) / 2);
  54:     savingThrows[stat] = mod + proficiencyBonus;
  55:   }
  56:   
  57:   // Calculate stat sum for reference
  58:   const stat_sum = Object.values(safeStats).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  59:   
  60:   return {
  61:     level,
  62:     armor_class: armorClass,
  63:     initiative,
  64:     saving_throws: savingThrows,
  65:     stat_sum,
  66:   };
  67: }
  68: 
  69: /**
  70:  * Calculate expected stat sum for a creature at given level/tier
  71:  * Base 50 at level 1 tier 1, +2 per level, +10 per tier, max 200
  72:  */
  73: export function getExpectedStatSum(level = 1, tier = 1) {
  74:   return Math.min(200, 50 + ((level - 1) * 2) + ((tier - 1) * 10));
  75: }
  76: 
  77: /**
  78:  * Calculate HP using D&D hit dice system
  79:  * Level 1: max die + CON mod + 10
  80:  * Each next: average die + CON mod
  81:  */
  82: export function calculateCreatureHp(con = 10, level = 1, tier = 1, hitDie = 8) {
  83:   return calculateHpDnd(con, level, hitDie);
  84: }
  85: 
  86: /**
  87:  * Get special attacks count by tier (Tier 1 = 1, Tier 5 = 5)
  88:  */
  89: export function getSpecialAttacksCount(tier = 1) {
  90:   return Math.max(1, Math.min(5, tier));
  91: }
  92: 
  93: /**
  94:  * Get base attacks count by level (2 per 10 levels)
  95:  */
  96: export function getBaseAttacksCount(level = 1) {
  97:   return Math.max(2, Math.min(10, 2 + Math.floor((level - 1) / 10)));
  98: }
  99: 
 100: /**
 101:  * Очищает и нормализует атаку в формате D&D
 102:  * @param {object} attack - сырые данные атаки
 103:  * @param {boolean} isSpecial - спецатака (больше урона)
 104:  * @param {number} tier - тир существа
 105:  * @param {number} level - уровень существа
 106:  * @returns {object} очищенная атака
 107:  */
 108: export function cleanAttack(attack = {}, isSpecial = false, tier = 1, level = 1) {
 109:   // Валидация типа урона
 110:   const damageTypeId = DAMAGE_TYPES[attack.damage_type] ? attack.damage_type : 'slashing';
 111:   const damageType = DAMAGE_TYPES[damageTypeId];
 112:   
 113:   // Генерация кубиков урона если не указаны
 114:   let damageDice = attack.damage_dice || attack.damage || generateDamageDice(level, tier, isSpecial);
 115:   
 116:   // Валидация формата кубиков
 117:   if (!/^\d+d\d+([+-]\d+)?$/.test(damageDice)) {
 118:     damageDice = generateDamageDice(level, tier, isSpecial);
 119:   }
 120:   
 121:   // DoT параметры (только для типов урона поддерживающих DoT)
 122:   const canDot = damageType.dot === true;
 123:   const isDot = canDot && (attack.is_dot === true || attack.is_damage_over_time === true);
 124:   
 125:   return {
 126:     name: (attack.name || (isSpecial ? 'Спецатака' : 'Атака')).slice(0, 50),
 127:     description: (attack.description || attack.desc || '').slice(0, 200),
 128:     damage_type: damageTypeId,
 129:     damage_type_name: damageType.name,
 130:     damage_dice: damageDice,
 131:     damage_bonus: Number(attack.damage_bonus) || 0,
 132:     is_special: isSpecial,
 133:     // DoT (Damage Over Time)
 134:     is_dot: isDot,
 135:     dot_name: isDot ? (attack.dot_name || damageType.dotName || 'Урон') : null,
 136:     dot_duration: isDot ? (Number(attack.dot_duration) || damageType.dotDefaultDuration || 2) : 0,
 137:     dot_damage_dice: isDot ? (attack.dot_damage_dice || damageDice) : null,
 138:     // Спасбросок
 139:     half_on_save: damageType.halfOnSave,
 140:     save_ability: damageType.saveAbility || null,
 141:     // Дополнительно
 142:     range: attack.range || (isSpecial ? '30 футов' : '5 футов'),
 143:     effects: Array.isArray(attack.effects) ? attack.effects.slice(0, 3) : [],
 144:   };
 145: }
 146: 
 147: /**
 148:  * Генерирует атаки для существа на основе его параметров
 149:  * @param {number} tier - тир (количество спецатак)
 150:  * @param {number} level - уровень (количество базовых атак)
 151:  * @param {string} category - категория существа
 152:  * @param {string} race - раса
 153:  * @returns {object} { special_attacks, base_attacks }
 154:  */
 155: export function generateAttacksForCreature(tier, level, category = 'monster', race = 'Чудовище') {
 156:   const specialCount = getSpecialAttacksCount(tier);
 157:   const baseCount = getBaseAttacksCount(level);
 158:   
 159:   // Типы урона по умолчанию для категорий
 160:   const defaultTypes = {
 161:     beast: ['piercing', 'slashing'],
 162:     monster: ['bludgeoning', 'piercing', 'slashing'],
 163:     boss: ['fire', 'cold', 'lightning', 'necrotic', 'force'],
 164:   };
 165:   
 166:   const availableTypes = defaultTypes[category] || defaultTypes.monster;
 167:   
 168:   const specialAttacks = [];
 169:   const baseAttacks = [];
 170:   
 171:   // Генерация спецатак
 172:   for (let i = 0; i < specialCount; i++) {
 173:     const typeIdx = i % availableTypes.length;
 174:     specialAttacks.push({
 175:       name: `Спецатака ${i + 1}`,
 176:       description: 'Мощная специальная атака',
 177:       damage_type: availableTypes[typeIdx],
 178:       damage_dice: generateDamageDice(level, tier, true),
 179:       is_special: true,
 180:       is_dot: DAMAGE_TYPES[availableTypes[typeIdx]]?.dot || false,
 181:       dot_duration: DAMAGE_TYPES[availableTypes[typeIdx]]?.dotDefaultDuration || 2,
 182:     });
 183:   }
 184:   
 185:   // Генерация базовых атак
 186:   for (let i = 0; i < baseCount; i++) {
 187:     const typeIdx = i % availableTypes.length;
 188:     baseAttacks.push({
 189:       name: `Атака ${i + 1}`,
 190:       description: 'Базовая атака',
 191:       damage_type: availableTypes[typeIdx],
 192:       damage_dice: generateDamageDice(level, tier, false),
 193:       is_special: false,
 194:     });
 195:   }
 196:   
 197:   return { special_attacks: specialAttacks, base_attacks: baseAttacks };
 198: }

 200: // Get user settings (API key + models)
 201: async function getUserSettings() {
 202:   const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
 203:   if (session?.user?.id) {
 204:     const { data } = await supabase
 205:       .from('user_settings')
 206:       .select('openrouter_key, card_model, dm_model')
 207:       .eq('id', session.user.id)
 208:       .maybeSingle();
 209:     return data || {};
 210:   }
 211:   return {};
 212: }

 214: // Get API key from user settings or fallback

 217:   return settings.openrouter_key || OPENROUTER_API_KEY;
 218: }

 226: // Call OpenRouter directly from frontend (no Edge Function limits)
 227: export async function callOpenRouter(systemPrompt, userMessage, options = {}) {
 228:   const apiKey = await getApiKey();
 229:   if (!apiKey) {
 230:     throw new Error('Укажите OpenRouter API Key в настройках аккаунта');
 231:   }
 232: 
 233:   // Use specified model or get from user settings
 234:   const model = options.model || await getCardModel();
 235:   
 236:   // Determine provider based on model
 237:   const getProvider = (modelId) => {
 238:     if (modelId.includes('xiaomi')) return ['Xiaomi'];
 239:     if (modelId.includes('z-ai')) return ['Z-AI'];
 240:     if (modelId.includes('thinkingmachines')) return ['Thinking Machines'];
 241:     if (modelId.includes('minimax')) return ['MiniMax'];
 242:     if (modelId.includes('meta-llama')) return ['Meta'];
 243:     if (modelId === 'openrouter/free') return []; // Auto-select
 244:     return ['Xiaomi']; // default
 245:   };
 246: 
 247:   const requestBody = {
 248:     model,
 249:     messages: [
 250:       { role: 'system', content: systemPrompt },
 251:       { role: 'user', content: userMessage },
 252:     ],
 253:     temperature: options.temperature ?? 0.7,
 254:     provider: {
 255:       order: getProvider(model),
 256:       allow_fallbacks: options.allow_fallbacks ?? false,
 257:     },
 258:     reasoning: {
 259:       effort: options.reasoningEffort || 'low',
 260:     },
 261:   };
 262: 
 263:   console.log('[callOpenRouter] Request:', {
 264:     model: requestBody.model,
 265:     provider: requestBody.provider,
 266:     reasoning: requestBody.reasoning,
 267:     userMsgLength: userMessage.length,
 268:   });
 269: 
 270:   console.log('[callOpenRouter] Request:', {
 271:     model: requestBody.model,
 272:     provider: requestBody.provider,
 273:     reasoning: requestBody.reasoning,
 274:     userMsgLength: userMessage.length,
 275:     systemMsgLength: systemPrompt.length,
 276:   });
 277: 
 278:   const response = await fetch(OPENROUTER_CHAT_URL, {
 279:     method: 'POST',
 280:     headers: {
 281:       'Authorization': `Bearer ${apiKey}`,
 282:       'Content-Type': 'application/json',
 283:       'HTTP-Referer': window.location.origin,
 284:       'X-Title': 'MultiRP-AI',
 285:     },
 286:     body: JSON.stringify(requestBody),
 287:   });
 288: 
 289:   if (!response.ok) {
 290:     const errText = await response.text();
 291:     throw new Error(`OpenRouter error: ${response.status} - ${errText}`);
 292:   }
 293: 
 294:   const data = await response.json();
 295:   console.log('[callOpenRouter] Response:', {
 296:     provider: data.provider,
 297:     model: data.model,
 298:     reasoningTokens: data.usage?.completion_tokens_details?.reasoning_tokens,
 299:     totalTokens: data.usage?.total_tokens,
 300:     contentLength: data.choices?.[0]?.message?.content?.length,
 301:   });
 302:   return data.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || '';
 303: }

 305: // Count NPCs in text
 306: export async function countNPCs(loreText) {
 307:   const SYSTEM_PROMPT = `Подсчитай сколько NPC, существ, монстров и животных упоминается в тексте.
 308: Ответь ТОЛЬКО одним числом (например: 22). Никакого текста, только число.`;
 309: 
 310:   const response = await callOpenRouter(SYSTEM_PROMPT, loreText);
 311:   console.log('[countNPCs] Raw response:', response);
 312:   const match = response.match(/\d+/);
 313:   const count = match ? parseInt(match[0], 10) : 0;
 314:   console.log('[countNPCs] Parsed count:', count);
 315:   return count;
 316: }

 318: // Generate world geography (states and cities)
 319: export async function generateWorldGeography(loreText, worldId, onProgress = () => {}) {
 320:   console.log('[generateWorldGeography] Starting, loreText length:', loreText.length);
 321:   
 322:   const SYSTEM_PROMPT = `На основе описания мира создай географию: государства и города.
 323: Правила:
 324: - Если в тексте уже упоминаются государства/королевства/регионы — используй ВСЕ их (сколько бы их ни было)
 325: - Если в тексте нет упоминаний государств — создай 3 новых государства
 326: - Для каждого государства создай минимум 6 локаций: 1 столица (type: capital) + 5 городов/деревень/руин/достопримечательностей (type: city, village, ruins, landmark)
 327: - Названия должны быть уникальными и соответствовать сеттингу мира
 328: - Описания краткие, но атмосферные (1-2 предложения)
 329: - ВСЕ названия и описания должны быть на русском языке
 330: 
 331: Верни ТОЛЬКО JSON объект:
 332: {
 333:   "states": [{"name": "Название государства", "description": "Описание"}],
 334:   "locations": [{"name": "Название локации", "type": "capital|city|village|ruins|landmark", "state_name": "Название государства", "description": "Описание"}]
 335: }`;
 336: 
 337:   onProgress({ step: 'geography_start', message: 'Генерация государств и городов...' });
 338:   
 339:   const response = await callOpenRouter(SYSTEM_PROMPT, loreText);
 340:   
 341:   let parsed;
 342:   try {
 343:     parsed = JSON.parse(response);
 344:   } catch {
 345:     const jsonMatch = response.match(/```(?:json)?\s*\n?([\s\S]*?)\n?```/);
 346:     if (jsonMatch) {
 347:       parsed = JSON.parse(jsonMatch[1]);
 348:     } else {
 349:       const objMatch = response.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/);
 350:       if (objMatch) {
 351:         parsed = JSON.parse(objMatch[0]);
 352:       } else {
 353:         throw new Error('Не удалось распарсить ответ географии');
 354:       }
 355:     }
 356:   }
 357:   
 358:   if (!parsed.states || !parsed.locations) {
 359:     throw new Error('Некорректный формат ответа географии');
 360:   }
 361:   
 362:   console.log('[generateWorldGeography] Generated:', parsed.states.length, 'states,', parsed.locations.length, 'locations');
 363:   onProgress({ step: 'geography_done', states: parsed.states.length, locations: parsed.locations.length });
 364:   
 365:   return parsed;
 366: }
 367: 
 368: // Save geography to DB
 369: export async function saveWorldGeography(worldId, geography) {
 370:   console.log('[saveWorldGeography] Saving geography for world:', worldId);
 371:   
 372:   
 373:   // Insert states
 374:   const statesToInsert = geography.states.map(s => ({
 375:     world_id: worldId,
 376:     name: s.name,
 377:     description: s.description || '',
 378:   }));
 379:   
 380:   const { data: insertedStates, error: statesError } = await supabase
 381:     .from('states')
 382:     .insert(statesToInsert)
 383:     .select();
 384:   
 385:   if (statesError) {
 386:     console.error('[saveWorldGeography] States error:', statesError);
 387:     throw statesError;
 388:   }
 389:   
 390:   console.log('[saveWorldGeography] Saved', insertedStates.length, 'states');
 391:   
 392:   // Create state name -> id mapping
 393:   const stateMap = {};
 394:   insertedStates.forEach(s => {
 395:     stateMap[s.name] = s.id;
 396:   });
 397:   
 398:   // Insert locations
 399:   const locationsToInsert = geography.locations.map(l => ({
 400:     state_id: stateMap[l.state_name] || insertedStates[0]?.id,
 401:     name: l.name,
 402:     type: l.type || 'city',
 403:     description: l.description || '',
 404:   }));
 405:   
 406:   const { data: insertedLocations, error: locationsError } = await supabase
 407:     .from('locations')
 408:     .insert(locationsToInsert)
 409:     .select();
 410:   
 411:   if (locationsError) {
 412:     console.error('[saveWorldGeography] Locations error:', locationsError);
 413:     throw locationsError;
 414:   }
 415:   
 416:   console.log('[saveWorldGeography] Saved', insertedLocations.length, 'locations');
 417:   
 418:   return { states: insertedStates, locations: insertedLocations };
 419: }

 421: // Generate a batch of NPCs with geography context
 422: export async function generateNPCBatch(loreText, startIdx, endIdx, totalCount, existingNames = [], geography = null) {
 423:   const geographyContext = geography ? `
 424: Доступные государства и локации мира:
 425: ${geography.states.map(s => `- ${s.name}: ${geography.locations.filter(l => l.state_name === s.name).map(l => l.name).join(', ')}`).join('\n')}
 426: 
 427: Для каждого NPC определи:
 428: 1. category: 'npc' (разумное существо), 'beast' (зверь), 'monster' (монстр), или 'boss' (босс)
 429: 2. location_name: название локации (только для category='npc')
 430: 3. state_name: название государства (для всех категорий)
 431: 
 432: Для зверей, монстров и боссов указывай только state_name (не location_name).
 433: Для разумных NPC указывай и location_name, и state_name.` : '';
 434: 
 435:   const SYSTEM_PROMPT = `Извлеки из текста указанных NPC и сгенерируй для них характеристики.
 436: 
 437: ## СИСТЕМА ПОТЕНЦИАЛА И УРОВНЯ
 438: TIER (1-5) = ПОТЕНЦИАЛ существа (максимальные возможности):
 439: - Tier 1: Слабые существа (крысы, слизни, гоблины)
 440: - Tier 2: Обычные существа (волки, орки, тролли)
 441: - Tier 3: Сильные существа (огры, демоны, молодые драконы)
 442: - Tier 4: Элитные существа (древние драконы, вампиры, лорды)
 443: - Tier 5: Легендарные существа (божества, титаны, древнейшие драконы)
 444: 
 445: LEVEL (1-100) = ТЕКУЩАЯ СИЛА (насколько раскрыт потенциал):
 446: - Детеныш дракона: Tier 5, но Level 1 (слаб, но имеет потенциал)
 447: - Взрослый дракон: Tier 5, Level 80 (могуществен)
 448: - Существо может быть любого уровня в пределах своего Tier
 449: 
 450: ## ДИАПАЗОНЫ УРОВНЕЙ ПО ВИДАМ
 451: Примеры для шаблонов:
 452: - Слизь: 1-10 ур
 453: - Волк: 5-15 ур
 454: - Орк: 10-25 ур
 455: - Тролль: 15-35 ур
 456: - Дракон: 50-100 ур
 457: - Демон: 30-80 ур
 458: 
 459: ## ХАРАКТЕРИСТИКИ
 460: Сумма статов (STR+DEX+CON+INT+WIS+CHA):
 461: - Уровень 1, Tier 1: ~50 (слабее игрока)
 462: - Уровень 100, Tier 5: ~200 (значительно сильнее игрока)
 463: - Игрок начинает с 72
 464: 
 465: Спецатаки: 1 на каждый Tier (Tier 1 = 1 спецатака, Tier 5 = 5 спецатак)
 466: Базовые атаки: 2-3 на каждые 10 уровней (level 1-10 = 2, level 11-20 = 3, и т.д.)
 467: 
 468: ## КОСТЬ ХИТОВ (HIT DICE) — D&D система
 469: Определяет HP: Уровень 1 = макс кости + CON mod + 10, каждый следующий = среднее + CON mod
 470: - d6 (4 среднее): волшебник, чародей, маг
 471: - d8 (5 среднее): бард, жрец, друид, монах, плут, шаман
 472: - d10 (6 среднее): воин, паладин, следопыт, наемник, рыцарь
 473: - d12 (7 среднее): варвар, берсерк
 474: Для зверей/монстров: d8 по умолчанию, d10 для боссов
 475: 
 476: ## ДИАПАЗОН УРОВНЕЙ (для неуникальных существ)
 477: Если существо НЕ уникально (is_unique: false), укажи диапазон уровней:
 478: - level_min: минимальный уровень при спавне
 479: - level_max: максимальный уровень при спавне
 480: - level: конкретный уровень (для уникальных) или среднее значение
 481: 
 482: Примеры:
 483: - Слизь: 1-10 ур
 484: - Волк: 5-15 ур
 485: - Орк: 10-25 ур
 486: - Тролль: 15-35 ур
 487: - Дракон: 50-100 ур
 488: 
 489: При спавне в игре уровень выбирается случайно из диапазона [level_min, level_max].
 490: 
 491: ## ТИПЫ ПЕРСОНАЖЕЙ (ROLE)
 492: - 'main' — главные персонажи (протагонисты, антагонисты, ключевые фигуры)
 493: - 'secondary' — второстепенные (спутники, торговцы, стражники)
 494: - 'tertiary' — третьестепенные (звери, монстры, рядовые враги)
 495: 
 496: ## КАТЕГОРИИ
 497: - 'npc' — разумные существа (люди, эльфы, гномы, орки), role: main/secondary
 498: - 'beast' — животные/звери (волки, медведи, драконы), role: tertiary
 499: - 'monster' — монстры (гоблины, тролли, скелеты), role: tertiary
 500: - 'boss' — могущественные (короли демонов, древние драконы), role: main/secondary
 501: 
 502: ## ПРАВИЛА ИМЕНОВАНИЯ
 503: ГЛАВНОЕ ПРАВИЛО: Зверям и монстрам имя НЕ ДАВАТЬ!
 504: - Только название вида: "Волк", "Гоблин", "Дракон", "Скелет"
 505: - Имя даётся ТОЛЬКО: NPC-людям/эльфам/гномам (всегда) и уникальным боссам (is_unique: true)
 506: - Стаям (is_pack: true) имя не дают — это группа существ
 507: 
 508: ## АТАКИ (D&D система)
 509: У каждой атаки есть:
 510: - name: название атаки
 511: - description: описание для ДМ
 512: - damage_type: тип урона (slashing/piercing/bludgeoning/fire/cold/lightning/thunder/acid/poison/necrotic/radiant/psychic/force)
 513: - damage_dice: кубики урона (1d6, 2d8+3, 3d4, etc.)
 514: - is_dot: true если урон каждый ход (fire/acid/poison)
 515: - dot_duration: длительность в ходах (2-5)
 516: - half_on_save: можно спастись наполовину
 517: - save_ability: способность спасброска (DEX/CON/WIS)
 518: 
 519: Спецатаки (special_attacks): 1 на каждый Tier (Tier 5 = 5 спецатак)
 520: Базовые атаки (base_attacks): 2 на уровни 1-10, +1 за каждые 10 уровней
 521: 
 522: Типы урона:
 523: - slashing (режущий), piercing (колющий), bludgeoning (дробящий) — физические
 524: - fire (огонь) — DoT 2-3 хода
 525: - cold (холод) — замедление
 526: - lightning (молния) — DEX спасбросок
 527: - acid (кислота) — DoT 2 хода
 528: - poison (яд) — DoT 3 хода, CON спасбросок
 529: - necrotic (некроз) — вампиризм
 530: - radiant (свет) — силён против нежити
 531: - psychic (психический) — WIS спасбросок
 532: - force (силовой) — игнорирует броню
 533: 
 534: ${geographyContext}
 535: 
 536: ВАЖНО: ВСЕ тексты (имя/вид, раса, описание внешности, предыстория, привычки, фразы) на русском языке!
 537: 
 538: Верни ТОЛЬКО JSON массив: [{name: 'Имя или вид', class: 'Класс (воин/маг/жрец/etc)', role: 'main'|'secondary'|'tertiary', race: 'Раса', category: 'npc'|'beast'|'monster'|'boss', appearance: 'Описание внешности', background: 'Предыстория', habits: ['привычка'], catchphrases: ['фраза'], location_name: 'Город или пусто', state_name: 'Государство', tier: INT (1-5), level: INT (1-100), level_min: INT, level_max: INT, hit_dice: INT (6|8|10|12), stats: {STR: INT, DEX: INT, CON: INT, INT: INT, WIS: INT, CHA: INT}, special_attacks: [{name: 'Название', description: 'Описание для ДМ', damage_type: 'fire|poison|slashing|etc', damage_dice: '1d6', is_dot: BOOLEAN, dot_duration: INT}], base_attacks: [{name: 'Название', description: 'Описание', damage_type: 'slashing|piercing|etc', damage_dice: '1d6'}], is_pack: BOOLEAN, is_unique: BOOLEAN}]`;
 539: // Расчётные поля (hp, max_hp, armor_class, initiative, saving_throws) рассчитываются автоматически
 540: // level_min/level_max: для неуникальных существ — диапазон уровней при спавне
 541: 
 542:   const existingNpcsText = existingNames.length > 0
 543:     ? `\n\nУже сгенерированные NPC (НЕ ДУБЛИРОВАТЬ): ${existingNames.join(', ')}`
 544:     : '';
 545: 
 546:   const userMessage = `${loreText}${existingNpcsText}\n\nСгенерируй NPC с ${startIdx} по ${endIdx} (всего ${totalCount}). Только этих, без дубликатов.`;
 547: 
 548:   const response = await callOpenRouter(SYSTEM_PROMPT, userMessage);
 549:   
 550:   // Parse JSON from response
 551:   try {
 552:     // Try direct parse
 553:     return JSON.parse(response);
 554:   } catch {
 555:     // Try to extract JSON from markdown
 556:     const jsonMatch = response.match(/```(?:json)?\s*\n?([\s\S]*?)\n?```/);
 557:     if (jsonMatch) {
 558:       return JSON.parse(jsonMatch[1]);
 559:     }
 560:     // Try to find array
 561:     const arrayMatch = response.match(/\[[\s\S]*\]/);
 562:     if (arrayMatch) {
 563:       return JSON.parse(arrayMatch[0]);
 564:     }
 565:     return [];
 566:   }
 567: }

 569: // Generate all NPCs in batches and save to DB after each batch
 570: export async function generateAllNPCs(loreText, worldId, geography = null, onProgress = () => {}) {
 571:   const BATCH_SIZE = 5;
 572:   console.log('[generateAllNPCs] Starting, loreText length:', loreText.length, 'worldId:', worldId);
 573:   
 574:   // Create location/state maps from geography
 575:   const locationMap = {};
 576:   const stateMap = {};
 577:   if (geography) {
 578:     geography.states.forEach(s => stateMap[s.name] = s.id);
 579:     geography.locations.forEach(l => {
 580:       locationMap[l.name] = l.id;
 581:       // Also map by state for fallback
 582:       if (!stateMap[l.state_name] && l.state_id) {
 583:         stateMap[l.state_name] = l.state_id;
 584:       }
 585:     });
 586:   }
 587:   
 588:   // Helper to clean and save NPCs
 589:   const saveNPCs = async (npcs) => {
 590:     if (!npcs || npcs.length === 0) return 0;
 591:     
 592:     const cleanedNpcs = npcs.map(npc => {
 593:       const category = ['npc', 'beast', 'monster', 'boss'].includes(npc.category) ? npc.category : 'npc';
 594:       // Only intelligent NPCs get a location
 595:       const location_id = (category === 'npc' && npc.location_name) ? (locationMap[npc.location_name] || null) : null;
 596:       const state_id = npc.state_name ? (stateMap[npc.state_name] || null) : null;
 597:       
 598:       // Determine role: beasts/monsters are tertiary by default
 599:       let role = npc.role;
 600:       if (category === 'beast' || category === 'monster') {
 601:         role = 'tertiary';
 602:       } else if (role !== 'main' && role !== 'secondary') {
 603:         role = 'secondary';
 604:       }
 605:       
 606:       // Calculate combat stats with level
 607:       const tier = Number(npc.tier) || 1;
 608:       const level = Number(npc.level) || Math.max(1, Math.min(100, tier * 10 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 20)));
 609:       const combatStats = calculateNPCCombatStats(npc.stats, npc.race, tier, level);
 610:       
 611:       // Clean special_attacks and base_attacks
 612:       const specialAttacks = Array.isArray(npc.special_attacks) 
 613:         ? npc.special_attacks.slice(0, getSpecialAttacksCount(tier)).map(a => cleanAttack(a, true, tier, level))
 614:         : [];
 615:       const baseAttacks = Array.isArray(npc.base_attacks)
 616:         ? npc.base_attacks.slice(0, getBaseAttacksCount(level)).map(a => cleanAttack(a, false, tier, level))
 617:         : [];
 618:       
 619:       // Если атаки не сгенерированы ИИ — генерируем автоматически
 620:       if (specialAttacks.length === 0 && baseAttacks.length === 0) {
 621:         const generated = generateAttacksForCreature(tier, level, category, npc.race);
 622:         specialAttacks.push(...generated.special_attacks);
 623:         baseAttacks.push(...generated.base_attacks);
 624:       }
 625:       
 626:       // Calculate hit dice based on class (if provided)
 627:       const hitDie = npc.hit_dice || getHitDice(npc.class) || 8;
 628:       
 629:       // Validate level range
 630:       const levelMin = Math.max(1, Math.min(100, Number(npc.level_min) || level));
 631:       const levelMax = Math.max(levelMin, Math.min(100, Number(npc.level_max) || level));
 632:       
 633:       return {
 634:         world_id: worldId,
 635:         role,
 636:         name: (npc.name || 'Безымянный').slice(0, 100),
 637:         race: resolveNpcRace(npc).slice(0, 50),
 638:         category,
 639:         class: (npc.class || '').slice(0, 50),
 640:         appearance: (npc.appearance || '').slice(0, 500),
 641:         background: (npc.background || '').slice(0, 1000),
 642:         status_tags: Array.isArray(npc.status_tags) ? npc.status_tags.slice(0, 10).map(String) : [],
 643:         habits: Array.isArray(npc.habits) ? npc.habits.slice(0, 10).map(String) : [],
 644:         catchphrases: Array.isArray(npc.catchphrases) ? npc.catchphrases.slice(0, 10).map(String) : [],
 645:         stats: npc.stats || { STR: 10, DEX: 10, CON: 10, INT: 10, WIS: 10, CHA: 10 },
 646:         hp: Number(npc.hp) || calculateCreatureHp(Number(npc.stats?.CON) || 10, level, tier, hitDie),
 647:         max_hp: Number(npc.max_hp) || Number(npc.hp) || calculateCreatureHp(Number(npc.stats?.CON) || 10, level, tier, hitDie),
 648:         location_id,
 649:         state_id,
 650:         // Combat stats
 651:         level,
 652:         armor_class: combatStats.armor_class,
 653:         initiative: combatStats.initiative,
 654:         saving_throws: combatStats.saving_throws,
 655:         hit_dice: hitDie,
 656:         // Tier & level range
 657:         tier,
 658:         level_min: levelMin,
 659:         level_max: levelMax,
 660:         // Attacks
 661:         special_attacks: specialAttacks,
 662:         base_attacks: baseAttacks,
 663:         // Pack/unique flags
 664:         is_pack_instance: npc.is_pack === true,
 665:         pack_size: npc.is_pack ? (npc.pack_size || 2 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 5)) : 1,
 666:         is_unique: npc.is_unique === true,
 667:       };
 668:     });
 669: 
 670:     console.log(`[saveNPCs] Saving ${cleanedNpcs.length} NPCs to DB...`);
 671:     
 672:     try {
 673:       const result = await invokeFunction('generate-world-npcs', {
 674:         world_id: worldId,
 675:         npcs: cleanedNpcs,
 676:       });
 677:       console.log(`[saveNPCs] Saved ${result.count} NPCs`);
 678:       return result.count || 0;
 679:     } catch (err) {
 680:       console.error('[saveNPCs] Failed:', err);
 681:       throw err;
 682:     }
 683:   };
 684:   
 685:   // Step 1: Count NPCs
 686:   onProgress({ step: 'counting', message: 'Подсчёт NPC в тексте...' });
 687:   let totalCount = await countNPCs(loreText);
 688:   console.log('[generateAllNPCs] Count result:', totalCount);
 689:   
 690:   if (totalCount === 0) {
 691:     totalCount = 10;
 692:     console.log('[generateAllNPCs] Using fallback count:', totalCount);
 693:   }
 694:   onProgress({ step: 'counting', total: totalCount, message: `Найдено ${totalCount} NPC` });
 695: 
 696:   // Step 2: Generate in batches and save after each
 697:   const totalBatches = Math.ceil(totalCount / BATCH_SIZE);
 698:   const allNpcs = [];
 699:   const generatedNames = new Set();
 700:   let totalSaved = 0;
 701: 
 702:   console.log('[generateAllNPCs] Will generate in', totalBatches, 'batches');
 703: 
 704:   for (let batchNum = 0; batchNum < totalBatches; batchNum++) {
 705:     const startIdx = batchNum * BATCH_SIZE + 1;
 706:     const endIdx = Math.min((batchNum + 1) * BATCH_SIZE, totalCount);
 707:     
 708:     console.log(`[generateAllNPCs] Batch ${batchNum + 1}/${totalBatches}: NPCs ${startIdx}-${endIdx}`);
 709:     
 710:     onProgress({
 711:       step: 'generating',
 712:       batch: batchNum + 1,
 713:       totalBatches,
 714:       current: endIdx,
 715:       total: totalCount,
 716:       message: `Генерация NPC ${startIdx}-${endIdx} из ${totalCount}...`,
 717:     });
 718: 
 719:     try {
 720:       const batchNpcs = await generateNPCBatch(
 721:         loreText,
 722:         startIdx,
 723:         endIdx,
 724:         totalCount,
 725:         Array.from(generatedNames),
 726:         geography
 727:       );
 728: 
 729:       console.log(`[generateAllNPCs] Batch ${batchNum + 1} result:`, Array.isArray(batchNpcs) ? batchNpcs.length : 'not array', 'NPCs');
 730: 
 731:       if (Array.isArray(batchNpcs) && batchNpcs.length > 0) {
 732:         // Add to local list for deduplication tracking
 733:         const newNpcs = [];
 734:         for (const npc of batchNpcs) {
 735:           const name = (npc.name || '').toLowerCase().trim();
 736:           if (name && !generatedNames.has(name)) {
 737:             generatedNames.add(name);
 738:             allNpcs.push(npc);
 739:             newNpcs.push(npc);
 740:           }
 741:         }
 742: 
 743:         // Save this batch to DB immediately
 744:         if (newNpcs.length > 0) {
 745:           onProgress({
 746:             step: 'saving',
 747:             message: `Сохранение ${newNpcs.length} NPC в БД...`,
 748:           });
 749:           const saved = await saveNPCs(newNpcs);
 750:           totalSaved += saved;
 751:           console.log(`[generateAllNPCs] Total saved so far: ${totalSaved}`);
 752:         }
 753: 
 754:         // If model returned more NPCs than expected (generated all at once), adjust
 755:         if (batchNpcs.length >= totalCount) {
 756:           console.log('[generateAllNPCs] Model returned all NPCs at once, stopping batches');
 757:           break;
 758:         }
 759:       }
 760:     } catch (batchErr) {
 761:       console.error(`[generateAllNPCs] Batch ${batchNum + 1} failed:`, batchErr);
 762:       // Continue with what we have
 763:       if (allNpcs.length > 0) {
 764:         break;
 765:       }
 766:       throw batchErr;
 767:     }
 768:   }
 769: 
 770:   console.log('[generateAllNPCs] Done. Total unique NPCs:', allNpcs.length, 'saved to DB:', totalSaved);
 771:   onProgress({ step: 'done', count: allNpcs.length, saved: totalSaved, message: `Сгенерировано ${allNpcs.length}, сохранено ${totalSaved} NPC` });
 772:   return { npcs: allNpcs, saved: totalSaved };
 773: }

 775: // Generate intelligent NPCs (category: npc) with progress saving
 776: export async function generateIntelligentNPCs(loreText, worldId, geography = null, onProgress = () => {}) {
 777:   const BATCH_SIZE = 5;
 778:   const STORAGE_KEY = `intelligent_npcs`;
 779:   
 780:   console.log('[generateIntelligentNPCs] Starting');
 781:   
 782:   // Load saved progress
 783:   const progress = loadGenerationProgress(worldId) || {};
 784:   const savedIntelligent = progress[STORAGE_KEY] || { generatedNames: [], totalSaved: 0, completed: false };
 785:   
 786:   if (savedIntelligent.completed) {
 787:     console.log('[generateIntelligentNPCs] Already completed');
 788:     onProgress({ step: 'done', message: 'Уже сгенерировано ранее', saved: savedIntelligent.totalSaved });
 789:     return { npcs: [], saved: savedIntelligent.totalSaved, alreadyCompleted: true };
 790:   }
 791:   
 792:   const generatedNames = new Set(savedIntelligent.generatedNames || []);
 793:   let totalSaved = savedIntelligent.totalSaved || 0;
 794:   
 795:   // Count intelligent NPCs
 796:   onProgress({ step: 'counting', message: 'Подсчёт разумных NPC...' });
 797:   const totalCount = await countNPCs(loreText);
 798:   const intelligentCount = Math.ceil(totalCount * 0.6); // ~60% are intelligent
 799:   
 800:   onProgress({ step: 'counting', total: intelligentCount, message: `Найдено ${intelligentCount} разумных NPC` });
 801:   
 802:   // Create location/state maps
 803:   const locationMap = {};
 804:   const stateMap = {};
 805:   if (geography) {
 806:     geography.states.forEach(s => stateMap[s.name] = s.id);
 807:     geography.locations.forEach(l => {
 808:       locationMap[l.name] = l.id;
 809:       if (!stateMap[l.state_name] && l.state_id) {
 810:         stateMap[l.state_name] = l.state_id;
 811:       }
 812:     });
 813:   }
 814:   
 815:   // Save helper
 816:   const saveNPCs = async (npcs) => {
 817:     if (!npcs || npcs.length === 0) return 0;
 818:     const cleanedNpcs = npcs.map(npc => {
 819:       const location_id = npc.location_name ? (locationMap[npc.location_name] || null) : null;
 820:       const state_id = npc.state_name ? (stateMap[npc.state_name] || null) : null;
 821:       const tier = Number(npc.tier) || 1;
 822:       const level = Number(npc.level) || Math.max(1, Math.min(100, tier * 10 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 20)));
 823:       const combatStats = calculateNPCCombatStats(npc.stats, npc.race, tier, level);
 824:       
 825:       // Clean special_attacks and base_attacks
 826:       const specialAttacks = Array.isArray(npc.special_attacks) 
 827:         ? npc.special_attacks.slice(0, getSpecialAttacksCount(tier)).map(a => cleanAttack(a, true, tier, level))
 828:         : [];
 829:       const baseAttacks = Array.isArray(npc.base_attacks)
 830:         ? npc.base_attacks.slice(0, getBaseAttacksCount(level)).map(a => cleanAttack(a, false, tier, level))
 831:         : [];
 832:       
 833:       // Если атаки не сгенерированы ИИ — генерируем автоматически
 834:       if (specialAttacks.length === 0 && baseAttacks.length === 0) {
 835:         const generated = generateAttacksForCreature(tier, level, 'npc', npc.race);
 836:         specialAttacks.push(...generated.special_attacks);
 837:         baseAttacks.push(...generated.base_attacks);
 838:       }
 839:       
 840:       // Calculate hit dice based on class
 841:       const hitDie = npc.hit_dice || getHitDice(npc.class) || 8;
 842:       
 843:       // Validate level range
 844:       const levelMin = Math.max(1, Math.min(100, Number(npc.level_min) || level));
 845:       const levelMax = Math.max(levelMin, Math.min(100, Number(npc.level_max) || level));
 846:       
 847:       return {
 848:         world_id: worldId,
 849:         role: npc.role === 'main' ? 'main' : 'secondary',
 850:         name: (npc.name || 'Безымянный').slice(0, 100),
 851:         race: resolveNpcRace(npc).slice(0, 50),
 852:         category: 'npc',
 853:         class: (npc.class || '').slice(0, 50),
 854:         appearance: (npc.appearance || '').slice(0, 500),
 855:         background: (npc.background || '').slice(0, 1000),
 856:         status_tags: Array.isArray(npc.status_tags) ? npc.status_tags.slice(0, 10).map(String) : [],
 857:         habits: Array.isArray(npc.habits) ? npc.habits.slice(0, 10).map(String) : [],
 858:         catchphrases: Array.isArray(npc.catchphrases) ? npc.catchphrases.slice(0, 10).map(String) : [],
 859:         stats: npc.stats || { STR: 10, DEX: 10, CON: 10, INT: 10, WIS: 10, CHA: 10 },
 860:         hp: Number(npc.hp) || calculateCreatureHp(Number(npc.stats?.CON) || 10, level, tier, hitDie),
 861:         max_hp: Number(npc.max_hp) || Number(npc.hp) || calculateCreatureHp(Number(npc.stats?.CON) || 10, level, tier, hitDie),
 862:         location_id,
 863:         state_id,
 864:         // Combat stats
 865:         level,
 866:         armor_class: combatStats.armor_class,
 867:         initiative: combatStats.initiative,
 868:         saving_throws: combatStats.saving_throws,
 869:         hit_dice: hitDie,
 870:         // Tier & level range
 871:         tier,
 872:         level_min: levelMin,
 873:         level_max: levelMax,
 874:         // Attacks
 875:         special_attacks: specialAttacks,
 876:         base_attacks: baseAttacks,
 877:         // Pack/unique flags
 878:         is_pack_instance: false,
 879:         pack_size: 1,
 880:         is_unique: npc.is_unique === true,
 881:       };
 882:     });
 883:     
 884:     try {
 885:       const result = await invokeFunction('generate-world-npcs', {
 886:         world_id: worldId,
 887:         npcs: cleanedNpcs,
 888:       });
 889:       return result.count || 0;
 890:     } catch (err) {
 891:       console.error('[saveNPCs] Failed:', err);
 892:       throw err;
 893:     }
 894:   };
 895:   
 896:   // Generate in batches
 897:   const totalBatches = Math.ceil(intelligentCount / BATCH_SIZE);
 898:   const allNpcs = [];
 899:   
 900:   for (let batchNum = 0; batchNum < totalBatches; batchNum++) {
 901:     const startIdx = batchNum * BATCH_SIZE + 1;
 902:     const endIdx = Math.min((batchNum + 1) * BATCH_SIZE, intelligentCount);
 903:     
 904:     onProgress({
 905:       step: 'generating',
 906:       batch: batchNum + 1,
 907:       totalBatches,
 908:       current: endIdx,
 909:       total: intelligentCount,
 910:       message: `Генерация разумных NPC ${startIdx}-${endIdx} из ${intelligentCount}...`,
 911:     });
 912:     
 913:     try {
 914:       const batchNpcs = await generateNPCBatch(
 915:         loreText, startIdx, endIdx, intelligentCount,
 916:         Array.from(generatedNames), geography
 917:       );
 918:       
 919:       if (Array.isArray(batchNpcs) && batchNpcs.length > 0) {
 920:         const newNpcs = [];
 921:         for (const npc of batchNpcs) {
 922:           const name = (npc.name || '').toLowerCase().trim();
 923:           if (name && !generatedNames.has(name)) {
 924:             generatedNames.add(name);
 925:             // Force category to 'npc' for intelligent batch
 926:             npc.category = 'npc';
 927:             allNpcs.push(npc);
 928:             newNpcs.push(npc);
 929:           }
 930:         }
 931:         
 932:         if (newNpcs.length > 0) {
 933:           const saved = await saveNPCs(newNpcs);
 934:           totalSaved += saved;
 935:           
 936:           // Save progress after each batch (localStorage + IndexedDB)
 937:           const progressData = {
 938:             [STORAGE_KEY]: {
 939:               generatedNames: Array.from(generatedNames),
 940:               totalSaved,
 941:               completed: false,
 942:             }
 943:           };
 944:           saveGenerationProgress(worldId, progressData);
 945:           await saveProgress(worldId, { type: 'intelligent', ...progressData[STORAGE_KEY] });
 946:         }
 947:         
 948:         if (batchNpcs.length >= intelligentCount) break;
 949:       }
 950:     } catch (batchErr) {
 951:       console.error(`[generateIntelligentNPCs] Batch ${batchNum + 1} failed:`, batchErr);
 952:       // Save progress before throwing
 953:       const progressData = {
 954:         [STORAGE_KEY]: {
 955:           generatedNames: Array.from(generatedNames),
 956:           totalSaved,
 957:           completed: false,
 958:         }
 959:       };
 960:       saveGenerationProgress(worldId, progressData);
 961:       await saveProgress(worldId, { type: 'intelligent', ...progressData[STORAGE_KEY] });
 962:       if (allNpcs.length > 0) break;
 963:       throw batchErr;
 964:     }
 965:   }
 966:   
 967:   // Mark as completed
 968:   const finalData = {
 969:     [STORAGE_KEY]: {
 970:       generatedNames: Array.from(generatedNames),
 971:       totalSaved,
 972:       completed: true,
 973:     }
 974:   };
 975:   saveGenerationProgress(worldId, finalData);
 976:   await saveProgress(worldId, { type: 'intelligent', ...finalData[STORAGE_KEY] });
 977:   
 978:   onProgress({ step: 'done', count: allNpcs.length, saved: totalSaved, message: `Разумные NPC сгенерировано: ${allNpcs.length}` });
 979:   return { npcs: allNpcs, saved: totalSaved };
 980: }

 982: // Generate non-intelligent creatures (beast, monster, boss) with progress saving
 983: export async function generateCreatures(loreText, worldId, geography = null, onProgress = () => {}) {
 984:   const BATCH_SIZE = 3;
 985:   const STORAGE_KEY = `creatures`;
 986:   
 987:   console.log('[generateCreatures] Starting');
 988:   
 989:   // Load saved progress
 990:   const progress = loadGenerationProgress(worldId) || {};
 991:   const savedCreatures = progress[STORAGE_KEY] || { generatedNames: [], totalSaved: 0, completed: false };
 992:   
 993:   if (savedCreatures.completed) {
 994:     console.log('[generateCreatures] Already completed');
 995:     onProgress({ step: 'done', message: 'Уже сгенерировано ранее', saved: savedCreatures.totalSaved });
 996:     return { npcs: [], saved: savedCreatures.totalSaved, alreadyCompleted: true };
 997:   }
 998:   
 999:   const generatedNames = new Set(savedCreatures.generatedNames || []);

1093: ${geography ? `Доступные государства:\n${geography.states.map(s => `- ${s.name}`).join('\n')}` : ''}

1097: Верни ТОЛЬКО JSON массив: [{name: 'Название вида', race: 'Раса', category: 'beast'|'monster'|'boss', appearance: 'Описание внешности', background: 'Предыстория', state_name: 'Государство', tier: INT (1-5), level: INT (1-100), level_min: INT, level_max: INT, hit_dice: INT (8|10), stats: {STR: INT, DEX: INT, CON: INT, INT: INT, WIS: INT, CHA: INT}, special_attacks: [{name: 'Название', description: 'Описание для ДМ', damage_type: 'fire|poison|slashing|etc', damage_dice: '1d6', is_dot: BOOLEAN, dot_duration: INT}], base_attacks: [{name: 'Название', description: 'Описание', damage_type: 'slashing|piercing|etc', damage_dice: '1d6'}], is_pack: BOOLEAN, is_unique: BOOLEAN}]`;

1101:   // Save helper
1102:   const saveNPCs = async (npcs) => {
1103:     if (!npcs || npcs.length === 0) return 0;
1104:     const cleanedNpcs = npcs.map(npc => {
1105:       const state_id = npc.state_name ? (stateMap[npc.state_name] || null) : null;
1106:       const category = ['beast', 'monster', 'boss'].includes(npc.category) ? npc.category : 'monster';
1107:       const tier = Number(npc.tier) || 1;
1108:       const level = Number(npc.level) || Math.max(1, Math.min(100, tier * 10));
1109:       const combatStats = calculateNPCCombatStats(npc.stats, npc.race, tier, level);
1110:       
1111:       // Clean special_attacks and base_attacks
1112:       const specialAttacks = Array.isArray(npc.special_attacks) 
1113:         ? npc.special_attacks.slice(0, getSpecialAttacksCount(tier)).map(a => cleanAttack(a, true, tier, level))
1114:         : [];
1115:       const baseAttacks = Array.isArray(npc.base_attacks)
1116:         ? npc.base_attacks.slice(0, getBaseAttacksCount(level)).map(a => cleanAttack(a, false, tier, level))
1117:         : [];
1118:       
1119:       // Если атаки не сгенерированы ИИ — генерируем автоматически
1120:       if (specialAttacks.length === 0 && baseAttacks.length === 0) {
1121:         const generated = generateAttacksForCreature(tier, level, category, npc.race);
1122:         specialAttacks.push(...generated.special_attacks);
1123:         baseAttacks.push(...generated.base_attacks);
1124:       }
1125:       
1126:       // Creatures use d8 by default (or d10 for bosses)
1127:       const hitDie = npc.hit_dice || (category === 'boss' ? 10 : 8);
1128:       
1129:       // Validate level range
1130:       const levelMin = Math.max(1, Math.min(100, Number(npc.level_min) || level));
1131:       const levelMax = Math.max(levelMin, Math.min(100, Number(npc.level_max) || level));
1132:       
1133:       return {
1134:         world_id: worldId,
1135:         role: 'tertiary',
1136:         name: (npc.name || 'Безымянный').slice(0, 100),
1137:         race: resolveNpcRace(npc).slice(0, 50),
1138:         category,
1139:         class: (npc.class || '').slice(0, 50),
1140:         appearance: (npc.appearance || '').slice(0, 500),
1141:         background: (npc.background || '').slice(0, 1000),
1142:         status_tags: Array.isArray(npc.status_tags) ? npc.status_tags.slice(0, 10).map(String) : [],
1143:         habits: [],
1144:         catchphrases: [],
1145:         stats: npc.stats || { STR: 10, DEX: 10, CON: 10, INT: 10, WIS: 10, CHA: 10 },
1146:         hp: Number(npc.hp) || calculateCreatureHp(Number(npc.stats?.CON) || 10, level, tier, hitDie),
1147:         max_hp: Number(npc.max_hp) || Number(npc.hp) || calculateCreatureHp(Number(npc.stats?.CON) || 10, level, tier, hitDie),
1148:         location_id: null, // Creatures don't have locations
1149:         state_id,
1150:         // Combat stats
1151:         level,
1152:         armor_class: combatStats.armor_class,
1153:         initiative: combatStats.initiative,
1154:         saving_throws: combatStats.saving_throws,
1155:         hit_dice: hitDie,
1156:         // Tier & level range
1157:         tier,
1158:         level_min: levelMin,
1159:         level_max: levelMax,
1160:         // Attacks
1161:         special_attacks: specialAttacks,
1162:         base_attacks: baseAttacks,
1163:         // Pack/unique flags
1164:         is_pack_instance: npc.is_pack === true,
1165:         pack_size: npc.is_pack ? (npc.pack_size || 2 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 5)) : 1,
1166:         is_unique: npc.is_unique === true,
1167:       };
1168:     });
1169:     
1170:     try {
1171:       const result = await invokeFunction('generate-world-npcs', {
1172:         world_id: worldId,
1173:         npcs: cleanedNpcs,
1174:       });
1175:       return result.count || 0;
1176:     } catch (err) {
1177:       console.error('[saveNPCs] Failed:', err);
1178:       throw err;
1179:     }
1180:   };
1181:   
1182:   // Generate in batches
1183:   const totalBatches = Math.ceil(creatureCount / BATCH_SIZE);
1184:   const allNpcs = [];
1185:   
1186:   for (let batchNum = 0; batchNum < totalBatches; batchNum++) {
1187:     const startIdx = batchNum * BATCH_SIZE + 1;
1188:     const endIdx = Math.min((batchNum + 1) * BATCH_SIZE, creatureCount);
1189:     
1190:     onProgress({
1191:       step: 'generating',
1192:       batch: batchNum + 1,
1193:       totalBatches,
1194:       current: endIdx,
1195:       total: creatureCount,
1196:       message: `Генерация существ ${startIdx}-${endIdx} из ${creatureCount}...`,
1197:     });
1198:     
1199:     try {
1200:       const userMessage = `${loreText}\n\nСгенерируй существ (звери, монстры, боссы) с ${startIdx} по ${endIdx} (всего ${creatureCount}). Только этих, без дубликатов. Уже сгенерированные: ${Array.from(generatedNames).join(', ')}`;
1201:       
1202:       const response = await callOpenRouter(creaturePrompt, userMessage);
1203:       
1204:       let batchNpcs;
1205:       try {
1206:         batchNpcs = JSON.parse(response);
1207:       } catch {
1208:         const jsonMatch = response.match(/```(?:json)?\s*\n?([\s\S]*?)\n?```/);
1209:         if (jsonMatch) {
1210:           batchNpcs = JSON.parse(jsonMatch[1]);
1211:         } else {
1212:           const arrayMatch = response.match(/\[[\s\S]*\]/);
1213:           batchNpcs = arrayMatch ? JSON.parse(arrayMatch[0]) : [];
1214:         }
1215:       }
1216:       
1217:       if (Array.isArray(batchNpcs) && batchNpcs.length > 0) {
1218:         const newNpcs = [];
1219:         for (const npc of batchNpcs) {
1220:           const name = (npc.name || '').toLowerCase().trim();
1221:           if (name && !generatedNames.has(name)) {
1222:             generatedNames.add(name);
1223:             allNpcs.push(npc);
1224:             newNpcs.push(npc);
1225:           }
1226:         }
1227:         
1228:         if (newNpcs.length > 0) {
1229:           const saved = await saveNPCs(newNpcs);
1230:           totalSaved += saved;
1231:           
1232:           // Save progress after each batch (localStorage + IndexedDB)
1233:           const progressData = {
1234:             [STORAGE_KEY]: {
1235:               generatedNames: Array.from(generatedNames),
1236:               totalSaved,
1237:               completed: false,
1238:             }
1239:           };
1240:           saveGenerationProgress(worldId, progressData);
1241:           await saveProgress(worldId, { type: 'creatures', ...progressData[STORAGE_KEY] });
1242:         }
1243:         
1244:         if (batchNpcs.length >= creatureCount) break;
1245:       }
1246:     } catch (batchErr) {
1247:       console.error(`[generateCreatures] Batch ${batchNum + 1} failed:`, batchErr);
1248:       // Save progress before throwing
1249:       const progressData = {
1250:         [STORAGE_KEY]: {
1251:           generatedNames: Array.from(generatedNames),
1252:           totalSaved,
1253:           completed: false,
1254:         }
1255:       };
1256:       saveGenerationProgress(worldId, progressData);
1257:       await saveProgress(worldId, { type: 'creatures', ...progressData[STORAGE_KEY] });
1258:       if (allNpcs.length > 0) break;
1259:       throw batchErr;
1260:     }
1261:   }
1262:   
1263:   // Mark as completed
1264:   const finalData = {
1265:     [STORAGE_KEY]: {
1266:       generatedNames: Array.from(generatedNames),
1267:       totalSaved,
1268:       completed: true,
1269:     }
1270:   };
1271:   saveGenerationProgress(worldId, finalData);
1272:   await saveProgress(worldId, { type: 'creatures', ...finalData[STORAGE_KEY] });
1273:   
1274:   onProgress({ step: 'done', count: allNpcs.length, saved: totalSaved, message: `Существа сгенерированы: ${allNpcs.length}` });
1275:   return { npcs: allNpcs, saved: totalSaved };
1276: }
1277: 
1278: // Check if generation can be resumed (checks both localStorage and IndexedDB)
1279: export async function canResumeGeneration(worldId) {
1280:   const progress = loadGenerationProgress(worldId);
1281:   if (!progress) {
1282:     // Try IndexedDB
1283:     const dbProgress = await loadProgress(worldId);
1284:     if (dbProgress) {
1285:       return {
1286:         intelligent: dbProgress.type === 'intelligent' && !dbProgress.completed,
1287:         creatures: dbProgress.type === 'creatures' && !dbProgress.completed,
1288:       };
1289:     }
1290:     return { intelligent: false, creatures: false };
1291:   }
1292:   
1293:   return {
1294:     intelligent: progress.intelligent_npcs && !progress.intelligent_npcs.completed,
1295:     creatures: progress.creatures && !progress.creatures.completed,
1296:   };
1297: }
1298: 
1299: // Clear all generation progress for a world
1300: export async function clearWorldGenerationProgress(worldId) {
1301:   clearGenerationProgress(worldId);
1302:   await deleteProgress(worldId);
1303: }

 107: export async function getSessions() {
 108:   const { data: sessions, error: sessErr } = await supabase
 109:     .from('sessions')
 110:     .select('*')
 111:     .order('created_at', { ascending: false });
 112:   if (sessErr) throw sessErr;
 113:   if (!sessions || sessions.length === 0) return [];
 114: 
 115:   const worldIds = [...new Set(sessions.map((s) => s.world_id).filter(Boolean))];
 116:   const sessionIds = sessions.map((s) => s.id);
 117: 
 118:   // Параллельно забираем миры и всех участников всех сессий за 2 запроса
 119:   const [{ data: worlds }, { data: allPlayers }] = await Promise.all([
 120:     supabase.from('worlds').select('id, name').in('id', worldIds.length ? worldIds : ['00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000']),
 121:     supabase.from('players').select('id, session_id, name, user_id, hp, max_hp, is_active').in('session_id', sessionIds),
 122:   ]);
 123: 
 124:   const worldMap = {};
 125:   (worlds || []).forEach((w) => { worldMap[w.id] = w; });
 126: 
 127:   const playersBySession = {};
 128:   (allPlayers || []).forEach((p) => {
 129:     if (!playersBySession[p.session_id]) playersBySession[p.session_id] = [];
 130:     playersBySession[p.session_id].push(p);
 131:   });
 132: 
 133:   return sessions.map((s) => ({
 134:     ...s,
 135:     worlds: worldMap[s.world_id] || null,
 136:     players: playersBySession[s.id] || [],
 137:   }));
 138: }

 140: export async function getSession(id) {
 141:   const { data, error } = await supabase
 142:     .from('sessions')
 143:     .select('*, worlds(settings)')
 144:     .eq('id', id)
 145:     .single();
 146:   if (error) throw error;
 147:   if (data) {
 148:     data.current_location_name = data.current_wild_zone || null;
 149:     data.current_state_name = null;
 150:     if (data.current_location_id) {
 151:       try {
 152:         const { data: locData } = await supabase
 153:           .from('locations')
 154:           .select('id, name, state_id, states(name)')
 155:           .eq('id', data.current_location_id)
 156:           .maybeSingle();
 157:         if (locData) {
 158:           if (!data.current_wild_zone) {
 159:             data.current_location_name = locData.name || null;
 160:           }
 161:           const stateObj = Array.isArray(locData.states) ? locData.states[0] : locData.states;
 162:           data.current_state_name = stateObj?.name || null;
 163:         }
 164:       } catch (locErr) {
 165:         console.warn('Failed to load session location details:', locErr);
 166:       }
 167:     }
 168:   }
 169: 
 170:   return data;
 171: }

 173: export async function createSession(session) {
 174:   const sessionData = {
 175:     game_year: 1248,
 176:     game_month: 5,
 177:     game_day: 14,
 178:     game_hour: 10,
 179:     game_minute: 0,
 180:     ...session,
 181:   };
 182:   const { data, error } = await supabase
 183:     .from('sessions')

 185:     .select()
 186:     .single();
 187:   if (error) throw error;
 188:   return data;

 202: export async function deleteSession(id) {
 203:   try {
 204:     const { data: rpcData, error: rpcErr } = await supabase.rpc('delete_session', { p_session_id: id });
 205:     if (!rpcErr && rpcData?.success) {
 206:       return rpcData;
 207:     }
 208:     if (rpcData && rpcData.success === false && rpcData.message) {
 209:       throw new Error(rpcData.message);
 210:     }
 211:   } catch (err) {
 212:     if (err.message && !err.message.includes('Could not find')) {
 213:       throw err;
 214:     }
 215:   }
 216: 
 217:   // Fallback: direct DELETE query with RLS cascade
 218:   const { error } = await supabase
 219:     .from('sessions')
 220:     .delete()
 221:     .eq('id', id);
 222:   if (error) throw error;
 223:   return { success: true, deleted_session_id: id };
 224: }

 349: export async function getTurnQueue(sessionId) {
 350:   const { data, error } = await supabase
 351:     .from('turn_queue')
 352:     .select('*')
 353:     .eq('session_id', sessionId)
 354:     .order('created_at', { ascending: true });
 355:   if (error) throw error;
 356:   return data || [];
 357: }
 358: 
 359: export async function initTurnQueue(sessionId, players = []) {
 360:   if (!sessionId || !players.length) return null;
 361: 
 362:   // 1. Получаем существующую очередь для сессии
 363:   const { data: existing, error: fetchErr } = await supabase
 364:     .from('turn_queue')
 365:     .select('*')
 366:     .eq('session_id', sessionId)
 367:     .order('created_at', { ascending: true });
 368: 
 369:   if (fetchErr) {
 370:     console.warn('Failed to fetch turn_queue:', fetchErr);
 371:     return null;
 372:   }
 373: 
 374:   // 2. Если очереди ещё нет — создаём для каждого игрока
 375:   if (!existing || existing.length === 0) {
 376:     const toInsert = players.map((p, idx) => ({
 377:       session_id: sessionId,
 378:       player_id: p.id,
 379:       status: idx === 0 ? 'active' : 'waiting',
 380:     }));
 381:     const { data: created, error: insertErr } = await supabase
 382:       .from('turn_queue')
 383:       .insert(toInsert)
 384:       .select();
 385:     if (insertErr) {
 386:       console.warn('Failed to insert turn_queue:', insertErr);
 387:       return null;
 388:     }
 389:     return created?.find((t) => t.status === 'active') || created?.[0] || null;
 390:   }
 391: 
 392:   // 3. Проверяем, есть ли игроки, которых ещё нет в очереди (зашли позже)
 393:   const existingPlayerIds = new Set(existing.map((t) => t.player_id));
 394:   const missingPlayers = players.filter((p) => !existingPlayerIds.has(p.id));
 395:   if (missingPlayers.length > 0) {
 396:     const toInsert = missingPlayers.map((p) => ({
 397:       session_id: sessionId,
 398:       player_id: p.id,
 399:       status: 'waiting',
 400:     }));
 401:     await supabase.from('turn_queue').insert(toInsert);
 402:   }
 403: 
 404:   // 4. Проверяем активный ход
 405:   const activeTurn = existing.find((t) => t.status === 'active');
 406:   if (activeTurn) {
 407:     return activeTurn;
 408:   }
 409: 
 410:   // Если активного хода нет, но есть ожидающие — активируем первый waiting
 411:   const waitingTurn = existing.find((t) => t.status === 'waiting');
 412:   if (waitingTurn) {
 413:     const { data: updated } = await supabase
 414:       .from('turn_queue')
 415:       .update({ status: 'active' })
 416:       .eq('id', waitingTurn.id)
 417:       .select()
 418:       .maybeSingle();
 419:     return updated || waitingTurn;
 420:   }
 421: 
 422:   // Если все ходы завершены (completed) — перезапускаем раунд
 423:   const firstTurn = existing[0];
 424:   const otherIds = existing.slice(1).map((t) => t.id);
 425:   if (otherIds.length > 0) {
 426:     await supabase.from('turn_queue').update({ status: 'waiting', resolved_at: null }).in('id', otherIds);
 427:   }
 428:   const { data: updated } = await supabase
 429:     .from('turn_queue')
 430:     .update({ status: 'active', resolved_at: null })
 431:     .eq('id', firstTurn.id)
 432:     .select()
 433:     .maybeSingle();
 434:   return updated || firstTurn;
 435: }
 436: 
 437: export async function passTurn(sessionId, targetPlayerId) {
 438:   if (!sessionId || !targetPlayerId) return;
 439:   // Переводим все активные ходы в waiting
 440:   await supabase
 441:     .from('turn_queue')
 442:     .update({ status: 'waiting' })
 443:     .eq('session_id', sessionId)
 444:     .eq('status', 'active');
 445: 
 446:   // Активируем ход целевого игрока
 447:   const { data: updated } = await supabase
 448:     .from('turn_queue')
 449:     .update({ status: 'active', resolved_at: null })
 450:     .eq('session_id', sessionId)
 451:     .eq('player_id', targetPlayerId)
 452:     .select()
 453:     .maybeSingle();
 454: 
 455:   // Если у целевого игрока ещё не было записи в turn_queue, создаём её
 456:   if (!updated) {
 457:     await supabase.from('turn_queue').insert({
 458:       session_id: sessionId,
 459:       player_id: targetPlayerId,
 460:       status: 'active',
 461:     });
 462:   }
 463: }
 464: 
 465: export async function submitAction(sessionId, playerId, actionText) {
 466:   try {
 467:     return await invokeFunction('process-turn', {
 468:       session_id: sessionId,
 469:       player_id: playerId,
 470:       action_text: actionText,
 471:     });
 472:   } catch (err) {
 473:     if (err?.data?.code === 'MISSING_API_KEY' || err?.status === 402) {
 474:       throw new Error('MISSING_API_KEY');
 475:     }
 476:     throw new Error(err.message || 'Неизвестная ошибка');
 477:   }
 478: }

 555: export async function exportWorld(worldId) {
 556:   const world = await getWorld(worldId);
 557:   const loreFiles = await getLoreFiles(worldId);
 558:   const folders = await getLoreFilesByFolder(worldId);
 559:   
 560:   // Get states with locations
 561:   const { data: states } = await supabase
 562:     .from('states')
 563:     .select('*, locations(*)')
 564:     .eq('world_id', worldId)
 565:     .order('name');
 566:   
 567:   // Get NPCs with location info
 568:   const { data: npcs } = await supabase
 569:     .from('npcs')
 570:     .select('*')
 571:     .eq('world_id', worldId)
 572:     .order('role')
 573:     .order('name');
 574: 
 575:   const exportData = {
 576:     version: '3.1',
 577:     exported_at: new Date().toISOString(),
 578:     schema: 'multirp_world_full',
 579:     world: {
 580:       name: world.name,
 581:       settings: world.settings,
 582:       description: world.description || '',
 583:     },
 584:     lore_files: loreFiles.map((f) => ({
 585:       folder: f.folder,
 586:       title: f.title,
 587:       content: f.content,
 588:       tags: f.tags,
 589:     })),
 590:     folders,
 591:     geography: {
 592:       states: states?.map(s => ({
 593:         id: s.id,
 594:         name: s.name,
 595:         description: s.description,
 596:         ruler_id: s.ruler_id,
 597:         locations: s.locations?.map(l => ({
 598:           id: l.id,
 599:           name: l.name,
 600:           type: l.type,
 601:           description: l.description,
 602:         })) || [],
 603:       })) || [],
 604:     },
 605:     bestiary: {
 606:       npcs: npcs?.map(n => ({
 607:         id: n.id,
 608:         name: n.name,
 609:         race: n.race,
 610:         class: n.class || '',
 611:         category: n.category,
 612:         role: n.role,
 613:         appearance: n.appearance,
 614:         background: n.background,
 615:         stats: n.stats,
 616:         // Расчётные поля (hp, max_hp, armor_class, initiative, saving_throws) исключаены — рассчитываются автоматически
 617:         level: n.level,
 618:         tier: n.tier,
 619:         hit_dice: n.hit_dice || 8,
 620:         // Для неуникальных существ — диапазон уровней при спавне
 621:         level_min: n.level_min || n.level || 1,
 622:         level_max: n.level_max || n.level || 1,
 623:         status_tags: n.status_tags,
 624:         habits: n.habits,
 625:         catchphrases: n.catchphrases,
 626:         location_id: n.location_id,
 627:         state_id: n.state_id,
 628:         special_attacks: n.special_attacks,
 629:         base_attacks: n.base_attacks,
 630:         is_pack: n.is_pack_instance,
 631:         pack_size: n.pack_size,
 632:         is_unique: n.is_unique || false,
 633:       })) || [],
 634:     },
 635:   };
 636: 
 637:   return exportData;
 638: }
 639: 
 640: export function downloadJSON(data, filename) {
 641:   const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
 642:   const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
 643:   const a = document.createElement('a');
 644:   a.href = url;
 645:   a.download = filename;
 646:   a.click();
 647:   URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
 648: }

 775: export async function importWorld(jsonData, ownerId) {
 776:   const worldData = JSON.parse(jsonData);
 777:   
 778:   // Validate schema
 779:   if (!worldData.world || !worldData.version) {
 780:     throw new Error('Некорректный формат файла мира');
 781:   }
 782: 
 783:   const world = await createWorld({
 784:     owner_id: ownerId,
 785:     name: worldData.world.name,
 786:     settings: worldData.world.settings,
 787:     description: worldData.world.description || '',
 788:   });
 789: 
 790:   // Import lore files
 791:   let loreCount = 0;
 792:   if (worldData.lore_files?.length) {
 793:     const files = worldData.lore_files.map((f) => ({
 794:       world_id: world.id,
 795:       folder: f.folder,
 796:       title: f.title,
 797:       content: f.content,
 798:       tags: f.tags || [],
 799:     }));
 800:     const { error } = await supabase.from('lore_files').insert(files);
 801:     if (error) throw error;
 802:     loreCount = files.length;
 803:   }
 804: 
 805:   // Import geography (states + locations)
 806:   const locationIdMap = {}; // old ID -> new ID
 807:   const locationNameMap = {}; // name -> new ID (for JSON without IDs)
 808:   const stateIdMap = {}; // old ID -> new ID
 809:   const stateNameMap = {}; // name -> new ID (for JSON without IDs)
 810:   let stateCount = 0;
 811:   let locationCount = 0;
 812:   
 813:   if (worldData.geography?.states?.length) {
 814:     for (const state of worldData.geography.states) {
 815:       const { data: newState, error: stateError } = await supabase
 816:         .from('states')
 817:         .insert({
 818:           world_id: world.id,
 819:           name: state.name,
 820:           description: state.description || '',
 821:         })
 822:         .select()
 823:         .single();
 824:       
 825:       if (stateError) throw stateError;
 826:       stateIdMap[state.id] = newState.id;
 827:       stateNameMap[state.name.toLowerCase().trim()] = newState.id;
 828:       stateCount++;
 829:       
 830:       // Import locations for this state
 831:       if (state.locations?.length) {
 832:         const locations = state.locations.map(l => ({
 833:           state_id: newState.id,
 834:           name: l.name,
 835:           type: l.type || 'city',
 836:           description: l.description || '',
 837:         }));
 838:         
 839:         const { data: newLocations, error: locError } = await supabase
 840:           .from('locations')
 841:           .insert(locations)
 842:           .select();
 843:         
 844:         if (locError) throw locError;
 845:         locationCount += newLocations.length;
 846:         
 847:         // Map old location IDs to new ones
 848:         state.locations.forEach((oldLoc, idx) => {
 849:           if (newLocations[idx]) {
 850:             locationIdMap[oldLoc.id] = newLocations[idx].id;
 851:             locationNameMap[oldLoc.name.toLowerCase().trim()] = newLocations[idx].id;
 852:           }
 853:         });
 854:       }
 855:     }
 856:   }
 857: 
 858:   // Import NPCs
 859:   let npcCount = 0;
 860:   if (worldData.bestiary?.npcs?.length) {
 861:     // Build name-based lookups for locations and states from DB
 862:     const locationNameToId = {};
 863:     const stateNameToId = {};
 864:     
 865:     // Fetch all states for this world to build name lookup
 866:     const { data: allStates } = await supabase
 867:       .from('states')
 868:       .select('id, name')
 869:       .eq('world_id', world.id);
 870:     
 871:     if (allStates) {
 872:       allStates.forEach(s => {
 873:         stateNameToId[s.name.toLowerCase().trim()] = s.id;
 874:       });
 875:     }
 876:     
 877:     // Fetch all locations for this world (via states)
 878:     if (allStates?.length) {
 879:       const stateIds = allStates.map(s => s.id);
 880:       const { data: allLocations } = await supabase
 881:         .from('locations')
 882:         .select('id, name')
 883:         .in('state_id', stateIds);
 884:       
 885:       if (allLocations) {
 886:         allLocations.forEach(l => {
 887:           locationNameToId[l.name.toLowerCase().trim()] = l.id;
 888:         });
 889:       }
 890:     }
 891:     
 892:     const npcs = worldData.bestiary.npcs.map(n => {
 893:       // Resolve location_id: can be UUID (from export) or name (manual JSON)
 894:       let locationId = null;
 895:       if (n.location_id) {
 896:         // Try UUID mapping first (from export)
 897:         locationId = locationIdMap[n.location_id] || null;
 898:         // Try name mapping from imported locations
 899:         if (!locationId && typeof n.location_id === 'string') {
 900:           locationId = locationNameMap[n.location_id.toLowerCase().trim()] || null;
 901:         }
 902:         // Fallback: search all locations in DB by name
 903:         if (!locationId && typeof n.location_id === 'string') {
 904:           locationId = locationNameToId[n.location_id.toLowerCase().trim()] || null;
 905:         }
 906:       }
 907:       
 908:       // Resolve state_id: can be UUID (from export) or name (manual JSON)
 909:       let stateId = null;
 910:       if (n.state_id) {
 911:         // Try UUID mapping first (from export)
 912:         stateId = stateIdMap[n.state_id] || null;
 913:         // Try name mapping from imported states
 914:         if (!stateId && typeof n.state_id === 'string') {
 915:           stateId = stateNameMap[n.state_id.toLowerCase().trim()] || null;
 916:         }
 917:         // Fallback: search all states in DB by name
 918:         if (!stateId && typeof n.state_id === 'string') {
 919:           stateId = stateNameToId[n.state_id.toLowerCase().trim()] || null;
 920:         }
 921:       }
 922:       
 923:       // Расчётные поля
 924:       const safeStats = {
 925:         STR: Number(n.stats?.STR) || 10,
 926:         DEX: Number(n.stats?.DEX) || 10,
 927:         CON: Number(n.stats?.CON) || 10,
 928:         INT: Number(n.stats?.INT) || 10,
 929:         WIS: Number(n.stats?.WIS) || 10,
 930:         CHA: Number(n.stats?.CHA) || 10,
 931:       };
 932:       const nLevel = Number(n.level) || 1;
 933:       const nHitDie = [6, 8, 10, 12].includes(Number(n.hit_dice)) ? Number(n.hit_dice) : 8;
 934:       const nRace = n.race || 'Человек';
 935:       
 936:       // HP: уровень 1 = макс кости + CON mod + 10, каждый следующий = среднее + CON mod
 937:       const calculatedHp = calculateHpDnd(safeStats.CON, nLevel, nHitDie);
 938:       
 939:       // AC: 10 + DEX mod + расовый бонус
 940:       const dexMod = Math.floor((safeStats.DEX - 10) / 2);
 941:       const raceBonus = getRaceAcBonus(nRace);
 942:       const calculatedAC = 10 + dexMod + raceBonus;
 943:       
 944:       // Initiative: DEX mod
 945:       const calculatedInit = dexMod;
 946:       
 947:       // Saving throws: stat mod + proficiency bonus
 948:       const proficiencyBonus = Math.ceil(nLevel / 4) + 1;
 949:       const calculatedSaves = {};
 950:       for (const stat of ['STR', 'DEX', 'CON', 'INT', 'WIS', 'CHA']) {
 951:         const statMod = Math.floor((safeStats[stat] - 10) / 2);
 952:         calculatedSaves[stat] = statMod + proficiencyBonus;
 953:       }
 954:       
 955:       return {
 956:         world_id: world.id,
 957:         name: n.name,
 958:         race: nRace,
 959:         category: n.category || 'npc',
 960:         class: n.class || '',
 961:         role: ['main', 'secondary', 'tertiary'].includes(n.role) ? n.role : 'secondary',
 962:         appearance: n.appearance || '',
 963:         background: n.background || '',
 964:         stats: safeStats,
 965:         // Расчётные поля
 966:         hp: calculatedHp,
 967:         max_hp: calculatedHp,
 968:         armor_class: calculatedAC,
 969:         initiative: calculatedInit,
 970:         saving_throws: calculatedSaves,
 971:         level: nLevel,
 972:         tier: n.tier || 1,
 973:         hit_dice: nHitDie,
 974:         level_min: Number(n.level_min) || nLevel,
 975:         level_max: Number(n.level_max) || nLevel,
 976:         status_tags: n.status_tags || [],
 977:         habits: n.habits || [],
 978:         catchphrases: n.catchphrases || [],
 979:         location_id: locationId,
 980:         state_id: stateId,
 981:         // Combat fields
 982:         special_attacks: Array.isArray(n.special_attacks) ? n.special_attacks : [],
 983:         base_attacks: Array.isArray(n.base_attacks) ? n.base_attacks : [],
 984:         is_pack_instance: n.is_pack === true,
 985:         pack_size: n.is_pack ? (n.pack_size || 2) : 1,
 986:         is_unique: n.is_unique === true,
 987:       };
 988:     });
 989:     
 990:     const { error: npcError } = await supabase.from('npcs').insert(npcs);
 991:     if (npcError) throw npcError;
 992:     npcCount = npcs.length;
 993:   }
 994: 
 995:   return {
 996:     world,
 997:     stats: {
 998:       loreCount,
 999:       stateCount,
1000:       locationCount,
1001:       npcCount,
1002:       hasGeography: stateCount > 0,
1003:       hasBestiary: npcCount > 0,
1004:     },
1005:   };
1006: }

1036: export async function createNpc(npc) {
1037:   const payload = { ...npc };
1038:   if (payload.location_name !== undefined) {
1039:     const locationName = payload.location_name;
1040:     delete payload.location_name;
1041:     if (locationName) {
1042:       const { data: location } = await supabase
1043:         .from('locations')
1044:         .select('id')
1045:         .ilike('name', locationName)
1046:         .maybeSingle();
1047:       payload.location_id = location?.id || null;
1048:     } else {
1049:       payload.location_id = null;
1050:     }
1051:   }
1052: 
1053:   const { data, error } = await supabase
1054:     .from('npcs')
1055:     .insert(payload)
1056:     .select()
1057:     .single();
1058:   if (error) throw error;
1059:   return data;
1060: }

1140: export async function getNpcRelationships(sessionId, playerId) {
1141:   // Получаем сессию чтобы узнать current_location_id
1142:   const { data: session } = await supabase
1143:     .from('sessions')
1144:     .select('current_location_id')
1145:     .eq('id', sessionId)
1146:     .maybeSingle();
1147: 
1148:   if (!session?.current_location_id) return [];
1149: 
1150:   // Получаем NPC в локации
1151:   const { data: npcs, error: npcsError } = await supabase
1152:     .from('npcs')
1153:     .select('id, name, race, role, status_tags, appearance, background')
1154:     .eq('location_id', session.current_location_id);
1155: 
1156:   if (npcsError) throw npcsError;
1157:   if (!npcs || npcs.length === 0) return [];
1158: 
1159:   // Получаем сохраненные отношения для этих NPC и текущего игрока
1160:   const npcIds = npcs.map((n) => n.id);
1161:   const { data: rels } = await supabase
1162:     .from('npc_relationships')
1163:     .select('*')
1164:     .in('npc_id', npcIds)
1165:     .eq('player_id', playerId);
1166: 
1167:   const relMap = new Map((rels || []).map((r) => [r.npc_id, r]));
1168: 
1169:   return npcs.map((npc) => {
1170:     const rel = relMap.get(npc.id);
1171:     const score = rel?.score ?? 0;
1172:     const tier = rel?.tier ?? 'neutral';
1173:     const statusTags = Array.from(new Set([...(npc.status_tags || []), ...(rel?.status_tags || [])]));
1174:     return {
1175:       npc,
1176:       relationship: {
1177:         score,
1178:         tier,
1179:         tier_label: getRelationshipTierLabelClient(tier),
1180:         status_tags: statusTags,
1181:         interactions_count: rel?.interactions_count ?? 0,
1182:         last_interaction_at: rel?.last_interaction_at,
1183:       },
1184:     };
1185:   });
1186: }

  22: function sanitizeAIText(raw) {
  23:   if (!raw) return "";
  24:   let text = String(raw);
  25:   text = text.replace(/[\x00-\x08\x0B\x0C\x0E-\x1F\x7F]/g, "");
  26:   text = text.replace(/[^\u0009\u000A\u000D\u0020-\u007E\u00A0-\u00FF\u0400-\u04FF]/g, "");
  27:   text = text.replace(/\b(image|img|photo|picture|avatar|icon|base64|data)\b[\s\S]*?\.(png|jpg|jpeg|gif|webp|bmp|svg)\b/gi, "");
  28:   text = text.replace(/[A-Za-z0-9+\/]{20,}={0,2}/g, "");
  29:   text = text.replace(/https?:\/\/[^\s]+/g, "");
  30:   text = text.replace(/[A-Za-z]:\\[^\s]+/g, "");
  31:   text = text.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  32:   if (text.length > 4000) text = text.slice(0, 4000);
  33:   return text;
  34: }
