  39: export async function renderGame(container, sessionId, user) {
  40:   let session = null;
  41:   let currentPlayer = null;
  42:   let allPlayers = [];
  43:   let messages = [];
  44:   let activePanel = null; // 'profile' | 'inventory' | 'settings' | 'npc' | null
  45:   let cachedNpcData = [];
  46:   let expandedMemoryNpcId = null;
  47:   let cachedMemories = {};
  48:   let isSubmitting = false;
  49:   let isMyTurn = true; // По умолчанию разрешаем ввод
  50:   let activePlayerName = '';
  51:   let playerSkills = [];
  52:   let unsubMessages = null;
  53:   let unsubPlayers = null;
  54:   let unsubTurnQueue = null;
  55:   let realtimeSubscribed = false;
  56:   const instanceId = Date.now().toString(36); // unique per render call
  57: 
  58:   // ============================================
  59:   // ТУМАН ВОЙНЫ: фильтр видимости сообщений
  60:   // Персональные сообщения Мастера (с metadata.target_player_id)
  61:   // видны ТОЛЬКО указанному игроку. Глобальный нарратив (без target)
  62:   // и системные сообщения видят все.
  63:   // ============================================
  64:   function isMessageVisibleToCurrentPlayer(msg) {
  65:     if (!msg) return false;
  66: 
  67:     // Системные сообщения — все
  68:     if (msg.sender_type === 'system') return true;
  69: 
  70:     // Свои действия видит только автор
  71:     if (msg.sender_type === 'player') {
  72:       return msg.sender_id === user.id;
  73:     }
  74: 
  75:     // Сообщения Мастера: проверяем target_player_id
  76:     if (msg.sender_type === 'master') {
  77:       const targetPlayerId = msg.metadata?.target_player_id;
  78:       // Глобальный лог: виден всем, кроме автора действия (автор уже видит подробный личный нарратив)
  79:       if (msg.metadata?.is_global === true) {
  80:         if (msg.metadata?.initiator_player_id && currentPlayer && msg.metadata.initiator_player_id === currentPlayer.id) {
  81:           return false;
  82:         }
  83:         return true;
  84:       }
  85:       if (!targetPlayerId) {
  86:         return true;
  87:       }
  88:       // Персональный нарратив — только адресату
  89:       return currentPlayer && targetPlayerId === currentPlayer.id;
  90:     }
  91: 
  92:     // Сообщения NPC (диалоги, спутники, реплики в сцене) — видны всем игрокам
  93:     if (msg.sender_type === 'npc') {
  94:       return true;
  95:     }
  96: 
  97:     return false;
  98:   }
  99: 
 100:   async function load() {
 101:     try {
 102:       session = await getSession(sessionId);
 103:       if (!session) {
 104:         toast.error('Сессия не найдена');
 105:         router.navigate('/');
 106:         return;
 107:       }
 108:       allPlayers = await getSessionPlayers(sessionId);
 109:       // Определяем текущего игрока для данного пользователя
 110:       currentPlayer = user?.id ? allPlayers.find((p) => p.user_id === user.id) : null;
 111:       if (!currentPlayer && allPlayers.length === 1 && !allPlayers[0].user_id) {
 112:         currentPlayer = allPlayers[0];
 113:       }
 114:       messages = await getSessionMessages(sessionId);
 115: 
 116:       // Если персонаж уже есть, проверяем очередь ходов и загружаем навыки
 117:       if (currentPlayer) {
 118:         try {
 119:           playerSkills = await getPlayerSkills(currentPlayer.id);
 120:         } catch (skErr) {
 121:           console.warn('Failed to load player skills:', skErr);
 122:         }
 123:         await checkTurnQueue();
 124:       }
 125:     } catch (err) {
 126:       toast.error('Ошибка загрузки: ' + err.message);
 127:       router.navigate('/');
 128:       return;
 129:     }
 130: 
 131:     if (!currentPlayer) {
 132:       renderCharacterCreation();
 133:       return;
 134:     }
 135: 
 136:     render();
 137:     subscribeRealtime();
 138:   }
 139: 
 140:   // ============================================
 141:   // ОЧЕРЕДЬ ХОДОВ: проверка и подписка
 142:   // ============================================
 143:   async function checkTurnQueue() {
 144:     if (!currentPlayer) return;
 145: 
 146:     // Если в сессии 1 игрок — всегда его ход
 147:     if (allPlayers.length <= 1) {
 148:       isMyTurn = true;
 149:       activePlayerName = currentPlayer.name || 'Герой';
 150:       updateInputState();
 151:       return;
 152:     }
 153: 
 154:     try {
 155:       let currentTurn = await getCurrentTurn(sessionId);
 156:       if (!currentTurn) {
 157:         // Очередь пуста или нет активного хода — самоисцеление/инициализация
 158:         currentTurn = await initTurnQueue(sessionId, allPlayers);
 159:       }
 160:       if (currentTurn) {
 161:         isMyTurn = currentTurn.player_id === currentPlayer.id;
 162:         const activeP = allPlayers.find((p) => p.id === currentTurn.player_id);
 163:         activePlayerName = activeP ? (activeP.name || 'Герой') : 'Напарник';
 164:       } else {
 165:         // Нет активного хода — разрешаем ввод
 166:         isMyTurn = true;
 167:         activePlayerName = currentPlayer.name || 'Герой';
 168:       }
 169:     } catch (err) {
 170:       console.warn('checkTurnQueue fallback:', err);
 171:       isMyTurn = true;
 172:       activePlayerName = currentPlayer.name || 'Герой';
 173:     }
 174:     updateInputState();
 175:   }
 176: 
 177:   function subscribeRealtime() {
 178:     if (realtimeSubscribed) return; // prevent double-subscribe
 179:     realtimeSubscribed = true;
 180: 
 181:     unsubMessages = subscribeToSessionMessages(sessionId, (payload) => {
 182:       if (payload.eventType === 'INSERT') {
 183:         const msg = payload.new;
 184:         // Добавляем в массив (для истории), но рисуем только то, что видно
 185:         messages.push(msg);
 186:         if (isMessageVisibleToCurrentPlayer(msg)) {
 187:           appendMessage(msg);
 188:         }
 189:       }
 190:     });
 191: 
 192:     unsubPlayers = subscribeToSessionPlayers(sessionId, async (payload) => {
 193:       if (payload.eventType === 'INSERT') {
 194:         const newPlayer = payload.new;
 195:         const exists = allPlayers.some((p) => p.id === newPlayer.id);
 196:         if (!exists) {
 197:           allPlayers.push(newPlayer);
 198:           toast.info(`Игрок «${newPlayer.name || 'Герой'}» присоединился к сессии!`);
 199:           const countEl = document.getElementById('participantsCount');
 200:           if (countEl) countEl.textContent = `Участники (${allPlayers.length})`;
 201:           const listEl = document.getElementById('sessionPlayersList');
 202:           if (listEl) listEl.innerHTML = renderSessionParticipants(allPlayers);
 203:           await checkTurnQueue();
 204:         }
 205:       } else if (payload.eventType === 'UPDATE') {
 206:         const idx = allPlayers.findIndex((p) => p.id === payload.new.id);
 207:         if (idx >= 0) allPlayers[idx] = { ...allPlayers[idx], ...payload.new };
 208:         if (currentPlayer && currentPlayer.id === payload.new.id) {
 209:           currentPlayer = { ...currentPlayer, ...payload.new };
 210:           updatePlayerUI();
 211:         }
 212:       } else if (payload.eventType === 'DELETE') {
 213:         allPlayers = allPlayers.filter((p) => p.id !== payload.old.id);
 214:         await checkTurnQueue();
 215:       }
 216:     });
 217: 
 218:     // Подписка на очередь ходов — уникальное имя канала во избежание конфликтов
 219:     unsubTurnQueue = supabase
 220:       .channel(`turn_queue:${sessionId}:${instanceId}`)
 221:       .on(
 222:         'postgres_changes',
 223:         {
 224:           event: '*',
 225:           schema: 'public',
 226:           table: 'turn_queue',
 227:           filter: `session_id=eq.${sessionId}`,
 228:         },
 229:         (payload) => {
 230:           handleTurnUpdate(payload);
 231:         }
 232:       )
 233:       .subscribe();
 234:   }
 235: 
 236:   let activeTurnEntityType = 'player';
 237: 
 238:   function handleTurnUpdate(payload) {
 239:     if (!currentPlayer) return;
 240: 
 241:     if (payload.eventType === 'INSERT' || payload.eventType === 'UPDATE') {
 242:       const turn = payload.new;
 243:       if (turn.status === 'active') {
 244:         const wasMyTurn = isMyTurn;
 245:         activeTurnEntityType = turn.entity_type || (turn.npc_id ? 'npc' : 'player');
 246:         if (activeTurnEntityType === 'npc') {
 247:           isMyTurn = false;
 248:           activePlayerName = 'Враг / NPC';
 249:         } else {
 250:           isMyTurn = turn.player_id === currentPlayer.id;
 251:           const activeP = allPlayers.find((p) => p.id === turn.player_id);
 252:           activePlayerName = activeP ? (activeP.name || 'Герой') : 'Напарник';
 253:         }
 254: 
 255:         // Снимаем блокировку, когда наступает наш ход
 256:         if (!wasMyTurn && isMyTurn) {
 257:           toast.info('Ваш ход!');
 258:         }
 259: 
 260:         updateInputState();
 261:       }
 262:     }
 263: 
 264:     if (payload.eventType === 'DELETE') {
 265:       checkTurnQueue();
 266:     }
 267:   }
 268: 
 269:   function updateInputState() {
 270:     const input = document.getElementById('actionInput');
 271:     const sendBtn = document.getElementById('sendBtn');
 272:     const turnIndicator = document.getElementById('turnIndicator');
 273:     const takeTurnBtn = document.getElementById('takeTurnBtn');
 274: 
 275:     const hasMultiplePlayers = allPlayers.length > 1;
 276: 
 277:     if (turnIndicator) {
 278:       if (activeTurnEntityType === 'npc') {
 279:         turnIndicator.innerHTML = '<span class="badge badge-error" style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;">⚔️ Ход противника / NPC</span>';
 280:       } else if (!hasMultiplePlayers) {
 281:         turnIndicator.innerHTML = '';
 282:       } else if (isMyTurn) {
 283:         turnIndicator.innerHTML = '<span class="badge badge-success" style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;">🟢 Ваш ход</span>';
 284:       } else {
 285:         turnIndicator.innerHTML = `<span class="badge badge-warning" style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;">⏳ Ход: ${escapeHtml(activePlayerName || 'Напарник')}</span>`;
 286:       }
 287:     }
 288: 
 289:     if (takeTurnBtn) {
 290:       takeTurnBtn.style.display = (hasMultiplePlayers && !isMyTurn) ? 'inline-flex' : 'none';
 291:     }
 292: 
 293:     if (!input || !sendBtn) return;
 294: 
 295:     if (!isMyTurn || isSubmitting) {
 296:       input.disabled = true;
 297:       input.placeholder = isSubmitting
 298:         ? 'Обработка действия...'
 299:         : (activeTurnEntityType === 'npc' ? 'Ход противника / NPC...' : `Ожидание действий напарника (${activePlayerName || 'другой игрок'})...`);
 300:       sendBtn.disabled = true;
 301:     } else {
 302:       input.disabled = false;
 303:       input.placeholder = 'Опишите действие вашего героя...';
 304:       sendBtn.disabled = false;
 305:     }
 306:   }

 463:   function renderMessage(msg) {
 464:     if (msg.sender_type === 'master') {
 465:       const isGlobalLog = msg.metadata?.is_global === true || msg.metadata?.type === 'global_log';
 466:       return `
 467:         <div class="message ${isGlobalLog ? 'message-system' : 'message-master'}">
 468:           <div class="message-avatar">${isGlobalLog ? '📜' : '🎭'}</div>
 469:           <div class="message-body">
 470:             ${isGlobalLog ? '<div class="message-sender" style="font-size: var(--fs-xs); color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 2px;">Общий лог комнаты</div>' : ''}
 471:             <div class="message-text">${escapeHtml(msg.content)}</div>
 472:           </div>
 473:         </div>
 474:       `;
 475:     }
 476: 
 477:     if (msg.sender_type === 'system') {
 478:       return `
 479:         <div class="message message-system">
 480:           <div class="message-text">${escapeHtml(msg.content)}</div>
 481:         </div>
 482:       `;
 483:     }
 484: 
 485:     // Сообщения игроков: показываем ТОЛЬКО свои
 486:     if (msg.sender_type === 'player') {
 487:       if (msg.sender_id === user.id) {
 488:         return `
 489:           <div class="message message-self">
 490:             <div class="message-body">
 491:               <div class="message-text">${escapeHtml(msg.content)}</div>
 492:             </div>
 493:             <div class="message-avatar">⚔️</div>
 494:           </div>
 495:         `;
 496:       }
 497:       return ''; // Чужие сообщения скрыты
 498:     }
 499: 
 500:     return '';
 501:   }

 503:   function renderProfile(player) {
 504:     if (!player) return '';
 505:     const stats = player.stats || {};
 506:     const safeMaxHp = Math.max(1, player.max_hp || 1);
 507:     const hpRatio = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (player.hp || 0) / safeMaxHp));
 508:     const hpClass = hpRatio > 0.5 ? '' : hpRatio > 0.25 ? 'low' : 'critical';
 509:     const hpPct = hpRatio * 100;
 510: 
 511:     const safeMaxMp = Math.max(1, player.max_mp ?? 50);
 512:     const mpRatio = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (player.mp ?? 50) / safeMaxMp));
 513:     const mpPct = mpRatio * 100;
 514: 
 515:     const currentLvl = player.level || 1;
 516:     const currentXp = player.xp || 0;
 517:     const xpNeeded = currentLvl * 100;
 518:     const xpPct = Math.min(100, Math.floor((currentXp / xpNeeded) * 100));
 519: 
 520:     const freeStatPoints = player.stat_points || 0;
 521: 
 522:     const statsHtml = STATS.map((stat) => {
 523:       const baseValue = stats[stat] || 10;
 524:       const injuryPenalty = (player.injuries || [])
 525:         .filter(i => !i.cured_at && i.stat_penalties?.[stat])
 526:         .reduce((sum, i) => sum + (Number(i.stat_penalties[stat]) || 0), 0);
 527:       const displayValue = baseValue + injuryPenalty;
 528:       const mod = Math.floor((displayValue - 10) / 2);
 529:       return `
 530:         <div class="stat-card" style="position: relative;">
 531:           <div class="stat-card-label">${stat}</div>
 532:           <div class="stat-card-value">${displayValue}</div>
 533:           <div class="stat-card-modifier">${mod >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${mod}</div>
 534:           ${freeStatPoints > 0 ? `
 535:             <button class="btn btn-xs btn-primary allocate-stat-btn" data-stat="${stat}" style="margin-top: 4px; padding: 1px 8px; font-size: 11px; width: 100%;" title="Повысить ${stat} на +1 (БЕЗ лимита в 20)">+1</button>
 536:           ` : ''}
 537:         </div>
 538:       `;
 539:     }).join('');
 540: 
 541:     const derived = calculateDerivedStats(stats, player.race || 'Человек', player.inventory || [], player.race_ac_bonus);
 542:     const initiative = derived.initiative;
 543:     const armorClass = derived.armor_class;
 544:     const savingThrows = derived.saving_throws;
 545:     const savingThrowsHtml = STATS.map((stat) => {
 546:       const baseMod = Math.floor(((stats[stat] || 10) - 10) / 2);
 547:       const injuryPenalty = (player.injuries || [])
 548:         .filter(i => !i.cured_at && i.stat_penalties?.[stat])
 549:         .reduce((sum, i) => sum + (Number(i.stat_penalties[stat]) || 0), 0);
 550:       const totalMod = baseMod + 2 + injuryPenalty;
 551:       return `
 552:         <div class="stat-card">
 553:           <div class="stat-card-label">${stat}</div>
 554:           <div class="stat-card-value">${totalMod >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${totalMod}</div>
 555:         </div>
 556:       `;
 557:     }).join('');
 558: 
 559:     const activeInjuries = (player.injuries || []).filter(i => !i.cured_at);
 560:     const injuriesHtml = activeInjuries.length ? `
 561:       <div class="profile-section">
 562:         <h4 class="profile-section-title">⚠️ Травмы</h4>
 563:         ${activeInjuries.map(injury => `
 564:           <div class="profile-injuries" style="margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">
 565:             <div style="font-weight: 600;">${escapeHtml(injury.injury_type)}</div>
 566:             <div style="font-size: var(--fs-sm); margin-top: 0.25rem;">${escapeHtml(injury.description || '')}</div>
 567:             ${injury.stat_penalties && Object.keys(injury.stat_penalties).length > 0 ? `
 568:               <div style="font-size: var(--fs-xs); margin-top: 0.25rem; color: var(--text-muted);">
 569:                 Штрафы: ${Object.entries(injury.stat_penalties).map(([k, v]) => `${k} ${Number(v) >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${Number(v)}`).join(', ')}
 570:               </div>
 571:             ` : ''}
 572:             ${injury.duration_hours ? `<div style="font-size: var(--fs-xs); color: var(--text-muted);">Длительность: ${injury.duration_hours}ч</div>` : ''}
 573:             ${injury.is_permanent ? '<div style="font-size: var(--fs-xs); font-weight: 600;">Постоянная</div>' : ''}
 574:           </div>
 575:         `).join('')}
 576:       </div>
 577:     ` : '';
 578: 
 579:     return `
 580:       <div class="profile-card">
 581:         <div class="profile-avatar">⚔️</div>
 582:         <h3 class="profile-name">${escapeHtml(player?.name || 'Герой')}</h3>
 583:         <p class="profile-meta">${escapeHtml(player?.race || '')} / ${escapeHtml(player?.class || '')}</p>
 584: 
 585:         <!-- Track 1: Уровень и Опыт -->
 586:         <div class="profile-section" style="width: 100%; background: var(--bg-card); border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border-color);">
 587:           <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 6px;">

 712:   function renderInventory(player) {
 713:     const inventory = player.inventory || [];
 714:     const totalWeight = inventory.reduce((sum, item) => sum + (item.quantity || 1), 0);
 715: 
 716:     return `
 717:       <div class="inventory-content">
 718:         <div class="inventory-summary">
 719:           <span>💰 ${player.money || 0} золота</span>
 720:           <span>📦 ${totalWeight} предметов</span>
 721:         </div>
 722: 
 723:         <div class="inventory-list">
 724:           ${inventory.length ? inventory.map((item) => {
 725:             const meta = getItemMeta(item.type);
 726:             return `
 727:             <div class="inventory-item">
 728:               <div class="inventory-item-info">
 729:                 <div class="inventory-item-name">${escapeHtml(item.item_name)}</div>
 730:                 <div class="inventory-item-meta">
 731:                   <span class="badge badge-${meta.badge}">${meta.icon} ${escapeHtml(meta.label)}</span>
 732:                   ${item.quantity > 1 ? `<span>x${item.quantity}</span>` : ''}
 733:                 </div>
 734:               </div>
 735:               ${item.attributes ? `
 736:                 <div class="inventory-item-stats text-muted" style="font-size: var(--fs-xs);">
 737:                   ${Object.entries(item.attributes).map(([k, v]) => `${k}: ${v}`).join(', ')}
 738:                 </div>
 739:               ` : ''}
 740:             </div>
 741:             `;
 742:           }).join('') : `
 743:             <div class="empty-state">
 744:               <p class="text-muted">Инвентарь пуст</p>
 745:             </div>
 746:           `}
 747:         </div>
 748:       </div>
 749:     `;
 750:   }

 810:   function getTierColor(tier) {
 811:     switch (tier) {
 812:       case 'sworn_enemy': return '#ef4444';
 813:       case 'hostile': return '#f97316';
 814:       case 'unfriendly': return '#eab308';
 815:       case 'neutral': return '#94a3b8';
 816:       case 'friendly': return '#10b981';
 817:       case 'trusted': return '#06b6d4';
 818:       case 'devoted': return '#a855f7';
 819:       default: return '#94a3b8';
 820:     }
 821:   }

 823:   function renderNpcList(items) {
 824:     if (!items || items.length === 0) {
 825:       return `
 826:         <div class="empty-state" style="padding: 2rem 1rem; text-align: center;">
 827:           <div style="font-size: 2rem; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">👥</div>
 828:           <p class="text-muted">В этой локации нет известных NPC</p>
 829:         </div>
 830:       `;
 831:     }
 832:     return `
 833:       <div class="npc-relationships-list">
 834:         ${items.map(renderNpcCard).join('')}
 835:       </div>
 836:     `;

 839:   function renderNpcCard(item) {
 840:     const { npc, relationship } = item;
 841:     const score = relationship.score || 0;
 842:     const tier = relationship.tier || 'neutral';
 843:     const tierColor = getTierColor(tier);
 844:     const tierLabel = relationship.tier_label || getRelationshipTierLabelClient(tier);
 845:     const isExpanded = expandedMemoryNpcId === npc.id;
 846:     const memories = cachedMemories[npc.id] || [];
 847: 
 848:     let barLeft = '50%';
 849:     let barWidth = '0%';
 850:     if (score >= 0) {
 851:       barLeft = '50%';
 852:       barWidth = `${Math.min(50, (score / 100) * 50)}%`;
 853:     } else {
 854:       const widthPct = Math.min(50, (Math.abs(score) / 100) * 50);
 855:       barLeft = `${50 - widthPct}%`;
 856:       barWidth = `${widthPct}%`;
 857:     }
 858: 
 859:     return `
 860:       <div class="npc-rel-card" data-npc-id="${npc.id}">
 861:         <div class="npc-rel-header">
 862:           <div>
 863:             <div class="npc-rel-name">${escapeHtml(npc.name)}</div>
 864:             <div class="npc-rel-meta">${escapeHtml(npc.race || 'Гуманоид')} · ${escapeHtml(npc.role || 'Житель')}</div>
 865:           </div>
 866:           <span class="npc-tier-badge" style="background: ${tierColor}20; color: ${tierColor}; border: 1px solid ${tierColor}50;">
 867:             ${escapeHtml(tierLabel)}
 868:           </span>
 869:         </div>
 870: 
 871:         <!-- Шкала отношений (-100..+100) -->
 872:         <div class="rel-bar-wrapper">
 873:           <div class="rel-bar-labels">
 874:             <span>Враг (-100)</span>
 875:             <span style="font-weight: 700; color: ${tierColor};">${score > 0 ? `+${score}` : score} / 100</span>
 876:             <span>Предан (+100)</span>
 877:           </div>
 878:           <div class="rel-bar-track">
 879:             <div class="rel-bar-center-marker"></div>
 880:             <div class="rel-bar-fill" style="left: ${barLeft}; width: ${barWidth}; background: ${tierColor};"></div>
 881:           </div>
 882:         </div>
 883: 
 884:         ${relationship.status_tags?.length ? `
 885:           <div class="npc-status-tags">
 886:             ${relationship.status_tags.map((t) => `<span class="npc-tag">#${escapeHtml(t)}</span>`).join('')}
 887:           </div>
 888:         ` : ''}
 889: 
 890:         <!-- Аккордеон воспоминаний -->
 891:         <div class="npc-memories-wrapper" style="margin-top: 4px;">
 892:           <button class="npc-memories-toggle" data-toggle-memories="${npc.id}">
 893:             <span>💭 Воспоминания NPC (${memories.length})</span>
 894:             <span>${isExpanded ? '▲' : '▼'}</span>
 895:           </button>
 896:           <div class="npc-memories-body" id="memories-body-${npc.id}" style="display: ${isExpanded ? 'flex' : 'none'};">
 897:             ${renderMemoriesBody(npc.id)}
 898:           </div>
 899:         </div>
 900:       </div>
 901:     `;
 902:   }

 904:   function renderMemoriesBody(npcId) {
 905:     const list = cachedMemories[npcId];
 906:     if (list === undefined) {
 907:       return '<div style="color: var(--text-muted); text-align: center;">Загрузка воспоминаний...</div>';
 908:     }
 909:     if (!list || list.length === 0) {
 910:       return '<div style="color: var(--text-muted); font-style: italic;">Пока нет воспоминаний об общении с этим героем.</div>';
 911:     }
 912: 
 913:     return list.map((m) => {
 914:       const typeClass = m.memory_type || (m.vividness >= 8 ? 'vivid' : m.vividness <= 3 ? 'impression' : 'regular');
 915:       const icon = typeClass === 'vivid' ? '🌟' : typeClass === 'belief' ? '🔮' : typeClass === 'impression' ? '💭' : '📜';
 916:       const typeLabel = typeClass === 'vivid' ? 'Яркое' : typeClass === 'belief' ? 'Убеждение' : typeClass === 'impression' ? 'Впечатление' : 'Обычное';
 917:       return `
 918:         <div class="memory-item ${typeClass}">
 919:           <div class="memory-item-header">
 920:             <span>${icon} ${typeLabel}${m.vividness ? ` · Яркость ${m.vividness}/10` : ''}</span>
 921:             ${m.emotional_tone ? `<span>[${escapeHtml(m.emotional_tone)}]</span>` : ''}
 922:           </div>
 923:           <div class="memory-item-text">«${escapeHtml(m.memory_text || m.content || '')}»</div>
 924:           ${m.significance_reason ? `<div style="font-size: 0.68rem; color: var(--text-muted);">Причина: ${escapeHtml(m.significance_reason)}</div>` : ''}
 925:         </div>
 926:       `;
 927:     }).join('');
 928:   }

 930:   async function refreshNpcPanel() {
 931:     if (!currentPlayer || !sessionId) return;
 932:     const content = document.getElementById('npcContent');
 933:     if (content && (!cachedNpcData || cachedNpcData.length === 0)) {
 934:       content.innerHTML = '<div style="padding: 1rem; text-align: center; color: var(--text-muted);">Загрузка персонажей...</div>';
 935:     }
 936:     try {
 937:       cachedNpcData = await getNpcRelationships(sessionId, currentPlayer.id);
 938:       if (content) {
 939:         content.innerHTML = renderNpcList(cachedNpcData);
 940:         bindNpcCardEvents();
 941:       }
 942:     } catch (err) {
 943:       console.warn('Failed to load NPC relationships:', err);
 944:       if (content) content.innerHTML = '<div style="padding: 1rem; color: var(--accent-danger);">Ошибка загрузки NPC</div>';
 945:     }
 946:   }
 947: 
 948:   function bindNpcCardEvents() {
 949:     document.querySelectorAll('[data-toggle-memories]').forEach((btn) => {
 950:       btn.addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
 951:         e.stopPropagation();
 952:         const npcId = btn.getAttribute('data-toggle-memories');
 953:         if (expandedMemoryNpcId === npcId) {
 954:           expandedMemoryNpcId = null;
 955:         } else {
 956:           expandedMemoryNpcId = npcId;
 957:           if (cachedMemories[npcId] === undefined) {
 958:             try {
 959:               const mems = await getNpcMemories(npcId, currentPlayer.id);
 960:               cachedMemories[npcId] = mems || [];
 961:             } catch (memErr) {
 962:               console.warn('Failed to load NPC memories:', memErr);
 963:               cachedMemories[npcId] = [];
 964:             }
 965:           }
 966:         }
 967:         const content = document.getElementById('npcContent');
 968:         if (content) {
 969:           content.innerHTML = renderNpcList(cachedNpcData);
 970:           bindNpcCardEvents();
 971:         }
 972:       });
 973:     });
 974:   }

1139:   async function refreshStoryPanel() {
1140:     try {
1141:       const fresh = await getSession(sessionId);
1142:       if (fresh) session = fresh;
1143:       const content = document.getElementById('storyContent');
1144:       if (content) {
1145:         content.innerHTML = renderStoryPanel(session?.storyline);
1146:         bindStoryEvents();
1147:       }
1148:     } catch (e) {
1149:       console.warn('Failed to refresh story panel:', e);
1150:     }
1151:   }

1155:     document.getElementById('generateStoryBtn')?.addEventListener('click', async () => {
1156:       const btn = document.getElementById('generateStoryBtn');
1157:       const wishesInput = document.getElementById('storyWishesInput');
1158:       const wishes = wishesInput?.value?.trim() || '';
1159:       try {
1160:         if (btn) {
1161:           btn.disabled = true;
1162:           btn.textContent = '⏳ Генерация сюжета...';
1163:         }
1164:         toast.info('ИИ создаёт сюжетную кампанию по миру...');
1165:         const newStory = await generateStorylineForSession({
1166:           sessionId,
1167:           worldId: session?.world_id,
1168:           customWishes: wishes,
1169:         });
1170:         session.storyline = newStory;
1171:         toast.success('Сюжетная линия успешно создана!');
1172:         await refreshStoryPanel();
1173:       } catch (err) {
1174:         toast.error('Ошибка генерации сюжета: ' + (err.message || err));
1175:         if (btn) {
1176:           btn.disabled = false;
1177:           btn.textContent = '✨ Сгенерировать сюжет по миру';
1178:         }
1179:       }
1180:     });

1188:         rewriteContainer.style.display = isHidden ? 'flex' : 'none';
1189:       }
1190:     });

1199:       const confirmBtn = document.getElementById('confirmRewriteStoryBtn');
1200:       try {
1201:         if (confirmBtn) {
1202:           confirmBtn.disabled = true;
1203:           confirmBtn.textContent = '⏳ Переписываю...';
1204:         }
1205:         toast.info('ИИ переписывает сюжет...');
1206:         const updated = await rewriteStoryline({
1207:           sessionId,
1208:           worldId: session?.world_id,
1209:           customWishes: wishes,
1210:           currentStoryline: session?.storyline,
1211:         });
1212:         session.storyline = updated;
1213:         toast.success('Сюжет обновлен!');
1214:         await refreshStoryPanel();
1215:       } catch (err) {
1216:         toast.error('Ошибка обновления сюжета: ' + (err.message || err));
1217:         if (confirmBtn) {
1218:           confirmBtn.disabled = false;
1219:           confirmBtn.textContent = 'Переписать';
1220:         }
1221:       }
1222:     });

1230:         const isHidden = editJsonContainer.style.display === 'none';
1231:         editJsonContainer.style.display = isHidden ? 'flex' : 'none';
1232:         if (isHidden && editJsonArea && session?.storyline) {
1233:           editJsonArea.value = JSON.stringify(session.storyline, null, 2);
1234:         }
1235:       }
1236:     });
1237:     document.getElementById('cancelEditStoryJsonBtn')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
1238:       if (editJsonContainer) editJsonContainer.style.display = 'none';

1249:         await refreshStoryPanel();

1258:       try {

1368:   function bindProfileEvents() {
1369:     document.querySelectorAll('.allocate-stat-btn').forEach((btn) => {
1370:       btn.addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
1371:         e.stopPropagation();
1372:         const statName = btn.getAttribute('data-stat');
1373:         if (!statName || !currentPlayer) return;
1374:         try {
1375:           toast.info(`Вкладываем 1 очко в ${statName}...`);
1376:           const res = await allocateStatPoints(currentPlayer.id, statName, 1);
1377:           if (res?.success) {
1378:             toast.success(`${statName} повышена до ${res.new_value}!`);
1379:             await refreshProfile();
1380:           } else {
1381:             toast.error(res?.error || 'Не удалось распределить очки');
1382:           }
1383:         } catch (err) {
1384:           toast.error('Ошибка: ' + err.message);
1385:         }
1386:       });
1387:     });
1388:   }

1390:   async function refreshProfile() {
1391:     if (!currentPlayer) return;
1392:     try {
1393:       const [freshPlayer, skills] = await Promise.all([
1394:         getPlayer(currentPlayer.id),
1395:         getPlayerSkills(currentPlayer.id),
1396:       ]);
1397:       if (freshPlayer) {
1398:         currentPlayer = { ...currentPlayer, ...freshPlayer };
1399:       }
1400:       playerSkills = skills || [];
1401:       const content = document.getElementById('profileContent');
1402:       if (content) {
1403:         content.innerHTML = renderProfile(currentPlayer);
1404:         bindProfileEvents();
1405:       }
1406:     } catch (e) {
1407:       console.warn('Failed to refresh profile:', e);
1408:     }
1409:   }
1410: 
1411:   async function refreshInventory() {
1412:     if (!currentPlayer) return;
1413:     try {
1414:       const inv = await getPlayerInventory(currentPlayer.id);
1415:       currentPlayer = { ...currentPlayer, inventory: inv || [] };
1416:       const content = document.getElementById('inventoryContent');
1417:       if (content) content.innerHTML = renderInventory(currentPlayer);
1418:     } catch (e) {
1419:       console.warn('Failed to refresh inventory:', e);
1420:     }
1421:   }

1423:   async function togglePanel(panel) {
1424:     activePanel = activePanel === panel ? null : panel;
1425:     render();
1426:     if (activePanel === 'inventory') {
1427:       await refreshInventory();
1428:     } else if (activePanel === 'npc') {
1429:       await refreshNpcPanel();
1430:     } else if (activePanel === 'profile') {
1431:       await refreshProfile();
1432:     } else if (activePanel === 'story') {
1433:       await refreshStoryPanel();
1434:     }
1435:   }

1438:   async function handleSend() {
1439:     if (isSubmitting || !currentPlayer || !isMyTurn) return;
1440: 
1441:     const input = document.getElementById('actionInput');
1442:     const text = input?.value?.trim();
1443:     if (!text) return;
1444: 
1445:     isSubmitting = true;
1446:     input.value = '';
1447:     input.style.height = 'auto';
1448:     updateInputState();
1449: 
1450:     try {
1451:       const result = await submitAction(sessionId, currentPlayer.id, sanitizeAIText(text));
1452: 
1453:       if (result.status === 'clarification_needed' && result.clarification_msg) {
1454:         toast.warning(result.clarification_msg);
1455:         return;
1456:       }
1457: 
1458:       if (result.error) {
1459:         toast.error(result.error);
1460:         return;
1461:       }
1462: 
1463:       if (result.rest_result?.is_rest) {
1464:         const restInfo = result.rest_result;
1465:         let restMessage = `Отдых: ${restInfo.rest_quality || 'normal'} (${restInfo.rest_duration_hours || 0}ч)`;
1466:         if (restInfo.hp_recovery) {
1467:           restMessage += `. Восстановлено HP: ${restInfo.hp_recovery}`;
1468:         }
1469:         if (restInfo.injuries?.length) {
1470:           restMessage += `. Получены травмы: ${restInfo.injuries.map(i => i.type).join(', ')}`;
1471:         }
1472:         toast.info(restMessage);
1473: 
1474:         if (restInfo.new_hp !== undefined) {
1475:           currentPlayer = { ...currentPlayer, hp: restInfo.new_hp };
1476:         }
1477:         if (restInfo.injuries?.length) {
1478:           currentPlayer = {
1479:             ...currentPlayer,
1480:             injuries: [...(currentPlayer.injuries || []), ...restInfo.injuries],
1481:           };
1482:         }
1483:       }
1484: 
1485:       if (result.hp_change) {
1486:         currentPlayer = { ...currentPlayer, hp: (currentPlayer.hp || 0) + result.hp_change };
1487:       }
1488: 
1489:       // Обновление времени сессии при наличии
1490:       if (result.game_time) {
1491:         session = {
1492:           ...session,
1493:           game_year: result.game_time.year,
1494:           game_month: result.game_time.month,
1495:           game_day: result.game_time.day,
1496:           game_hour: result.game_time.hour,
1497:           game_minute: result.game_time.minute,
1498:         };
1499:       }
1500: 
1501:       // Обновление локации при смене или генерации начальной локации
1502:       if (result.current_location_name || result.current_wild_zone !== undefined) {
1503:         session = {
1504:           ...session,
1505:           current_location_name: result.current_location_name,
1506:           current_state_name: result.current_state_name || session?.current_state_name,
1507:           current_location_id: result.new_location_id || session?.current_location_id,
1508:           current_wild_zone: result.current_wild_zone !== undefined ? result.current_wild_zone : session?.current_wild_zone,
1509:         };
1510:       }
1511: 
1512: 
1513:       // Обновление локации при смене
1514:       if (result.location_changed) {
1515:         try {
1516:           const freshSession = await getSession(sessionId);
1517:           if (freshSession) session = freshSession;
1518:           cachedNpcData = [];
1519:           cachedMemories = {};
1520:         } catch (e) {
1521:           console.warn('Failed to reload session after location change:', e);
1522:         }
1523:       }
1524: 
1525:       // Оповещения об изменении отношений и памяти NPC
1526:       if (Array.isArray(result.npc_updates) && result.npc_updates.length > 0) {
1527:         for (const update of result.npc_updates) {
1528:           const deltaSign = update.delta > 0 ? `+${update.delta}` : `${update.delta}`;
1529:           const toneIcon = update.delta > 0 ? '💚' : update.delta < 0 ? '💔' : '💬';
1530:           toast.info(`${toneIcon} ${update.npc_name}: ${update.tier_label} (${update.score}/100, ${deltaSign})`);
1531:         }
1532:         if (activePanel === 'npc') {
1533:           refreshNpcPanel();
1534:         }
1535:       }
1536: 
1537:       // Оповещения о сюжетном прогрессе (автоматическое отслеживание)
1538:       if (result.story_progress) {
1539:         try {
1540:           const freshSession = await getSession(sessionId);
1541:           if (freshSession) session = freshSession;
1542:           if (result.story_progress.completed_goals?.length > 0) {
1543:             toast.success(`🎯 Цель сюжета выполнена: ${result.story_progress.completed_goals.join(', ')}`);
1544:           }
1545:           if (result.story_progress.advanced_arc) {
1546:             toast.success(`📜 Сюжет продвинулся к следующему акту!`);
1547:           }
1548:           if (activePanel === 'story') {
1549:             await refreshStoryPanel();
1550:           }
1551:         } catch (e) {
1552:           console.warn('Failed to reload session after story progress:', e);
1553:         }
1554:       }
1555: 
1556:       // Уведомления о спутниках, навыках и уровнях
1557:       if (result.companion_action) {
1558:         toast.info(`🤝 ${result.companion_action.npc_name}: ${result.companion_action.dialogue}`);
1559:       }
1560:       if (result.skill_progress?.leveled_up) {
1561:         toast.success(`🔔 Навык повышен! ${result.skill_progress.name} ур. ${result.skill_progress.level}!`);
1562:       }
1563:       if (result.level_up) {
1564:         toast.success(`🎉 Новый уровень ${result.level_up.new_level}! Получено +2 свободных очка характеристик (ОХ)!`);
1565:       }
1566: 
1567:       // Обновление данных игрока, навыков и инвентаря
1568:       try {
1569:         const [freshPlayer, freshSkills] = await Promise.all([
1570:           getPlayer(currentPlayer.id),
1571:           getPlayerSkills(currentPlayer.id),
1572:         ]);
1573:         if (freshPlayer) {
1574:           currentPlayer = freshPlayer;
1575:         }
1576:         if (freshSkills) {
1577:           playerSkills = freshSkills;
1578:         }
1579:       } catch {
1580:         await refreshInventory();
1581:       }
1582: 
1583:       render();
1584:     } catch (err) {
1585:       if (err.message === 'MISSING_API_KEY') {
1586:         toast.error('Не задан OpenRouter API Key. Откройте «⚙️ Аккаунт» в лобби и введите ключ.');
1587:       } else {
1588:         toast.error('Ошибка обработки: ' + err.message);
1589:       }
1590:     } finally {
1591:       isSubmitting = false;
1592:       updateInputState();
1593:     }
1594:   }

1596:   function appendMessage(msg) {
1597:     // ТУМАН ВОЙНЫ: единая функция проверки видимости
1598:     if (!isMessageVisibleToCurrentPlayer(msg)) return;
1599: 
1600:     const chatMessages = document.getElementById('chatMessages');
1601:     if (!chatMessages) return;
1602: 
1603:     // Remove empty state if present
1604:     const empty = chatMessages.querySelector('.chat-empty');
1605:     if (empty) empty.remove();
1606: 
1607:     const html = renderMessage(msg);
1608:     if (!html) return;
1609: 
1610:     const div = document.createElement('div');
1611:     div.innerHTML = html;
1612:     chatMessages.appendChild(div.firstElementChild);
1613:     scrollToBottom();
1614:   }

1616:   function updatePlayerUI() {
1617:     if (!currentPlayer) return;
1618:     const hpBar = document.querySelector('.hp-bar');
1619:     const hpText = document.querySelector('.game-header-hp');
1620:     if (hpBar && currentPlayer) {
1621:       const safeMaxHp = Math.max(1, currentPlayer.max_hp || 1);
1622:       const pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, ((currentPlayer.hp || 0) / safeMaxHp) * 100));
1623:       hpBar.style.width = pct + '%';
1624:       hpBar.className = 'hp-bar ' + (pct > 50 ? '' : pct > 25 ? 'low' : 'critical');
1625:     }
1626:     if (hpText && currentPlayer) {
1627:       hpText.textContent = `${currentPlayer.hp}/${currentPlayer.max_hp}`;
1628:     }
1629: 
1630:     // Update location and time in header without full re-render
1631:     const locEl = document.querySelector('.game-header-location');
1632:     const locStr = session?.current_wild_zone ? `🌲 ${session.current_wild_zone}` : (session?.current_location_name || '');
1633: 
1634:     if (locStr) {
1635:       if (locEl) {
1636:         locEl.textContent = `📍 ${locStr}`;
1637:         locEl.title = locStr;
1638:         locEl.style.display = '';
1639:       } else {
1640:         const statusBar = document.querySelector('.game-status-bar') || document.querySelector('.game-header-center');
1641:         if (statusBar) {
1642:           const span = document.createElement('span');
1643:           span.className = 'game-header-location';
1644:           span.textContent = `📍 ${locStr}`;
1645:           span.title = locStr;
1646:           statusBar.prepend(span);
1647:         }
1648:       }
1649:     } else if (locEl) {
1650:       locEl.style.display = 'none';
1651:     }
1652: 
1653:     const timeEl = document.querySelector('.game-header-time');
1654:     const day = session?.game_day ?? session?.game_time?.day;
1655:     const month = session?.game_month ?? session?.game_time?.month;
1656:     const year = session?.game_year ?? session?.game_time?.year;
1657:     const hour = session?.game_hour ?? session?.game_time?.hour ?? 10;
1658:     const minute = session?.game_minute ?? session?.game_time?.minute ?? 0;
1659:     const timeStr = formatGameCalendarDate(day, month, year, hour, minute);
1660:     if (timeStr) {
1661:       if (timeEl) {
1662:         timeEl.textContent = `🕐 ${timeStr}`;
1663:         timeEl.title = timeStr;
1664:         timeEl.style.display = '';
1665:       } else {
1666:         const statusBar = document.querySelector('.game-status-bar') || document.querySelector('.game-header-center');
1667:         if (statusBar) {
1668:           const span = document.createElement('span');
1669:           span.className = 'game-header-time';
1670:           span.textContent = `🕐 ${timeStr}`;
1671:           span.title = timeStr;
1672:           statusBar.appendChild(span);
1673:         }
1674:       }
1675:     } else if (timeEl) {
1676:       timeEl.style.display = 'none';
1677:     }
1678:   }

1934:       } catch (err) {
1935:         console.error('[generate-character] error:', err);
1936:         if (err?.data?.code === 'MISSING_API_KEY') {
1937:           toast.error('Не задан OpenRouter API Key. Откройте «⚙️ Аккаунт» в лобби и введите ключ.');
1938:         } else {
1939:           const detail = err?.data?.details || err?.data?.error || err.message || 'Неизвестная ошибка';
1940:           toast.error('Ошибка генерации: ' + detail);
1941:         }
1942:       } finally {
1943:         console.log('[generate-character] finally: reset UI');
1944:         btn.disabled = false;
1945:         btn.textContent = '✨ Сгенерировать нейросетью';
1946:         loading.style.display = 'none';
1947:       }
1948:     });
1949:   }
1950: 
1951:   // Cleanup on unmount
1952:   function cleanup() {
1953:     if (unsubMessages) unsubMessages();
1954:     if (unsubPlayers) unsubPlayers();
1955:     if (unsubTurnQueue) {
1956:       supabase.removeChannel(unsubTurnQueue);
1957:     }
1958:   }
1959: 
1960:   await load();
1961: 
1962:   // Return cleanup function
1963:   return cleanup;
1964: }

  41: // ============================================
  42: // AI API call
  43: // ============================================
  44: async function callAI(systemPrompt: string, userMessage: string, apiKey: string, retries = 3, model?: string): Promise<string> {
  45:   const useModel = model || AI_MODEL;
  46:   let lastError: Error | null = null;
  47:   for (let attempt = 0; attempt < retries; attempt++) {
  48:     try {
  49:       if (attempt > 0) {
  50:         await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1200 * attempt));
  51:       }
  52:       const response = await fetch("https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions", {
  53:         method: "POST",
  54:         headers: {
  55:           "Authorization": `Bearer ${apiKey}`,
  56:           "Content-Type": "application/json",
  57:         },
  58:         body: JSON.stringify({
  59:           model: useModel,
  60:           messages: [
  61:             { role: "system", content: systemPrompt },
  62:             { role: "user", content: userMessage },
  63:           ],
  64:           temperature: 0.7,
  65:           max_tokens: 2000,
  66:         }),
  67:       });
  68:       if (!response.ok) {
  69:         lastError = new Error(`AI API error: ${response.status}`);
  70:         continue; // retry
  71:       }
  72:       const data = await response.json();
  73:       const content = data?.choices?.[0]?.message?.content;
  74:       // OpenRouter sometimes returns null/empty content — treat as transient error, retry
  75:       if (!content || content.trim() === "") {
  76:         lastError = new Error("AI Router: пустой ответ от LLM");
  77:         console.warn(`[callAI] attempt ${attempt + 1}/${retries} — empty content, retrying...`);
  78:         continue;
  79:       }
  80:       return content;
  81:     } catch (err) {
  82:       lastError = err instanceof Error ? err : new Error(String(err));
  83:     }
  84:   }
  85:   throw new Error(`AI Router: не удалось получить валидный ответ после ${retries} попыток. Последняя ошибка: ${lastError?.message || "unknown"}`);
  86: }

  89: // ============================================
  90: // Утилиты времени (для fallback в GPS, если Шаг 1.6 не вызывается)
  91: // ============================================
  92: function advanceTime(base: { year: number; month: number; day: number; hour: number; minute: number }, addMinutes: number) {
  93:   let totalMin = (base.hour * 60 + base.minute + addMinutes);
  94:   let day = base.day, month = base.month, year = base.year;
  95:   const minutesInDay = 24 * 60;
  96:   while (totalMin >= minutesInDay) {
  97:     totalMin -= minutesInDay;
  98:     day++;
  99:     if (day > 30) { day = 1; month++; if (month > 12) { month = 1; year++; } }
 100:   }
 101:   return { year, month, day, hour: Math.floor(totalMin / 60), minute: totalMin % 60 };
 102: }

 104: // ============================================
 105: // Парсинг намерения прокачки характеристик из текста чата
 106: // ============================================
 107: function parseStatAllocationIntent(text: string): { stat: string; points: number } | null {
 108:   if (!text) return null;
 109:   const clean = text.toLowerCase().trim();
 110: 
 111:   const statMap: Record<string, string> = {
 112:     "сил": "STR", "str": "STR", "strength": "STR",
 113:     "ловк": "DEX", "dex": "DEX", "dexterity": "DEX",
 114:     "вынос": "CON", "con": "CON", "constitution": "CON", "тело": "CON",
 115:     "интел": "INT", "int": "INT", "intelligence": "INT", "ум": "INT",
 116:     "мудр": "WIS", "wis": "WIS", "wisdom": "WIS",
 117:     "хариз": "CHA", "cha": "CHA", "charisma": "CHA", "обаяни": "CHA"
 118:   };
 119: 
 120:   // Шаблон 1: глагол + количество + характеристика
 121:   // "вкладываю 2 очка в силу", "качаю ловкость +1", "добавь 2 в выносливость", "повысь мудрость на 1"
 122:   const verbRegex = /(?:вкладываю|вкачиваю|качаю|повышаю|добавь|распредели|кинь|увеличь|подними|повысь|поставь)\s*(?:себе)?\s*(\+?\d+)?\s*(?:очка|очко|очков|ед|пт|поинт[а-я]*)?\s*(?:в|на|к)?\s*([а-яa-z]+)/i;
 123:   const match1 = clean.match(verbRegex);
 124:   if (match1) {
 125:     const rawPts = match1[1] ? parseInt(match1[1].replace("+", ""), 10) : 1;
 126:     const rawStat = match1[2].toLowerCase();
 127:     for (const [prefix, statKey] of Object.entries(statMap)) {
 128:       if (rawStat.startsWith(prefix)) {
 129:         return { stat: statKey, points: isNaN(rawPts) || rawPts <= 0 ? 1 : rawPts };
 130:       }
 131:     }
 132:   }
 133: 
 134:   // Шаблон 2: характеристика + количество ("ловкость +1", "сила 2", "интеллект +2")
 135:   const statFirstRegex = /([а-яa-z]+)\s*(?:\+|\bплюс\b|\bна\b)?\s*(\d+)\s*(?:очка|очко|очков|ед|пт|поинт[а-я]*)?/i;
 136:   const match2 = clean.match(statFirstRegex);
 137:   if (match2) {
 138:     const rawStat = match2[1].toLowerCase();
 139:     const rawPts = parseInt(match2[2], 10);
 140:     for (const [prefix, statKey] of Object.entries(statMap)) {
 141:       if (rawStat.startsWith(prefix)) {
 142:         return { stat: statKey, points: isNaN(rawPts) || rawPts <= 0 ? 1 : rawPts };
 143:       }
 144:     }
 145:   }
 146: 
 147:   // Шаблон 3: +N характеристика ("+1 сила", "+2 выносливость")
 148:   const plusFirstRegex = /\+(\d+)\s*(?:в|на|к)?\s*([а-яa-z]+)/i;
 149:   const match3 = clean.match(plusFirstRegex);
 150:   if (match3) {
 151:     const rawPts = parseInt(match3[1], 10);
 152:     const rawStat = match3[2].toLowerCase();
 153:     for (const [prefix, statKey] of Object.entries(statMap)) {
 154:       if (rawStat.startsWith(prefix)) {
 155:         return { stat: statKey, points: isNaN(rawPts) || rawPts <= 0 ? 1 : rawPts };
 156:       }
 157:     }
 158:   }
 159: 
 160:   // Шаблон 4: глагол + характеристика без цифр ("качаю силу", "повысь ловкость" -> 1 очко)
 161:   const simpleRegex = /(?:вкладываю|вкачиваю|качаю|повышаю|увеличь|подними|повысь)\s*(?:себе)?\s*(?:в|на|к)?\s*([а-яa-z]+)/i;
 162:   const match4 = clean.match(simpleRegex);
 163:   if (match4) {
 164:     const rawStat = match4[1].toLowerCase();
 165:     for (const [prefix, statKey] of Object.entries(statMap)) {
 166:       if (rawStat.startsWith(prefix)) {
 167:         return { stat: statKey, points: 1 };
 168:       }
 169:     }
 170:   }
 171: 
 172:   return null;
 173: }

 178: serve(async (req) => {
 179:   if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
 180:     return new Response("ok", { headers: CORS });
 181:   }
 182: 
 183:   const requestId = crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8);
 184:   console.log(`\n[${requestId}] ════════ PROCESS-TURN (5-step pipeline) START ════════`);
 185: 
 186:   try {
 187:     const { session_id, player_id, action_text } = await req.json();

 192:         status: 400, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
 193:       });
 194:     }
 195: 
 196:     const imagePattern = /\b(image|img|photo|picture|avatar|icon|base64|data)\b[\s\S]*?\.(png|jpg|jpeg|gif|webp|bmp|svg)\b/gi;
 197:     if (imagePattern.test(safeActionText)) {
 198:       return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Обнаружены ссылки на изображения. Удалите их и попробуйте снова." }), {
 199:         status: 400, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
 200:       });
 201:     }
 202: 
 203:     const supabase = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY);
 204: 
 205:     // ============================================
 206:     // LOAD CONTEXT
 207:     // ============================================
 208:     const { data: player, error: playerErr } = await supabase
 209:       .from("players")
 210:       .select("*, inventory(*)")
 211:       .eq("id", player_id)
 212:       .single();
 213:     if (playerErr || !player) {
 214:       return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Player not found" }), { status: 404, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
 215:     }
 216:

 218:       .from("sessions")
 219:       .select("*, worlds(settings)")
 220:       .eq("id", session_id)
 221:       .single();
 222:     if (!session) {
 223:       return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Session not found" }), { status: 404, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
 224:     }
 225: 
 226:     const sessionStoryline = session.storyline || session.worlds?.settings?.storyline || null;
 227: 
 228:     // Resolve API key + models
 229:     let openrouterApiKey = sanitizeKey(FALLBACK_OPENROUTER_KEY);
 230:     let satelliteModel = AI_MODEL, gpsModel = AI_MODEL, dmModel = AI_MODEL;
 231:     if (player.user_id) {
 232:       const { data: us } = await supabase.from("user_settings")
 233:         .select("openrouter_key, satellite_model, gps_model, dm_model")
 234:         .eq("id", player.user_id).maybeSingle();
 235:       if (us?.openrouter_key) openrouterApiKey = sanitizeKey(us.openrouter_key);
 236:       if (us?.satellite_model) satelliteModel = us.satellite_model;
 237:       if (us?.gps_model) gpsModel = us.gps_model;
 238:       if (us?.dm_model) dmModel = us.dm_model;
 239:     }
 240:     if (!openrouterApiKey) {
 241:       return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Укажите ваш OpenRouter API Key в настройках.", code: "MISSING_API_KEY" }), {
 242:         status: 402, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
 243:       });
 244:     }
 245: 
 246:     // Load location, available locations, lore
 247:     let currentLocationName: string | null = null, currentStateName: string | null = null;
 248:     // Wild zone — природная зона вне именных локаций (лес, пещера, поле)
 249:     const currentWildZone: string | null = session.current_wild_zone || null;
 250:     if (currentWildZone) {
 251:       // Player is in open world / wild zone — use currentWildZone as location name
 252:       currentLocationName = currentWildZone;
 253:     } else if (session.current_location_id) {
 254:       try {
 255:         const { data: locData } = await supabase
 256:           .from("locations")
 257:           .select("name, states(name)")
 258:           .eq("id", session.current_location_id)
 259:           .maybeSingle();
 260:         if (locData) {
 261:           currentLocationName = locData.name;
 262:           const stateObj = Array.isArray(locData.states) ? locData.states[0] : locData.states;
 263:           currentStateName = stateObj?.name || null;
 264:         }
 265:       } catch (locErr) {
 266:         console.warn(`[${requestId}] Failed to load current location:`, locErr);
 267:       }
 268:     }
 269:

 271:     if (session.world_id) {
 272:       try {
 273:         const { data: statesWithLocs } = await supabase
 274:           .from("states")
 275:           .select("id, name, locations(id, name, type)")
 276:           .eq("world_id", session.world_id);
 277:         if (statesWithLocs) {
 278:           for (const s of statesWithLocs) {
 279:             const locs = Array.isArray(s.locations) ? s.locations : [];
 280:             for (const l of locs) {

 282:                 id: l.id,
 283:                 name: l.name,

 286:               });
 287:             }
 288:           }
 289:         }
 290:       } catch (locsErr) {
 291:         console.warn(`[${requestId}] Failed to load available locations:`, locsErr);
 292:       }
 293:     }
 294: 
 295:     let loreContext = "";
 296:     if (session.world_id) {
 297:       const { data: loreFiles } = await supabase
 298:         .from("lore_files")
 299:         .select("title, content")
 300:         .eq("world_id", session.world_id)
 301:         .limit(10);
 302: 
 303:       if (loreFiles && loreFiles.length > 0) {
 304:         const keywords = [safeActionText, currentLocationName || "", currentWildZone || ""]
 305:           .join(" ")
 306:           .toLowerCase();
 307: 
 308:         const relevantLore = loreFiles.filter((f: any) => {
 309:           const content = ((f.title || "") + " " + (f.content || "")).toLowerCase();
 310:           return keywords
 311:             .split(/\s+/)
 312:             .some((w: string) => w.length > 4 && content.includes(w));
 313:         }).slice(0, 2);
 314: 
 315:         const allLore = relevantLore.length > 0 ? relevantLore : loreFiles.slice(0, 1);
 316:         loreContext = allLore
 317:           .map((f: any) => `### ${f.title}\n${cleanTextForAI(f.content).slice(0, 600)}`)
 318:           .join("\n\n");
 319:       }
 320:     }
 321:     const { data: recentMsgs } = await supabase.from("messages").select("content, sender_type").eq("session_id", session_id).order("created_at", { ascending: false }).limit(10);
 322:     const recentMessages = (recentMsgs || []).reverse().map((m) => `[${m.sender_type === "master" ? "Мастер" : "Игрок"}]: ${cleanTextForAI(m.content).slice(0, 200)}`);
 323: 
 324:     // Load all players in session (for router, engine and system truth context)
 325:     const { data: allPlayersData } = await supabase.from("players").select("*, inventory(*)").eq("session_id", session_id);
 326:     const allPlayers = allPlayersData || [];
 327: 
 328:     // Load all NPCs in current location (for router, engine and system truth context)
 329:     let allNpcs: any[] = [];

 331:       const { data: npcData, error: npcErr } = await supabase.from("npcs")
 332:         .select("id, name, race, class, role, category, hp, max_hp, armor_class, level, is_hostile, status_tags, stats, background, appearance, habits, catchphrases, special_attacks, base_attacks, current_activity, activity_data, last_activity_time")
 333:         .eq("location_id", session.current_location_id);
 334:       if (!npcErr) {
 335:         // Derive is_alive from hp (column might not exist yet in all environments)
 336:         allNpcs = (npcData || []).map((n: any) => ({
 337:           ...n,
 338:           is_alive: (n.hp ?? 10) > 0,
 339:         }));
 340:       }
 341:     }
 342: 
 343:     const isCompanionNpc = (n: any) => {
 344:       const role = (n.role || "").toLowerCase();
 345:       const tags = Array.isArray(n.status_tags) ? n.status_tags.map((t: string) => String(t).toLowerCase()) : [];
 346:       return role === "companion" || role === "спутник" || tags.some((t: string) => ["companion", "спутник", "в_отряде", "питомец", "приручен"].includes(t));
 347:     };
 348: 
 349:     // Если игрок находится в дикой зоне (лес, пещера, пустошь), городские NPC (торговцы, жители) остаются в городе!
 350:     // В сцене с игроком присутствуют ТОЛЬКО спутники/питомцы или дикие враги/существа.
 351:     if (currentWildZone) {
 352:       const totalLoaded = allNpcs.length;
 353:       allNpcs = allNpcs.filter((n: any) =>
 354:         isCompanionNpc(n) ||
 355:         n.is_hostile === true ||
 356:         (Array.isArray(n.status_tags) && n.status_tags.some((t: string) => ["дикий", "монстр", "дикая_зона", "зверь", "хищник"].includes(String(t).toLowerCase())))
 357:       );
 358:       console.log(`[${requestId}] [WILD_ZONE] In wild zone "${currentWildZone}": filtered out town NPCs (${totalLoaded} -> ${allNpcs.length} present)`);
 359:     }
 360: 
 361:     console.log(`[${requestId}] [START] 🎯 Turn for player "${player.name}" (${player.id}) in session "${session_id}". Action: "${safeActionText}"`);
 362:     console.log(`[${requestId}] [LOCATION] 📍 LocationID=${session.current_location_id}, Name="${currentLocationName}", WildZone="${session.current_wild_zone || 'none'}", NPCs present=${allNpcs.length} (${allNpcs.map((n: any) => n.name).join(', ') || 'none'})`);
 363: 
 364:     // Проверяем, первый ли это ход в сессии (нет сообщений игрока или локация не задана)
 365:     const isFirstTurn = !session.current_location_id || !(recentMsgs || []).some((m: any) => m.sender_type === "player");
 366:     let startingLocationGenerated = false;
 367:

 369:       console.log(`[${requestId}] [STARTING_LOCATION] Generating/ensuring starting location for first turn...`);
 370:       try {
 371:         const startLoc = await ensureStartingLocation({
 372:           supabase,

 374:           player: {
 375:             id: player.id,
 376:             name: player.name || "Герой",
 377:             race: player.race,
 378:             class: player.class,
 379:             appearance: player.appearance,
 380:             personality: player.personality,
 381:             bio: player.bio,
 382:           },
 383:           action_text: safeActionText,
 384:           is_first_turn: true,
 385:           lore_context: loreContext,
 386:           openrouter_api_key: openrouterApiKey,
 387:           model: satelliteModel,
 388:         });
 389: 
 390:         if (startLoc && startLoc.is_new_location) {
 391:           startingLocationGenerated = true;
 392:           session.current_location_id = startLoc.location_id;
 393:           currentLocationName = startLoc.location_name;
 394:           currentStateName = startLoc.state_name;
 395:           session.game_year = startLoc.game_time.year;
 396:           session.game_month = startLoc.game_time.month;
 397:           session.game_day = startLoc.game_time.day;
 398:           session.game_hour = startLoc.game_time.hour;
 399:           session.game_minute = startLoc.game_time.minute;
 400: 
 401:           if (startLoc.initial_npcs?.length) {
 402:             allNpcs = startLoc.initial_npcs;
 403:           }
 404:           console.log(`[${requestId}] [STARTING_LOCATION] Created start location "${currentLocationName}" (${currentStateName}) for ${player.name}`);
 405:         }
 406:       } catch (locGenErr) {
 407:         console.warn(`[${requestId}] [STARTING_LOCATION] Generation error:`, locGenErr);
 408:       }
 409:     }
 410: 
 411:     // ============================================
 412:     // Чат: распределение очков характеристик
 413:     // ============================================
 414:     let statAllocatedFact: string | null = null;
 415:     const statAllocIntent = parseStatAllocationIntent(safeActionText);
 416:     if (statAllocIntent) {
 417:       console.log(`[${requestId}] [STAT_ALLOC] Detected chat intent: +${statAllocIntent.points} to ${statAllocIntent.stat}`);
 418:       try {
 419:         const { data: rpcRes, error: rpcErr } = await supabase.rpc("allocate_stat_points", {
 420:           p_player_id: player.id,
 421:           p_stat_name: statAllocIntent.stat,
 422:           p_points: statAllocIntent.points,
 423:         });
 424:         if (rpcErr) {
 425:           console.warn(`[${requestId}] [STAT_ALLOC] RPC error:`, rpcErr);
 426:         } else if (rpcRes && rpcRes.success) {
 427:           console.log(`[${requestId}] [STAT_ALLOC] Successfully allocated:`, rpcRes);
 428:           const statNamesRu: Record<string, string> = {
 429:             STR: "силу", DEX: "ловкость", CON: "выносливость",
 430:             INT: "интеллект", WIS: "мудрость", CHA: "харизму"
 431:           };
 432:           const statRu = statNamesRu[statAllocIntent.stat] || statAllocIntent.stat;
 433:           statAllocatedFact = `${player.name} успешно вложил ${statAllocIntent.points} очк. в характеристику ${statRu} (новое значение: ${rpcRes.new_value}, свободно очков: ${rpcRes.remaining_points}).`;
 434: 
 435:           player.stat_points = rpcRes.remaining_points;
 436:           if (!player.stats) player.stats = { STR: 10, DEX: 10, CON: 10, INT: 10, WIS: 10, CHA: 10 };
 437:           player.stats[statAllocIntent.stat] = rpcRes.new_value;
 438:           if (statAllocIntent.stat === "CON") {
 439:             const conMod = Math.floor((rpcRes.new_value - 10) / 2);
 440:             player.max_hp = Math.max(10, rpcRes.new_value * 2 + (player.level || 1) * Math.max(1, conMod + 5));
 441:           } else if (statAllocIntent.stat === "INT") {
 442:             player.max_mp = Math.max(20, rpcRes.new_value * 2 + (player.level || 1) * 5);
 443:           }
 444:         } else if (rpcRes && !rpcRes.success) {
 445:           console.log(`[${requestId}] [STAT_ALLOC] Allocation rejected: ${rpcRes.error}`);
 446:           statAllocatedFact = `${player.name} попытался распределить очки в ${statAllocIntent.stat}, но не смог: ${rpcRes.error}`;
 447:         }
 448:       } catch (allocEx) {
 449:         console.warn(`[${requestId}] [STAT_ALLOC] Exception:`, allocEx);
 450:       }
 451:     }
 452: 
 453:     // ============================================
 454:     // ШАГ 1: AI Router (parsePlayerIntent)
 455:     // ============================================
 456:     console.log(`[${requestId}] [STEP 1] AI Router...`);
 457:     const routerInput: RouterInputContext = {
 458:       player_action_text: safeActionText,
 459:       player: {
 460:         id: player.id,

 462:         race: player.race || "Человек",
 463:         class: player.class || "Воин",
 464:         level: player.level || 1,
 465:         hp: player.hp ?? 100,
 466:         max_hp: player.max_hp ?? 100,
 467:         stats: player.stats || { STR: 10, DEX: 10, CON: 10, INT: 10, WIS: 10, CHA: 10 },

 475:         quantity: i.quantity || 1,
 476:         condition: i.condition ?? null,
 477:         durability: i.durability ?? null,
 478:         description: i.description || "",
 479:       })),
 480:       nearby_npcs: allNpcs.map((n: any) => ({
 481:         id: n.id,
 482:         name: n.name || "NPC",

 484:         is_hostile: n.is_hostile || false,

 486:         max_hp: n.max_hp ?? 10,
 487:         distance_meters: 5,

 489:       weather: {
 490:         description: "Ясно",
 491:         temperature: 20,
 492:         is_raining: false,
 493:         is_night: ((session.game_hour ?? 8) < 6 || (session.game_hour ?? 8) >= 22),
 494:         wind_speed: 2,
 495:       },
 496:       game_time: {
 497:         year: session.game_year || 1,
 498:         month: session.game_month || 1,
 499:         day: session.game_day || 1,
 500:         hour: session.game_hour || 8,
 501:         minute: session.game_minute || 0,
 502:       },
 503:       current_location_id: session.current_location_id || null,
 504:       current_location_name: currentLocationName,

 506:         title: sessionStoryline.title,
 507:         current_arc: sessionStoryline.arcs?.[sessionStoryline.current_arc_index || 0] || null,

 514:         routerInput,

 525:       return new Response(JSON.stringify({

 528:         clarification_msg: routerResult.clarification_msg,
 529:         actions: [],
 530:       }), { status: 200, headers: { ...CORS, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
 531:     }
 532: 
 533:     console.log(`[${requestId}] [STEP 1] 🧭 Router: status="${routerResult.status}", actions=${JSON.stringify(routerResult.actions.map((a: any) => ({ type: a.action_type, target: a.target_item_name || a.target_entity_id, stat: a.stat_to_check })))}`);
 534: 
 535:     // Apply GPS time/location (still here, as it's pre-engine)
 536:     let time_passed_minutes = 0;
 537:     let location_changed = startingLocationGenerated,
 538:       new_location_id: string | null = startingLocationGenerated ? session.current_location_id : null,
 539:       new_wild_zone: string | null = null,
 540:       wild_zone_changed = false,
 541:       travel_description = "";
 542:     try {
 543:       const gpsSystemPrompt = buildGpsPrompt({
 544:         playerName: cleanTextForAI(player.name || "Герой"),
 545:         actionText: safeActionText,
 546:         intentType: "router",
 547:         intentDescription: safeActionText,
 548:         currentYear: session.game_year || 1248, currentMonth: session.game_month || 5,
 549:         currentDay: session.game_day || 14, currentHour: session.game_hour || 10,
 550:         currentMinute: session.game_minute || 0,

 556:       const gpsResp = await callAI(gpsSystemPrompt, "Определи время.", openrouterApiKey, 2, gpsModel);
 557:       const gpsParsed = parseAIJson(gpsResp);
 558:       if (gpsParsed) {
 559:         time_passed_minutes = Math.max(0, Math.min(1440, Number(gpsParsed.time_minutes) || 0));
 560:         if (gpsParsed.location_changed === true) {
 561:           if (gpsParsed.is_wild_zone === true && gpsParsed.new_location_name) {
 562:             // Переход в дикую зону (лес, пещера, поле)
 563:             wild_zone_changed = true;
 564:             new_wild_zone = gpsParsed.new_location_name;
 565:             travel_description = gpsParsed.travel_description || "";
 566:             console.log(`[${requestId}] [GPS] Wild zone: ${new_wild_zone}`);
 567:           } else if (gpsParsed.new_location_id) {
 568:             // Переход в именованную локацию
 569:             location_changed = true;
 570:             new_location_id = gpsParsed.new_location_id;
 571:             wild_zone_changed = true;
 572:             new_wild_zone = null; // очищаем дикую зону
 573:             travel_description = gpsParsed.travel_description || "";
 574:             console.log(`[${requestId}] [GPS] Location change → ${new_location_id}`);
 575:           }
 576:         }
 577:       }
 578:     } catch (e) { /* ignore GPS errors, game continues */ }
 579: 
 580: 
 581:     // ============================================
 582:     // ШАГ 2: Game Engine

 588:       .from("player_skills")
 589:       .select("skill_key, level, effects")
 590:       .eq("player_id", player.id);

 592:     if (pSkills) {
 593:       for (const ps of pSkills) {

 595:       }
 596:     }
 597: 
 598:     // Сокращение времени на действия от навыков (собирательство, выживание, горное дело и т.д.)
 599:     if (time_passed_minutes > 0) {
 600:       let maxTimeRedPct = 0;
 601:       for (const s of Object.values(skillsMap)) {
 602:         if (s.effects?.time_reduction_pct && s.effects.time_reduction_pct > maxTimeRedPct) {
 603:           maxTimeRedPct = s.effects.time_reduction_pct;
 604:         }
 605:       }
 606:       if (maxTimeRedPct > 0) {
 607:         const reduced = Math.round(time_passed_minutes * (1 - maxTimeRedPct / 100));
 608:         console.log(`[${requestId}] [SKILLS] Time reduced by ${maxTimeRedPct}% from ${time_passed_minutes}m to ${reduced}m`);

 631:         armor_class: player.armor_class || 10,
 632:         initiative: player.initiative || 0,
 633:         level: player.level || 1,
 634:         inventory: player.inventory || [],
 635:         injuries: player.injuries || [],
 636:         skills: skillsMap,
 637:       },
 638:       targets: {
 639:         players: new Map((allPlayers || []).map((p: any) => [p.id, p])),
 640:         npcs: new Map(allNpcs.map((n: any) => [n.id, n])),
 641:         location_items: new Map(),
 642:       },
 643:     });
 644:     if (statAllocatedFact) {
 645:       if (!engineResult.raw_system_facts) engineResult.raw_system_facts = [];
 646:       engineResult.raw_system_facts.push(statAllocatedFact);
 647:       if (!engineResult.system_facts) engineResult.system_facts = engineResult.raw_system_facts;
 648:       else engineResult.system_facts.push(statAllocatedFact);
 649:     }
 650:     console.log(`[${requestId}] [STEP 2] ⚙️ Engine: mutations=${JSON.stringify(engineResult.mutations.map((m: any) => m.type))}, facts=${JSON.stringify(engineResult.raw_system_facts)}`);
 651:

 657:       session_id,
 658:       engine_output: engineResult,
 659:     });
 660:     console.log(`[${requestId}] [STEP 3] ${persistenceResult.status}, ${persistenceResult.applied_mutations_count} applied`);
 661: 
 662:     // Apply time advance to session
 663:     if (time_passed_minutes > 0) {
 664:       const nt = advanceTime({
 665:         year: session.game_year || 1248, month: session.game_month || 5, day: session.game_day || 14,
 666:         hour: session.game_hour || 10, minute: session.game_minute || 0,
 667:       }, time_passed_minutes);

 669:         game_year: nt.year, game_month: nt.month, game_day: nt.day,
 670:         game_hour: nt.hour, game_minute: nt.minute,
 671:       }).eq("id", session_id);
 672:       session.game_year = nt.year;
 673:       session.game_month = nt.month;
 674:       session.game_day = nt.day;
 675:       session.game_hour = nt.hour;
 676:       session.game_minute = nt.minute;
 677:     }
 678:     if (location_changed && new_location_id) {
 679:       await supabase.from("sessions").update({
 680:         current_location_id: new_location_id,
 681:         current_wild_zone: null, // вернулись в именованную локацию
 682:         current_wild_zone_description: null,
 683:       }).eq("id", session_id);
 684: 
 685:       // Спутники и члены отряда перемещаются вместе с игроком в новую локацию
 686:       try {
 687:         const { data: compNpcs } = await supabase
 688:           .from("npcs")
 689:           .select("id, status_tags, role")
 690:           .eq("world_id", session.world_id);
 691:         const companionIds = (compNpcs || [])
 692:           .filter((n: any) =>
 693:             n.role === "companion" ||
 694:             (Array.isArray(n.status_tags) && (n.status_tags.includes("спутник") || n.status_tags.includes("в_отряде") || n.status_tags.includes("питомец") || n.status_tags.includes("приручен")))
 695:           )
 696:           .map((n: any) => n.id);
 697: 
 698:         if (companionIds.length > 0) {
 699:           await supabase.from("npcs").update({ location_id: new_location_id }).in("id", companionIds);
 700:           console.log(`[${requestId}] [COMPANION] Moved ${companionIds.length} companion(s) to new location ${new_location_id}`);
 701:         }
 702:       } catch (moveErr) {
 703:         console.warn(`[${requestId}] [COMPANION] Failed to move companions:`, moveErr);
 704:       }
 705:     }
 706: 
 707:     if (wild_zone_changed && new_wild_zone) {
 708:       await supabase.from("sessions").update({
 709:         current_wild_zone: new_wild_zone,

 711:       }).eq("id", session_id);

 714:       allNpcs = allNpcs.filter((n: any) =>
 715:         isCompanionNpc(n) ||

 717:         (Array.isArray(n.status_tags) && n.status_tags.some((t: string) => ["дикий", "монстр", "дикая_зона", "зверь", "хищник"].includes(String(t).toLowerCase())))
 718:       );

 729:         expeditionEvents = await resolveNpcBackgroundActivities({

 732:           current_game_time: {
 733:             year: session.game_year || 1248,
 734:             month: session.game_month || 5,

 736:             hour: session.game_hour || 10,
 737:             minute: session.game_minute || 0,

 749:     try {
 750:       companionAction = await handleCompanionInSceneAction({
 751:         supabase,
 752:         player_action_text: safeActionText,

 768:     try {
 769:       const detectedSkill = detectSkillFromAction({
 770:         action_text: safeActionText,

 772:         skill_hint: routerResult.skill_hint,

 781:           p_xp_amount: xpAmount,

 796:     let playerLevelUp: any = null;
 797:     try {
 798:       const isCombatAction = routerResult.actions.some((a: any) => a.type === "attack");
 799:       const baseTurnXp = isCombatAction ? 50 : 25;
 800:       const currentLevel = player.level || 1;

 802:       const xpNeeded = currentLevel * 100;
 803:

 808:

 814: 
 815:         const intVal = player.stats?.INT || 10;
 816:         const newMaxMp = Math.max(20, intVal * 2 + newLevel * 5);

 821:           xp: leftoverXp,

 823:           max_hp: newMaxHp,
 824:           hp: newHp,
 825:           max_mp: newMaxMp,
 826:           mp: newMp,
 827:           updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
 828:         }).eq("id", player.id);

 832:         } else {

 834:           player.xp = leftoverXp;
 835:           player.stat_points = newStatPoints;
 836:           player.max_hp = newMaxHp;
 837:           player.hp = newHp;
 838:           player.max_mp = newMaxMp;
 839:           player.mp = newMp;
 840:         }
 841: 
 842:         playerLevelUp = {
 843:           old_level: currentLevel,
 844:           new_level: newLevel,
 845:           stat_points_gained: 2,
 846:           total_stat_points: newStatPoints,
 847:           hp_gained: hpGain,
 848:           max_hp: newMaxHp,
 849:           max_mp: newMaxMp,
 850:         };
 851:         console.log(`[${requestId}] [LEVEL_UP] Player ${player.name} leveled up to ${newLevel}! (+2 stat points)`);
 852:       } else {
 853:         const { error: xpUpdateErr } = await supabase.from("players").update({
 854:           xp: currentXp,
 855:           updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
 856:         }).eq("id", player.id);
 857:         if (xpUpdateErr) {
 858:           console.error(`[${requestId}] [XP_UPDATE] DB update error:`, xpUpdateErr);
 859:         } else {
 860:           player.xp = currentXp;
 861:         }
 862:       }
 863:     } catch (lvlErr) {
 864:       console.warn(`[${requestId}] Leveling check failed:`, lvlErr);

 866: 
 867:     // ============================================
 868:     // ШАГ 4: System Truth Compiler
 869:     // ============================================
 870:     console.log(`[${requestId}] [STEP 4] System Truth...`);
 871:     const systemTruth = await compileSystemTruth({
 872:       session_id,
 873:       acting_player_id: player.id,
 874:       engine_output: engineResult,
 875:       persistence_output: persistenceResult,
 876:       session: {
 877:         game_year: session.game_year || 1248, game_month: session.game_month || 5,
 878:         game_day: session.game_day || 14, game_hour: session.game_hour || 10,
 879:         game_minute: session.game_minute || 0,
 880:         current_location_id: session.current_location_id,
 881:       },
